quick: Talk to Dravynea the Stoneweaver.
Obtain a sample of frost salts.
Return for your reward.

walkthrough.heading: Keeping the Mine Safe
paragraphs: Dravynea the Stoneweaver is a Dark Elf alteration expert living in Kynesgrove. When she is not working in the Steamscorch Mine, you can find her wandering the town or in the Braidwood Inn. Should you be in the market for some free Alteration training, ask her about her business in Kynesgrove. She will explain that she uses her powers as a mage to keep the mine safe. She is able to make a potion using frost salts to keep the temperature in the mine bearable, but is out of frost salts at the moment. Tell her that you can get some for her. She will off-handedly offer you free training if you actually bring her the salts.

walkthrough.heading: Finding Frost Salts
paragraphs: The quest will update to "Bring some Frost Salts to Dravynea". While the term "some" is rather ambiguous, only one bowl of frost salts is required to fulfill the objective. If you do not have a sample in your inventory already, there are many ways to obtain a sample: from the corpse of a frost atronach, purchasing one from an apothecary merchant, creating a sample at the Atronach Forge, or placed randomly on shelves. If you are a member of the College of Winterhold, you have access to two free samples in the Hall of Countenance alchemy lab.

walkthrough.heading: The Reward
paragraphs: When you have your sample, take it to Dravynea to complete the quest. She will seem surprised that you actually came through, and will give you a free training session equaling one level of Alteration as a reward.

stages.text: Objective 10: Bring some Frost Salts to Dravynea

notes: Because this is a favor quest which affects Dravynea's disposition, it will count towards the "Help the People" part of the Thane of Eastmarch quest.
This quest can be assigned multiple times, resulting in a +1 Alteration skill improvement every time the quest is completed.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.1, fixes this bug.

quick: Speak with Klimmek about his trips to High Hrothgar.
Receive Klimmek's Supplies, and climb the steps to High Hrothgar.
Place supplies in indicated chest.
Return to Klimmek for your reward.

walkthrough.heading: Klimmek's Problem
paragraphs: When you arrive in Ivarstead for the first time, you will find Klimmek and Gwilin having a conversation on the bridge:

Gwilin: "On your way up the 7,000 Steps again, Klimmek?" Klimmek: "Not today. I'm just not ready to make the climb to High Hrothgar. The path isn't safe." Gwilin: "Aren't the Greybeards expecting some supplies?" Klimmek: "Honestly, I'm not certain. I've yet to be allowed into the monastery. Perhaps one day."

Apparently Klimmek makes a trip every few weeks up the 7,000 steps to High Hrothgar to deliver supplies to the Greybeards, though he has never actually seen them in person. Unfortunately, he is now older, and finds the climb more difficult. You can choose to help him, with the promise of a reward. He will give you a bag of supplies and ask you to place them in a chest outside the High Hrothgar monastery. You can also ask Klimmek for advice on what to expect on the way, and he'll tell you that he's only had to deal with wolves. He will, however, also tell you to watch your step, as the snow-capped stairs can be dangerous.

walkthrough.heading: Deliver the Goods
paragraphs: If you have already discovered High Hrothgar, you may simply travel there. If not, you must climb the 7,000 steps leading out of Ivarstead and up the mountainside, encountering some wolves and a frost troll along the way. Once at the top of the 7,000 steps, you will see the monastery with a chest located in the center of a pair of stairwells that lead up to the building itself. Now just open the chest and place the supplies inside. Klimmek's supplies are found in the Misc section of the inventory.

walkthrough.heading: There and Back Again
paragraphs: Once you have placed the supplies in the chest, return to Klimmek, who will compensate you for your leg work. He will give you a level-dependent amount of gold as a reward.

stages.text: Objective 10: Bring the supplies to High Hrothgar

notes: Klimmek's supplies will remain in the chest indefinitely. They can be taken and returned at any time, however doing so will not grant you any further reward. The supplies are also always persistent; placing them in the inventory of a corpse keeps them from despawning.

There are only about 700 steps on the way up to High Hrothgar, not 7,000. When walking, it takes approximately 2,400 footsteps from High Hrothgar to reach the base of the path. Walking 7,000 footsteps from High Hrothgar will actually bring you to the town center of Whiterun.
Todd Howard jokingly mentioned in an interview that he would count all the steps leading up to High Hrothgar to make sure it's 7,000.
Gwilin can sometimes be killed by nearby bears. In that case, Klimmek will no longer be on the bridge and you will have to track him down in order to start the quest.
If you drop Klimmek's supplies after completing the quest, they will hover in the air and can be used as a platform of sorts.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.5, fixes this bug.

quick: Read Nightgate Inn Patron's Note in Nightgate Inn.
Investigate the barrel behind the inn.
Read the Undercover Guard's Journal.
Investigate the camp site.
Inspect Pale-Eyes' body.

paragraphs: To start this quest, read the Nightgate Inn Patron's Note in Nightgate Inn. The note mentions the barrel behind the Inn, investigate the barrel and you will find Undercover Guard's Journal. The journal mentions that a wanted criminal, Pale-Eyes is camping out west of Northwatch Keep.

As you arrive at the camp, you will find a Thalmor wizard and two Thalmor soldiers, once you have dealt with them you can search the corpse of Pale-Eyes to find a full set of enchanted iron plate armor. Once you take his journal, the quest will finish.

quick: Obtain permission to purchase land from the steward/jarl of Hjaalmarch, Falkreath Hold, or the Pale.
Purchase the land from the steward.
Visit your new property, and use the drafting table to begin building your house.
Use the carpenter's workbench to build the foundation of your house. Continue building your home to your liking.

paragraphs: Once you've obtained the favor of the Jarl of Falkreath Hold, Hjaalmarch, or the Pale, usually by doing quests for them, you will be given the right to purchase a piece of land in the hold. In Morthal and Falkreath, you will need to see the steward about obtaining permission; in Dawnstar, it is the jarl who grants permission. After receiving permission, you may purchase the land from the relevant steward for 5,000 gold. The plot will then be marked on your map.

Upon arriving at your new property, you will be instructed to use the drafting table to begin building your house. Your only option will be the Small House Layout. After selecting the plans, you will be instructed to use the carpenter's workbench to build the foundation of your house and, if this is your purchased land, a misc objective to buy lumber will appear in your journal. It directs you to Hert but it can be completed by speaking to any lumberjack. To start off the building you need one sawn log and ten quarried stone for the foundations. There will be a stone quarry somewhere on the site, so you won't need to go far to find some.
Having done this, the quest concludes. However, there are many more construction and furnishing options to choose from. See the construction article for more information.

walkthrough.heading: Achievements
paragraphs: Two achievements are unlocked while completing the three versions of this quest:
Landowner (10 points/Bronze) — Buy a plot of land
Land Baron (10 points/Bronze) — Buy three plots of land

notes: If you reach level 9, and have not yet started the quest, one of the jarls will send you a letter by courier. If you're friends with the jarl of Falkreath or Hjaalmarch, the steward will send you this letter; for the Pale, it will instead be this letter, straight from the jarl. If you haven't made friends with any of them yet, this letter will be sent to you from the current Jarl of Falkreath. Regardless of who sends which letter, reading it will give you the objective to speak to the jarl and advance the quest.
If not yet friends with any jarl, and Rare Gifts is still in your journal when the courier sets out to find you, it will be failed and removed from your journal in favor of this quest.
It is advisable to purchase the land for Lakeview Manor in Falkreath hold before completing Contract: Kill Helvard, as you may not be able to regain Siddgeir's favor afterwards.
If you use the console, you can click on Siddgeir and use setrelationshiprank player 2 to fix this.
Alternatively if you side with the Stormcloaks and take Falkreath, Dengeir of Stuhn replaces Siddgeir as the Jarl, bypassing this issue.
If Hert is dead, the misc quest doesn't fail but will have no marker and can be completed by speaking to any other lumberjack as normal.

Once you are eligible to start this quest in one of the other two holds by having befriended their jarl, Siddgeir possibly may not offer Rare Gifts or Kill the Bandit Leader, which will make the house unavailable in Falkreath.

Once you are level 9 or above and are certain that the courier isn't coming, enter Siddgeir's Longhouse and then use the following console commands. This should start the bandit quest, allowing this quest to proceed normally afterwards. prid 19822 setrelationshiprank player 2 setstage Favor154 10
If you've started but not completed this quest, you cannot initiate Thane quests in other holds.
Quest becomes impossible to start either after having started the Kill Helvard quest or after becoming thane.
After (but also possibly before) becoming thane the quest can be force started with: setstage BYOHHouseFalkreath 30
This quest doesn't have the property set for cut logs which can result in the planned inventory filter failing to apply. This led to potential script overload and stack dumps.
The Unofficial Hearthfire Patch, version 2.0.1, fixes this bug.

If you did not talk to Farengar Secret-Fire during the Bleak Falls Barrow quest yet, you possibly may not get the option to ask the jarl for any jobs, and may not be able to tell him you got his letter. This will block you from becoming a thane and thus accessing the house until you progress the main quest. If you want to evade starting Dragon Rising to avoid enabling dragons in Skyrim but still want to access to Lakeview Manor, you can progress the Bleak Falls Barrow quest to the point where you need to give Farengar the tablet and stop there. This will make Siddgeir talk to you about "tasks" or the letter but won't enable dragons.

quick: Talk to Lars Battle-Born and agree to help him.
Talk to Braith and get her to stop bullying Lars.

paragraphs: Wander around Whiterun and you may hear Lars Battle-Born being picked on by Braith. Speak to Lars and he'll explain that he's being bullied. He'll also offer you his life savings to deal with the problem: "Yes. Braith bullies me all the time. All the elders think I'm a milk drinker 'cause I can't fight. Nobody understands. If you can get Braith to leave me alone, I'll be your best friend... forever! I'll pay you, too! My whole life's savings - two septims!"

walkthrough.heading: Beat Senseless... By a Girl, no Less!
paragraphs: Others will take notice of the boy's distress, and try to speak to Lars, who will be unforthcoming, including Bergritte, who suggests her grandson go play outside:

Bergritte: "Lars, dear, why don't you go outside and play? It's a beautiful day." Lars: "That's all right, grandmother. I like staying home with you." Bergritte: "It's that Braith girl again, isn't it? Has she been bothering you again? I've a mind to speak with her mother." Lars: "No! Please, grandmother, don't do that. I'm fine. Really. Can we just... not talk about this anymore?" Bergritte: "All right, dear."
Lars' no-nonsense mother, Alfhild Battle-Born, will take a much harder tone, saying: "My boy Lars has been getting beat senseless, and by a girl, no less!"

walkthrough.heading: Bratty Braith
paragraphs: It seems that these aren't exaggerations - Braith is a child with a serious chip on her shoulder, as illustrated by her treatment of her unfortunate target. The first conversation will always play out first, with the next two appearing randomly:

walkthrough.heading: A Love/Hate Relationship
paragraphs: At Lars' request, you can approach Braith and tell her to stop her bullying ways. In order to persuade her, you can tell her:
"I'm Lars' bodyguard. Mess with him and you mess with me!"
"He has a disease. It's very contagious."
"You want to be shipped off to the Honorhall Orphanage?"

As harsh as the last choice may seem, all three options lead to the same response. It turns out Braith has liked Lars for quite some time now, and only wanted a kiss. If he had obliged, she wouldn't have had to bully him. Although this may seem like an odd way to treat the boy she wants a kiss from, the blame for this warped behavior does not entirely lie with Braith herself, as she can often be heard asking her parents for advice, to little or no avail:

Braith: "Papa, I want to talk to you..." Amren: "Hmm? What about?" Braith: "Well, there's this boy, and..." Amren: "Listen, Braith... Why don't you talk to your mother about this, okay? There's a good girl."
Braith: "Mother? Can I talk to you?" Saffir: "Not now, Braith." Braith: "But..." Saffir: "Not now, Braith!"
Braith: "Mother?" Saffir: "What?" Braith: "I wanted to ask you something. It's about a boy..." Saffir: "Not now, Braith. Go... go ask your father."

After the quest conclusion, you'll notice that Braith no longer bullies Lars, and in fact keeps her distance from him. Lars will thank you for your help, and Braith will tell you that she has stopped bullying him.

stages.text: Objective 10: Convince Braith to stop bullying Lars

notes: You can only speak with Lars Battle-Born between 8am and 8pm.
After completing this quest, even if she continues with her same abrasive dialogue, Braith becomes friendly to you and will occasionally give you a gift or invite you to play.
You do not have to complete this quest to receive your reward (2 gold pieces).
If Braith's parents are dead and Braith is sent to Honorhall Orphanage, the dialogue to tell her to stop bullying Lars won't show up there.

Braith will sometimes go into Carlotta Valentia's house and stay there, no longer patrolling Whiterun or returning to Amren's house. If this has happened, your quest marker may point to Carlotta's house after you talk to Lars.

If you can pick the lock on Carlotta's house without being detected, you can still have the quest dialogue with Braith inside the house. When you leave, she will follow you out, and resume her normal schedule.

During the opening conversation with Lars, Braith will say: "You'd better give me five septims right now, or I'm going to bloody your nose... Ten septims tomorrow, baby Battle-Born. Or I'm gonna bloody your nose and your lip.", making Braith undecided on the amount of septims she wants.

The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.4, addresses this issue. After Braith says "You'd better give me five septims right now, or I'm going to bloody your nose...", Lars will say his "No! Please! I really don't have any money, Braith! I'll give you ten septims tomorrow. Just don't hit me." line, THEN Braith will say "Ten septims tomorrow, baby Battle-Born. Or I'm gonna bloody your nose and your lip."

quick: Buy a Dwarven item from a shop in a city.
Receive the message from a courier.
Sell it to Calcelmo.

paragraphs: After purchasing a Dwarven item of any kind inside a city, a courier may come to you shortly afterward with a letter from Calcelmo in Markarth, saying that he wants to buy the item from you. Reading the letter triggers this quest.

When you take the item to Calcelmo, you can sell it to him for twice the item's base value. If you succeed at a persuade (Speech 50+) or intimidate check, Calcelmo will offer two and a half times the item's base value.

walkthrough.heading: Value Ratio
paragraphs: You can use these tables to find out how much gold Calcelmo will pay you for each item:

stages.text: Objective 10: Bring a <Alias=Item> to Calcelmo

notes: Enchanted and non-enchanted Dwarven apparel and weapons (including arrows/bolts) can trigger this quest.
You can keep the item and complete the quest by agreeing to sell, immediately exiting dialogue, and then dropping your item before it is removed.
Be mindful of your positioning if using this trick, as it's possible for the item in question to be tossed into the flowing water below and end up out of reach.
If the item is dropped, sold, tempered, or enchanted the quest cannot be completed unless you find another, identical item (as stated in his message).
This quest may be triggered multiple times.
Calcelmo may ask for the same item more than once.
If you have two of the requested item and want to keep a specific one, trade the one you want to your follower then finish the quest as Calcelmo might end up taking the one you want to keep.

As the price Calcelmo offers is calculated from the base value of the item (e.g., Dwarven gauntlets have a base value of 85 septims), selling an enchanted item through this quest can be a horribly bad deal.

With the addition of Dawnguard add-on, Calcelmo may ask for Dwarven Crossbows, Enhanced Dwarven Crossbows, and Dwarven Bolts, including any of the three explosive bolts discovered during the Ancient Technology radiant quests.

It doesn't matter where you buy it (be it Volkihar Castle or the Riverwood Trader) or from which merchant (even the Dremora Merchant via the Black Market power), you can still get the letter via courier to start the quest.
If the requested item you bought is enchanted, it is strongly recommended that you don't disenchant it at an Arcane Enchanter, or you may need to tell Calcelmo you lost it.

If the requested item was bought from a military camp, the note will say "military camp", rather than the camp's actual name. For example, Reach Stormcloak Camp and Winterhold Imperial Camp will simply be recognized as "Stormcloak military camp" and "Imperial military camp", respectively.

Crafting, enchanting, looting, and stealing Dwarven weapons and armor doesn't initiate the quest; they must be purchased from a valid merchant. However, if one you made, enchanted, looted, or stole is sold to a merchant and purchased back, then that may be taken into account.

You may or may not get his letter after you buy a Dwarven item from a blacksmith or merchant. If you want to keep the item and not start the quest (as it will remain stuck in your quest log until you finally sell the item to him), don't read the letter he sends to you and drop it or put it into a container (one belonging to you or even something in the depths of a dungeon). He'll still have the dialogue option to sell (as if you'd read the note, even though you didn't), but as long as you don't pick it, you can avoid starting the quest and keep what you paid for.
Calcelmo may not acknowledge that an item is in your inventory.

Removing the item and getting it back again, such as dropping it and picking it up or trading it to a follower temporarily, may fix this. You may have to be in third-person view or the item could disappear when you drop it.
If you have sold/lost the item, you can add it to your inventory through the console commands and it may be accepted by Calcelmo.
If you have sold/lost the item, a forged/enchanted replacement may not be accepted by Calcelmo.
Items that have been marked for the quest, but the courier has not delivered the note regarding, can be enchanted but cannot be named.
The item Calcelmo requests may not be removed from your inventory when you are rewarded.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.1, fixes this bug.
The Execution Hood from With Friends Like These... is counted as a Dwarven artifact for this quest.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.1, fixes this bug.

It is possible to sell an item to Calcelmo without having been given the note from the courier. This would then result in the courier attempting to make a delivery for the quest even though it was already complete.
The Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch, version 4.0.8, fixes this bug.

Unique items like the Dwarven Black Bow of Fate can be targeted by this quest. If you're not willing to part with the item, your only choices are to drop the item, as detailed in Notes, or leave the quest active.
You can escape the dialogue right after Persuade/Intimidate speech check before advancing quest stage. Therefore it can be repeated for leveling Speech up.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.5, fixes this bug.

Shoot down the bird outside the Bulwark's south gate.
Read the note.
Follow the Redoran Guard to Old Attius Farm Cellar.
Kill the guard and the Buyer.

paragraphs: After reading Masks of the Tribunal, you will need to travel to Raven Rock, and head up the stairs near the front of the Temple to the top of the Bulwark. Face south towards Old Attius Farm to see a lone Felsaad Tern circling close by. As long as it's not too close to midnight (any time up to 11) this bird will appear and continuously circle around. If it's knocked out of the sky an objective prompt to "retrieve the note" will appear. Find the bird's body and loot it to find a note.

Locate the Redoran Guard marked with a quest objective. Follow him south to the Old Attius Farm site, and from there down through the trapdoor into the Old Attius Farm Cellar. Kill the guard and the Buyer, and retrieve the Mask of Vivec and a Fahlbtharz Forge Gem. Optionally loot the Redoran Guard for a note describing his motivations.
Finishing this quest completes one of the three tasks of the goddess in the Ghosts of the Tribunal quest. It also provides one of the four forge gems required to complete the Trueflame quest.

notes: The Redoran Guard needn't be followed or watched. Just head over near the Old Attius Farm Cellar trap door and wait past midnight, during 12AM~4AM. It'll be unlocked and the Buyer will be down there with the guard. They'll attack on sight so kill them.

quick: Meet with Legate Rikke.
Defend Whiterun.
Destroy the attacking force of Stormcloaks.
Talk to Jarl Balgruuf the Greater after his speech.

walkthrough.heading: The Burning City
paragraphs: At the end of Message to Whiterun, report to Legate Quentin Cipius and he will tell you the latest news about the Stormcloaks and give you your new orders: "The Stormcloaks are here. In force. Get down to the front line. This is it. We must hold the city. Move it!"

Upon leaving Dragonsreach, you will find Whiterun under siege by Stormcloak catapults. Along the city wall of the Plains District, the Imperial Legion will be returning fire with their own catapults. The streets will be busy with citizens running back to their houses and city guards making ready to fight the enemy. Whiterun will suffer great destruction during the battle. Severio Pelagia will be killed and his home, as well as Heimskr's, will be destroyed.

walkthrough.heading: The Bleeding Battlefield
paragraphs: Just outside the city gates, you will find Legate Rikke on the strategically important main entryway, busy addressing a crowd of fully-armed Imperial Soldiers:

"This is it men! This is an important day for the Empire and for the Legion. And for all of Skyrim. This is the day we send a message to Ulfric Stormcloak and the rebel Jarls who support him. But make no mistake. What we do here today, we do for Skyrim and her people. By cutting out the disease of this rebellion, we will make this country whole again! Ready now! Everyone, with me! For the Empire! For the Legion! Rrrrrraaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!!"

Soon after Rikke finishes her speech, the Stormcloaks will start their attack. Their archers will provide suppression fire from a distance outside the gate, while the main force will move up the main road in groups. First, you need to defend the barricades, then the drawbridge. Finally, you need to kill attacking soldiers until the percentage of attackers remaining drops to zero. Legate Rikke and Hadvar, both of whom are essential and cannot be killed, will give you a hand during the defense, so stay close to one or both of them if you are having difficulty. The united force of Whiterun guards and Imperial soldiers will take advantage of the fortifications and draw the attention of many enemies.

Don't worry if you are unable to defend the barricades or drawbridge. It does not affect the ending of the quest or your reward. When the percentage of remaining attackers drops to zero, the battle will be over and this quest will be complete. Any surviving Stormcloaks will lose heart and flee the battlefield. This starts an unnamed miscellaneous quest with the objective Report to the Jarl of Whiterun. Also, completion of Battle for Whiterun automatically starts the next quest Reunification of Skyrim.

walkthrough.heading: The Inspiring Speech
paragraphs: Irileth will tell everyone to follow her, as Jarl Balgruuf the Greater wishes to speak. You may listen to his speech after the combat:

"Revel in your victory here today, even as the gods revel in your honor! They already sing of your valor and skill! The halls of Sovngarde are no doubt ringing with your praises! In defeating these Stormcloak traitors, you have proven the hollowness of their cause and the fullness of your hearts. The citizens of Whiterun are forever in your debt! But Ulfric will not stop here. No, he will continue to strike out against any true Nord who remains faithful to the Empire. He will continue to sow discord and chaos wherever he can. And so, we must each one of us, continue to fight this insurrection, lest our fallen brothers have died for naught! Lest our honor be lessened should we allow these bloodthirsty beasts to prowl our lands! Carry on men, my gratitude and blessings go with you! For Whiterun! For the Empire!"

At the end of his speech, you may talk to him. The jarl will thank you and grant you the privilege of buying a house in his city, if you haven't already: "Thank you for your role in all of this. It'd be my honor should you decide to make Whiterun your home. Speak with Proventus. He'll make the necessary arrangements.". This completes the miscellaneous quest.

walkthrough.heading: Reward
paragraphs: As part of the next quest, Reunification of Skyrim, when you return to General Tullius in Solitude, he commends you for the victory and gives you the rank of Quaestor, along with a leveled enchanted weapon.

stages.text: The Stormcloaks are attacking Whiterun. I have been ordered to defend the outer walls and keep the rebels from taking the city.
We have successfully defended the city of Whiterun. Demonstrating the weakness of the rebels' cause and the excellence of the Imperial Legion.
Objective 1: Report to the Jarl of Whiterun

notes: This quest, Battle for Whiterun (Stormcloaks), Battle for Solitude, and Battle for Windhelm are all different radiant versions of the same quest.
After Balgruuf finishes his speech, you can ask him why he chose to side with the Imperials and what it will take to win the war.

His response for why he sided with the Imperials will be "Mutual advantage! Any fool can see that. For centuries, we have benefitted from the Empire's protection, and prosperous trade with the south. In exchange, the people of Cyrodiil sleep peacefully, knowing that their northern border is guarded by the fiercest warriors in all Tamriel."

His response for what it will take to win the war will be "Ulfric Stormcloak's head on a pike. Do you think Ulfric really cares about Skyrim's independence, or the welfare of its people? I promise you, he doesn't. He's nothing more than a barbarian renegade, whose lust for power has cost the lives of countless innocents."
Even before this quest has begun, Whiterun Guards and Stormcloak soldiers can be seen engaging each other in combat.
If you previously befriended Fralia Gray-Mane, Fralia will remain friendly after the Empire gains control of Whiterun.
If you previously told Idolaf Battle-Born that you support the Gray-Manes, Idolaf will remain hostile after the Empire gains control of Whiterun.

If Lucia has been adopted, she will be transferred to the Bannered Mare until after the battle is over. This happens because her editor location is there and CWCitizensFlee will pick her up in one of the aliases.

The Bannered Mare will have a barricade across the main entrance and both doors will be expert-locked, however if you pick the lock, both Hulda and Saadia will have their normal speech options, welcoming you and are willing to trade.
Breezehome becomes locked again, key required.

Honningbrew Meadery is apprentice-locked during this battle, however if you pick the lock Sabjorn will be back in charge with both him and Mallus Maccius telling you to get out and treating you as if they don't know you. You are unable to trade with either of them.
You will be unable to enter Jorrvaskr during or after the battle as all the doors require a key.
Your horse can easily be killed if it's waiting by the stables, as it does if you fast-traveled here.
Followers who are accompanying you when receiving this quest cannot exit the Whiterun city gates with you, and instead stay inside the walls until you return.

Select the "part ways" dialogue before leaving the city gates and recruit them again on the other side. This does not work for followers who return to Whiterun when dismissed, such as Lydia or Jenassa.
During the previous quest Message to Whiterun, tell your follower to wait just outside the city gates before returning Balgruuf's war axe to the jarl.

It can be somewhat difficult to keep the barricade intact because your own archers will shoot at it while trying to shoot the enemies. To get around this, you can run past the stable and into the field. This is essentially the spawn point. You will have to kill about 50 enemies by yourself, but they will prioritize attacking you over the town.
In fact, defending the city becomes much easier when exactly one of the barricades is down, as the gap will form a bottleneck and the Stormcloaks will ignore the other barricade.

There is a temporary Stormcloak camp outside the city next to the Meadery. If you run to it directly after the battle, there will be one Stormcloak Soldier in the large tent looking at the map, but no other inhabitants.
After this quest Fort Greymoor will be garrisoned by Imperial Soldiers. Additionally, due to the destruction of his house, Heimskr will preach outside the Shrine of Talos 24/7.

Heimskr was supposed to be arrested and sent to the Dragonsreach dungeon due to the Empire having control of Whiterun, but that never happens. In addition, the Shrine of Talos isn't affected in any way.
Vilkas may fail to greet you properly after the battle is finished.
The Official Skyrim Patch, version 1.9, fixes this bug.
Random dragon attacks may occur in and around the city of Whiterun during this quest.
The Official Skyrim Patch, version 1.9.26.0.8, fixes this bug.
Legate Quentin Cipius may not start this quest, instead giving only generic greetings.
This bug is caused by quest aliases for the CWSiege quest failing to fill if they are missing.
After this quest, Heimskr doesn't get arrested and instead simply preaches in front of the Shrine of Talos nonstop.
After you finish this quest, [...] may appear in your journal instead of the name of the next quest and the quest marker will disappear.

Do not stand next to Balgruuf when he's running up the ramp to deliver his speech. Go stand in among the soldiers he will be addressing below him. Then you will be within the trigger area and the quest will correctly update.

Sometimes the bug is caused because the trigger area isn't spawning precisely in the correct location (it sometimes spawns too high, you can't hit it by walking through it). So, another thing that often helps is after you deliver the axe to Ulfric, don't go straight back to Whiterun. Spend time doing other things and other quests, away from the Whiterun cell, until the area has time to respawn with the quest flags set. Otherwise, the area is all respawned with all the quest updates and alterations to the area all happening at once, the moment you enter the cell - and this sometimes glitches, ending up with the master quest being labeled [...]. This helps insure that by the time you DO go back to Whiterun, the trigger area will have spawned in the right spot (down around where the soldiers gather, in the grassy area near the entrance gate) and will update the quest correctly.
NPCs such as Aela, Lydia, Lucia (if adopted), and your hired bard may appear as soon as you leave Whiterun and be attacked by the Whiterun guards. Additionally, no Stormcloak guards will spawn.
Be sure to dismiss all followers before exiting the city gates, Additionally, move your family to a different city before you start this quest.
Use the console command setstage CWSiegeObj 9000 to complete the quest instead.
Legate Rikke may not complete her speech, making the battle unwinnable. Balgruuf may also fail to give his speech at the end of the quest.
Re-entering Whiterun's main gate may update the quest objective from "Meet with Legate Rikke" to "Defend the Barricades".

It is possible to attack Rikke until she becomes hostile, and then to yield to her, to move the quest forward. Balgruuf's speech may be bypassed simply by travelling away from the area after the battle. Both will prevent you from watching the entire scene, but will allow you to continue play.

This bug seems to be related to guards failing to travel to the mustering point prior to the battle, and therefore the speech scene being unable to proceed until those actors are in their correct positions -- possibly related to the locking main gate that prevents your followers from joining you for the battle.
If you report to General Tullius before reporting to the Jarl of Whiterun, the miscellaneous quest Report to the Jarl of Whiterun will be stuck in your journal with no way to complete it.
The console command CompleteAllObjectives CWPostWhiterunObj can be used to complete the related quest.
Upon reaching the barricades, the Stormcloaks may run away but the quest will not update, leaving the quest marker at the barricades
Reloading the autosave from exiting Whiterun fixes this issue
Rarely, after exiting Dragonsreach, the quest will update to 'Speak with General Tullius' and the battle will be skipped. NPCs will react as if you fought in the battle.
When defending the barricades, if you destroy both of them yourself before the enemy does, the Stormcloaks will be unable to find the barricades and you will end up fighting on the field alone.
There is a rare situation where you and the enemies will not be able to destroy the barricades.
Restarting the game will fix this.

If you manage to keep the barricades intact, the drawbridge will not open. People then take the ramp and walk around the drawbridge towards Whiterun but drop off the wall moving away from Whiterun. The latter may result in people with low health dying due to the drop.
Restarting the battle and letting the Stormcloaks destroy at least one barricade will fix this.

The drawbridge may be reenabled using console commands prid 6a167, then disable, then again prid 17055 and enable reopening the path for the player. However, this does not reset the navmesh with NPCs still using the detour.

quick: Talk to Matriarch Drevlan about performing a task for the Goddess.
Read Masks of the Tribunal.
Ask Aphia Velothi about a missing Curate.
Read Curate Melita's Plea.
Travel to Stony Creek Cave.
Rescue or kill Curate Melita.
Retrieve the Mask of Sotha Sil.

paragraphs: You will have to head to Raven Rock and speak to Aphia Velothi:

She will hand you the Curate's plea. The objective says to return to Skyrim and find Curate Melita in Kagrenzel. You can circumvent this entire location and simply head to Stony Creek Cave. She's tied up in the waterfall chamber all the way at the back of the cave. You will have the option to either save her or end her life. The Mask of Sotha Sil can be acquired with both options. If her life is spared, she will return to Ashfall's Tear as an Apothecary vendor.

stages.text: I've discovered a temple near Raven Rock where worshipers of Almalexia gather. It seems the temple Matriarch is searching for the lost Masks of Vivec and Sotha Sil. Objective 10: Ask about the missing Curate

I've discovered a temple near Raven Rock where worshipers of Almalexia gather. It seems the temple Matriarch is searching for the lost Masks of Vivec and Sothal Sil. Evidently, one of the temple's Curates had been following up on a lead for the masks when she went missing. Objective 20: Read Curate Melita's Plea

I've discovered a temple near Raven Rock where worshipers of Almalexia gather. It seems the temple Matriarch is searching for the lost Masks of Vivec and Sothal Sil. Evidently, one of the temple's Curates had been following up on a lead near Kagrenzel. I should head to the area and see what I can find. Objective 25: Find the missing Curate in Kagrenzel

I've discovered a temple near Raven Rock where worshipers of Almalexia gather. It seems the temple Matriarch is searching for the lost Masks of Vivec and Sothal Sil. Evidently, one of the temple's Curates had been following up on a lead near Kagrenzel. I should head to the area and see what I can find.

I've discovered a temple near Raven Rock where worshipers of Almalexia gather. It seems the temple Matriarch is searching for the lost Masks of Vivec and Sothal Sil. Evidently, one of the temple's Curates had been following up on a lead near Kagrenzel. I found the Curate and retrieved the mask from her.

notes: Her location intersects with other creation content. The bandits and bandit chief carrying the Ruin's Edge Bow and the Blissbug In A Jar from Saints and Seducers will all be in this same location together.
When going directly to Stony Creek Cave, the quest marker nonetheless will point to the entrance of Kagrenzel until you speak to Melita and the quest completes.

quick: Talk to Swims-In-Deep-Water inside the Riften Fishery.
Read the book in the back room of the Fishery for the optional objective.
Go outside the Fishery and at the end of the dock is a Rod and Fishing Supplies where you can catch the list of fish.
Return to Swims-In-Deep-Water.

paragraphs: To begin this quest you need to speak to Swims-In-Deep-Water:
You then have three options:
He will hand you a list of fair weather fish, which requests you to catch:
Carp
Glassfish
Goldfish
Pogfish

You can find a copy of Fishing Mastery, v1 on a shelf in the room behind Swims. This book will inform you of where you can catch each of these fish. All of the fish can be found in temperate lakes and rivers, see this link for a list of fishing locations, but these fish can all be caught in the docks of Riften and along the river that leads to Ivarstead.
Once you have caught all the fish required, return to Swims:
He will then reward you with 200 gold.

stages.text: Swims-In-Deep-Water has given me a list of fish I should catch to improve my fishing skills. I should read the note to see what I need to catch. Objective : Read the list of fair weather fish

Swims-In-Deep-Water would like me to catch fish that can commonly be caught in streams and lakes in the warmer parts of Skyrim. Once I've caught one of each, I should return them to him. His field guide, Fishing Mastery, should provide details on each fish and how they can be caught. He mentioned that a copy is sitting on a shelf in the back room of the Riften Fishery. Objective 0: Obtain a carp Objective 1: Obtain a glassfish Objective 2: Obtain a goldfish Objective 3: Obtain a pogfish Objective 75: (Optional) Read Fishing Mastery, v1

I read the first volume of Fishing Mastery, Swims-In-Deep-Water's field guide. All of the fish I need to catch can be caught in the warmer parts of Skyrim on a clear day. Goldfish and glassfish can only be caught in lakes, while pogfish are found in streams. Carp can be caught in both lakes and streams. I should be able to catch what I need by fishing of off the docks near the Riften Fishery, and along the river that leads to Ivarstead. Objective 50: Return to Swims-In-Deep-Water
I've given Swims-In-Deep-Water all of the fish he requested as proof of completing his fishing challenge. In return, he gave me a sum of gold, as well as a key to the Riften Fishery.

quick: Talk to Svana Far-Shield in Haelga's Bunkhouse.
Obtain the Marks of Dibella from Bolli, Indaryn, and Hofgrir.
Confront Haelga.
Return to Svana.

walkthrough.heading: A Worshipper
paragraphs: If you visit Haelga's Bunkhouse in Riften, you may see Svana Far-Shield busy doing some cleaning there. The work is difficult and endless, and she prefers to call it slavery. Ever since her parents died and Haelga took her in, it's been a nightmare. She was surprised to learn that Haelga is such a wretched woman. "So now I'm stuck living here while those pigs she calls customers grope me and say the most awful things." In her opinion, Haelga is disgusting and she takes her worship of Dibella a bit too seriously. According to Svana, Haelga slept with three different men in the last month. Svana would like to see her squirm just once. She happens to know that after Haelga makes love, she gives her partner a token of her affection called a Mark of Dibella. If you collect the marks from Bolli, Indaryn, and Hofgrir (All three men are located in Riften), and confront Haelga with them, it would cause her endless embarrassment. Furthermore, Svana asks that you collect the marks without violence.

walkthrough.heading: Three Lovers
paragraphs: In order to get the three Marks of Dibella, you can use your Speech skills to persuade or intimidate the men into giving their marks to you. Alternatively, you can just pickpocket the marks from your targets. If you kill any of the men, the quest will fail immediately.

Bolli can usually be found wandering in the market or working in Riften Fishery. Talk to him about the mark and he will say "I have no idea what you're talking about. I'd never sleep with anyone besides my good wife, Drifa [sic]." You must pass an average-level Speech check to persuade him.

Indaryn can usually be found at the Black-Briar Meadery, but he will visit The Bee and Barb too. If you talk to him about Haelga, he will be a little angry "You're crazy! How dare you make such an accusation!" You must pass an average-level Speech check to persuade him.

Hofgrir is the owner of the Riften Stables and you can find him there easily. If you ask him to give you the mark, he will pretend to be innocent: "Huh? What are you talking about? I don't even know what that is." You must pass a bugged easy-level Speech check to persuade him (see Bugs).

walkthrough.heading: Two Rewards
paragraphs: Once you have all three Marks of Dibella, return to Haelga's Bunkhouse and show them to Haelga. She will be surprised. "What? How... where did you get these?" Obviously, she doesn't want anyone else to know about it, especially Svana. She will give you a magic scroll to keep you quiet. "If word got out that I'm practicing my Dibellan Arts in Riften, they'll run me out of town."

Bring the news to Svana, and she will be quite happy. "Oh I know. Isn't it wonderful? I bet she squirmed like a skeever when you pulled them out of your pocket." She believes things are going to be a lot different around here with your help. Then she will give you a piece of enchanted armor in return. "I want you to have this. It was my father's but I'm certain you'll put it to good use."

stages.text: Objective 10: Obtain a Mark of Dibella from Bolli Objective 20: Obtain a Mark of Dibella from Hofgrir Objective 30: Obtain a Mark of Dibella from Indaryn
Objective 40: Confront Haelga with the Marks of Dibella
Objective 50: Speak to Svana

notes: Blessing of Dibella (+10 Speechcraft for 8 hours) from the shrine in Haelga's bedroom and Gift of Charity (+10 Speechcraft for 1 hour) from giving alms to Edda or Snilf can improve your chance to persuade targets to hand over marks of Dibella.
After you complete this quest, you will be allowed to take low value items from anywhere in Haelga's Bunkhouse (due to your new friendship with Svana), even items found in her boarders' containers.
Svana will not offer the quest if one of the three lovers was already killed before talking to her.

If you have pickpocketed any of the marks of Dibella by accident before receiving the quest, make sure to find all three before attempting to speak to anyone. You will get a notice to confront Haelga in your miscellaneous quest log. You can talk to Haelga and Svana without the requisite dialogue options and then talk to Haelga again. You will get to give the stones to Haelga after all and your quest will complete and a reward given.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.6, fixes this bug.

After acquiring one of the marks before ever picking up the quest, Svana will urge you to find the rest of the marks though you won't see anything in your quest log. However after obtaining all three, a miscellaneous objective to confront Haelga will then appear and the quest can be taken through to completion from that point on with items received from both Haelga and Svana.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.6, fixes this bug.
When asking Bolli about his relationship with Haelga he will remark that he has never slept with any woman other than his wife Drifa. However, Bolli's wife is Nivenor.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.7, fixes this bug.
Hofgrir Horse-Crusher's persuade check is incorrectly flagged to check his Speech level rather than yours.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.1, fixes this bug.
Hofgrir's intimidation check can be used, instead, which always works.
The Persuade option will succeed if the player has the Persuasion perk. Additionally, the effect of having picked the Persuasion perk at any point will be retained even if the Speech skill is reset.

quick: Read Adonato Leotelli's Journal in Candlehearth Hall.
Kill the Web Mother in Cronvangr Cave.
Loot the bodies of Grenwulf and Holrik.

paragraphs: To start this quest you need to read Adonato Leotelli's Journal which can be found on a table on the upper floor of Candlehearth Hall. You will then need to travel to Cronvangr Cave.

At the end of the lair, the web mother will drop down and attack you alongside some frostbite spiders. The web mother can spit projectile spiders. The spirits of Holrik Frost-Sword and Grenwulf the Brawler will join the fight, and once the web mother is dead, will walk to their corpses.
Investigate Holrik's body and you will find the Ice Blade of the Monarch and Holrik's Note. Investigate Grenwulf's body and you will find the Fists of Randagulf and Grenwulf's Note.

stages.text: I've heard many great warriors have come through Skyrim over the years, and passed through Candlehearth Hall in Windhelm. If I travel there, I may hear some stories of what became of them. Objective 10: Investigate Candlehearth Hall

I traveled to Candlehearth Hall and read a journal about two warriors, who traveled to Cronvangr Cave to defeat a dangerous spider. I should travel to the cave and find out what became of them. Objective 20: Search Cronvangr Cave for the two heroes

I traveled to Candlehearth Hall and read a journal about two warriors, who traveled to Cronvangr Cave to defeat a dangerous spider. I traveled to Cronvangr Cave and found the spider's lair. Objective 30: Defeat the Web Mother

I traveled to Candlehearth Hall and read a journal about two warriors, who traveled to Cronvangr Cave to defeat a dangerous Web Mother. I traveled to Cronvangr Cave and found the spider's lair, defeating the Web Mother. Objective 40: Speak to the Heroes

I traveled to Candlehearth Hall and read a journal about two warriors, who traveled to Cronvangr Cave to defeat a dangerous Web Mother. I traveled to Cronvangr Cave and found the spider's lair, defeating the Web Mother. I spoke to the heroes who bequeathed me their treasures before fading away.
Objective 50: Inspect Grenwulf's corpse
Objective 60: Inspect Holrik's corpse

I traveled to Candlehearth Hall and read a journal about two warriors, who traveled to Cronvangr Cave to defeat a dangerous Web Mother. I traveled to Cronvangr Cave and found the spider's lair, defeating the Web Mother. After the battle, the heroes rewarded me with their treasures.

notes: At the bottom of the first large chamber within Cronvangr Cave there is a button that opens to a vampire lair. This is an optional quest overlap location. This is the lair location of one of the "Pets of Skyrim". Behind the gory shack on the upper ledge and in a cage is the Tamable Frostbite spider named "Arachnia". It can be picked up now or later on following its associated quest.
Sometimes the quest won't start even after reading Adonato Leotelli's Journal.
Manually triggering the quest by using console command setstage ccBGSSSE069_quest 20 will solve this issue.
After killing the Web Mother, Grenwulf's ghost may not lead you to his corpse after Holrik has done the same.
Exiting the Broodlair into the main cave and returning will remedy this.
You can also use resurrect 0 in the console.
Grenwulf and Holrik can be given follower commands by holding the action key. Doing that, then waiting for them to disappear and then giving a command to either one will instantly crash the game.

quick: Travel to Riften Fishery and speak with Swims-In-Deep-Water.
Read List of Rainy Weather Fish.
(Optional) Read Fishing Mastery, v2.
Obtain a Catfish.
Obtain a Pearlfish.
Obtain a Pygmy Sunfish.
Obtain a Spadefish.
Obtain Swims-In-Deep-Water's Lucky Fishing Hat.
Hand your fish over to Swims-In-Deep-Water and decide on whether to keep the Lucky Fishing Hat or give it back.

paragraphs: Speak to Swims for this next challenge:
He then hands you a list of rainy weather fish, which tells you that you need to catch a:
Catfish
Pearlfish
Pygmy Sunfish
Spadefish

You can also optionally pickup a copy of Fishing Mastery, v2 from the shelf in the backroom. Travel to Geirmund's Hall, where you can fish up Swims' lucky fishing hat, which when worn will cause thunderstorms while fishing at temperate lakes and streams, making this quest much easier.
Once you have caught the required fish, return to Swims where you can either return his hat to him or lie that you didn't find it:
Either option leads to you getting an Argonian fishing rod and the ability to create more, if you give Swims his hat back, he will also reward you with 400 gold:

stages.text: Swims-In-Deep-Water has given me another fishing challenge. I should read the list he gave me to see what I will need to catch. Objective 100: Read the list of rainy weather fish Objective 10: Fish up Swims-In-Deep-Water's lucky fishing hat

The fish that Swims-In-Deep-Water would like me to catch are a bit more elusive than last time. However, they come to the surface more frequently while it is raining. I should refer to the second volume of Fishing Mastery to learn more. He also asked me to help fish up his lucky fishing hat, lost at a fishing spot west of Sarethi Farm. He claims that it rains wherever he wears the hat when fishing. That sounds far-fetched, but I suppose I could use all the luck I can get. Objective 0: Obtain a catfish Objective 1: Obtain a pearlfish Objective 2: Obtain a pygmy sunfish Objective 3: Obtain a spadefish Objective 75: (Optional) Read Fishing Mastery, v2

I have read the second volume of Fishing Mastery. All of the fish I need to catch are most easily caught when it's raining in the warmer parts of Skyrim. Catfish and spadefish can only be caught in lakes, while pygmy sunfish are found in streams. Pearlfish can be caught in both lakes and streams. He also asked me to help fish up his lucky fishing hat, lost at a fishing spot west of Sarethi Farm. He claims that it rains wherever he wears the hat when fishing. That sounds far-fetched, but I suppose I could use all the luck I can get. Objective 50: Return to Swims-In-Deep-Water

I've given Swims-In-Deep-Water all of the fish he requested as proof of completing his fishing challenge, as well as his lucky fishing hat. He rewarded me with an Argonian fishing rod, which will be useful when trying to catch large fish. He also handed me a sum of gold.

I've given Swims-In-Deep-Water all of the fish he requested as proof of completing his fishing challenge. I kept his lucky fishing hat to myself after telling him I couldn't find it. He rewarded me with an Argonian fishing rod, which will be useful when trying to catch large fish.

notes: The journal states that you can find pygmy sunfish in streams, when in reality they are found in lakes when it is raining.
The Official Skyrim Special Edition Patch, version 1.6.1130.0, fixes this bug.

The objective to "Fish up Swims-In-Deep-Water's lucky fishing hat" and a quest marker to the respective fishing spot appear right after the quest is given, but the Lucky Fishing Hat can only be fished after the List of Rainy Weather Fish is read.
The Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch, version 4.3.2, addresses this issue. The objective for fishing up the hat will no longer be displayed until after the note is read.
The fish tank that's supposed to receive the fish you turn in during the quest was never properly set in the script properties, which can lead to the fish not being added to it.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 4.3.3, fixes this bug.

quick: Speak to Serana.
Explore Castle Volkihar.
Investigate the Moondial.
Explore Castle Volkihar's Ruined Tower.
Locate Valerica's Journal.
(If not a vampire) Become a Vampire Lord or get partially soul trapped.
Enter the Soul Cairn.

paragraphs: Serana will speak to you after the Moth Priest reads the Elder Scroll, saying she may know where to find one of the scrolls. She thinks her mother, Valerica, may have information on it, and may even possess it. Serana believes Valerica may have left a clue in the courtyard at Castle Volkihar. Though you will not be able to enter through the Keep, Serana knows of a secret entrance you can use. If you have a follower at this point, you must dismiss them. Simply telling them to wait is not enough: Serana won't accompany you unless you send your follower home.

When you reach the castle, head northwest, along the coastline. When you reach the castle's old docks, you will be attacked by four high-powered skeletons. Use the secret entrance to the undercroft and fight your way through death hounds, skeevers, skeletons, and a feral vampire.

After dealing with the vampire, you will arrive at a stone archway with a raised drawbridge. Head up a set of stairs on the opposite corner of the room to find the lever needed to lower the bridge. Cross the bridge and take a left as instructed by Serana: this leads into an open area inhabited by death hounds. Climb the stairs in the southern section and pass through a tunnel leading to a room with a giant frostbite spider. You can snipe at the spider from the tunnel, as it's too large to enter the tunnel. Once you've dispatched it, pull a lever to lower another bridge, giving you access to the courtyard.

The courtyard itself is abandoned and derelict, and Serana will immediately tell you there is something wrong with the moon dial. You will need to find the three missing pieces and place them in the moon dial in order for a secret entrance to open.
The Half Moon Crest is in the center of a pond lying against a rock in the northwest corner of the courtyard.
The Full Moon Crest is behind a patch of nightshade lying against the castle's exterior wall in the fenced off area identified as Valerica's garden.
The Crescent Moon Crest is up the stairs, to the right of the entrance to Volkihar North Tower lying on the floor beside a table and chairs.

Once all pieces are back in place, the dial will swivel to reveal steps leading down to the ruins below the castle. Fight your way past more gargoyles and skeletons until you reach a room with gargoyles and a fireplace. Serana will tell you there must be a secret entrance somewhere, and sure enough, you can either turn the candlestick near the fireplace or pull the chain behind the gargoyle to reveal a secret door. Note that pulling the chain will unleash the stone gargoyle. There is also a vampire royal armor near the shelf to the right.

Head through the secret door to Valerica's study. Here you will need to search for her journal, in the central bookcase west of where you entered. After Serana reads it, she will tell you to find certain ingredients in the laboratory:
The Finely Ground Bone Meal is on the table by the entrance beneath the mammoth skull.
The Soul Gem Shards are on the first wardrobe up the stairs that lead east.
The Purified Void Salts are on a shelf with other ingredients, near the farthest point of the raised area of the room, on the balcony above the entrance.

All of these items are in silver bowls, and will be added to your miscellaneous inventory when you pick them up, as they are considered quest items. Note that "regular" bonemeal, soul gem fragments, and void salts will not work.
Once you have all three, place them in the vessel in front of the portal, which Serana is typically standing next to. She will then add her blood to the mixture, opening a portal to the Soul Cairn.

If you are vampire (whether by siding with the Volkihar or through "regular" infection when siding with the Dawnguard), you will be able to enter straight away. If you are not a vampire, you will suffer some health damage when attempting to use the portal. Serana will explain that to enter the Soul Cairn you must be "dead" and then give you a choice:
Allow her to turn you into a Vampire Lord.
Allow her to trap part of your soul in a soul gem.

This is the only way to enter the Soul Cairn without becoming a vampire and will add the Weakened Soul effect, which reduces your health, stamina, and magicka by 45 points (as well as their regeneration rates) while in the Soul Cairn (click here or here for workarounds).
Choosing either will allow you to enter the Soul Cairn.

stages.text: Dexion's reading of the Elder Scroll has given rise to more questions than answers. The Moth Priest saw a vision of a weapon called Auriel's Bow, but Serana and I need to locate two more Elder Scrolls in order to unravel the rest of the prophecy. Objective 10: Speak to Serana

Serana has indicated her desire to locate her estranged mother, Valerica, who had fled Castle Volkihar with one of the Elder Scrolls. She believes that Valerica may have left a clue to her whereabouts somewhere in the courtyard of the castle. In order to avoid detection by Harkon, we've decided to utilize a hidden entrance on the back side of the island. Objective 20: Explore Castle Volkihar's Courtyard

Serana has indicated her desire to locate her estranged mother, Valerica, who had fled Castle Volkihar with one of the Elder Scrolls. She believes that Valerica may have left a clue to her whereabouts somewhere in the courtyard of the castle. In order to avoid detection by the castle's vampires, we've decided to utilize a hidden entrance on the back side of the island. Objective 20: Explore Castle Volkihar's Courtyard
Objective 30: Investigate the moondial

Serana and I are trying to locate her mother, Valerica, who may have one of the Elder Scrolls. Our journey has taken us to the courtyard of Castle Volkihar where we've discovered a hidden entrance underneath Valerica's old moondial. Objective 40: Explore Castle Volkihar's Ruined Tower

Serana and I are trying to locate her mother, Valerica, who may have one of the Elder Scrolls. Our journey has taken us beyond the courtyard of Castle Volkihar where we've discovered a hidden entrance underneath Valerica's old moondial. After exploring the ruined tower beyond, we've stumbled across an old alchemy laboratory. Serana is convinced her mother has hidden some notes that may yield a clue as to her whereabouts. Objective 45: Locate Valerica's Journal
Objective 50: Speak to Serana

Serana and I are trying to locate her mother, Valerica, who may have one of the Elder Scrolls. Our search has taken us to Valerica's laboratory hidden within the ruined tower at Castle Volkihar. According to Valerica's notes found there, she has likely fled Tamriel and entered the Soul Cairn, a dimensional plane of Oblivion. In order to pursue her into the Soul Cairn, Serana and I need to recreate the experiment that opens the portal to this strange place. Objective 52: Gather Soul Gem Shards (if not in inventory) Objective 54: Gather Finely Ground Bone Meal (if not in inventory) Objective 56: Gather Purified Void Salts (if not in inventory)
Objective 60: Place the ingredients in the vessel
Objective 70: Speak to Serana

Serana and I are trying to locate her mother, Valerica who may have one of the Elder Scrolls. In Valercia's laboratory, we've recreated an experiment she performed and opened a portal to the Soul Cairn, a plane of Oblivion. Serana believes strongly that her mother is inside this strange place and has indicated we should step through. Objective 80: Enter the Soul Cairn
Objective 90: Speak to Serana

When attempting to step through the portal to the Soul Cairn, a hidden force that seems to be draining my life energy is preventing me from entering. I have two choices if I wish to enter the Soul Cairn. I can allow Serana to change me into a vampire, thereby "killing" me in effect. Alternatively, I can allow her to partially soul trap me which could potentially weaken me while I roam the Soul Cairn. Objective 100 or 110: Become a vampire or Become partially soul trapped
Objective 100: Become a vampire

Serana and I have stepped from Valerica's laboratory on Tamriel to a plane of Oblivion known as the "Soul Cairn" in order to find her mother Valerica. Serana strongly believes if we can find her, she will be able to tell us the location of one of the Elder Scrolls we need to decipher the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy.

notes: Before entering the Cairn, you can exit the laboratory through a door in the southern corner. This leads to the Castle Volkihar Balcony, a small outside area from which you can fast-travel and then return to the Soul Cairn without having to traverse the castle ruins and courtyard again. A foot chest near the door also provides easy access to a container to stash loot while fast-travelling.

If you exit before deciding whether to be become a Vampire Lord or have your soul captured, Serana will remain in the study, even if you fast travel. This presents a small window of opportunity to acquire two followers: leave the castle grounds, recruit a follower and return. Though your new follower won't enter the Castle, they will not be dismissed, and once you complete Beyond Death they will continue following you, as will Serana. This allows you to have two followers for the rest of the game.

If playing on Survival Mode (which disables fast travel), the Become Ethereal Shout can allow the balcony exit to remain a shortcut outside by jumping off the ledge. Otherwise you'll have to backtrack through the dungeons to go back outside.

Choosing to become a Vampire Lord and then returning to Fort Dawnguard will prompt Florentius, Sorine, or Gunmar to direct you to Falion, thus beginning the quest Rising at Dawn. Other Dawnguard members, including Isran, will regard you with caution and disgust. You will not be able to use the Dawnguard's services until you cure yourself.

While this quest or Beyond Death are active, you will be unable to dismiss Serana from your party. If you are on the Dawnguard side and a werewolf, it can be challenging to use Beast Form and have the Savage Feeding perk as Serana tends to raise corpses in battle. This prevents you from feeding unless you manage to feed on raised corpses after they die again but before they turn into a pile of ash.
From the courtyard you have access to two more zones of the castle - the east and north towers - which contain further loot.
Serana may repeat dialogue about her mother being on the other side of the portal if you should decide to leave the ruins before entering the portal.

When asked to put the ingredients inside the vessel, they will be removed from your inventory, but the vessel will not be filled, and Serana will keep telling you to put the ingredients in, causing the quest to be unfinishable.
It is possible to manually advance to the next stage of the quest by opening the console and typing setstage DLC1VQ04 75 .

This can also be caused by multi-follower mods. Typing 'set playerfollowercount to 0' will let the quest continue normally. Once back out of the Soul Cairn set the value back to the number of followers you have.
When asked to speak to Serana after putting the ingredients inside the vessel, speaking to Serana does not advance the quest.
It is possible to manually advance to the next stage of the quest by returning to a previous save before the items were placed into the pedestal and enter the console and typing setstage DLC1VQ04 80.

Dead Thralls cannot enter the Volkihar Courtyard. Entering the Courtyard can cause the thrall(s) to vanish from the game after returning from the Soul Cairn. Kill and leave the bodies of the thrall(s) in a safe place before entering the Courtyard.
When Serana asks for the journal, it might not be removed from your inventory.
It can be dropped or stored once you rescue her mother and return from the Soul Cairn.
You may not be able to enter the Soul Cairn.
Open the console and type set DLC1VQ04SoulTrapped to 1.

It is possible to get stuck in a loop where Serana tries to turn you into a vampire if you had previously elected to become a vampire and then for some reason did not enter the Soul Cairn to advance the quest.

The Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch, version 4.3.6, addresses this issue. The script call that actually performs the bite has been moved from Stage 110 into the dialogue topic itself, which will run whether you'd done this portion before or not.

walkthrough.heading: Easy Money
paragraphs: If you talk to one of the quest givers, they will offer to pay you for chopped firewood. Alternatively, you can also chop the firewood first and then sell the firewood to a quest giver later. You are paid five gold per unit of firewood.

walkthrough.heading: Find a Chopping Block
paragraphs: As a general rule, wood chopping blocks are easily found near the quest givers. Otherwise, they can be found in almost any military camp or Khajiit traders caravan camp, and also at the following locations:

walkthrough.heading: Get Chopping
paragraphs: To chop wood you must have a woodcutter's axe in your inventory (one can usually be found near the wood pile). In addition to standard woodcutter's axes, the Poacher's Axe can be used to chop firewood. Activating a wood chopping block will then cause you to produce firewood at a rate of two units every eight seconds, with a limit of six units per activation. After you have produced six units, you must activate the block again or leave the woodcutting session. You can leave partially through, in which you'll either cut two or four units instead.

It is also possible to have a follower chop firewood for you, even if they don't have an axe. By having someone else do the chopping, you can perform other tasks such as smithing and selling items. By multitasking and restarting their orders every few moments, you can earn several hundred gold on the side while performing bartering.

If a second wood chopping block is nearby, you can chop wood simultaneously to double production while only adding an extra couple of seconds to the equation. This can be done early on in Riverwood by getting Faendal as a follower and then using the two chopping blocks near the mill. Use the command feature to command Faendal from afar and maximize efficiency. After twenty or so minutes of woodcutting, you can earn a few thousand gold at the beginning of the game without gaining any XP.

walkthrough.heading: Achievements
paragraphs: An Achievement is related to chopping wood:
Hard Worker (10 points/Bronze) — Chop wood, mine ore, and cook food
To obtain this achievement you do not need to sell the firewood, or even talk to any of the quest givers. Simply activating the wood chopping block is sufficient.

notes: This quest does not have any stages or objectives.
This quest can be repeated indefinitely.

There is no limit to the amount of firewood you can chop at each wood chopping block and then sell. One (painfully slow) way to get the money to purchase a house is to chop the required amount of wood. For the house in Whiterun, for example, you will get 5000 gold if you accumulate 1000 pieces of firewood. This takes approximately 24 hours of game time when the time scale is set around 10, or 25 minutes in real time. At the standard time scale, it is possible to chop 150 pieces of firewood in 15 real-time minutes, which is a pay rate of 3000 gold per real-time hour.

You can also ask a follower to chop wood for you, by entering command mode and selecting a valid chopping block. The follower does not need to be carrying a woodcutter's axe to perform this. They will begin a single cycle of the chopping animation (3 chops gaining 6 wood) before returning to standing idle. They can continue to chop even when they are overencumbered.

As an augmented way to make money, you can find a location which has two chopping blocks nearby, command your follower to use one, and use the other yourself. This will nearly double your output and allow earning a sizable amount of gold in less time.

Riverwood is the easiest location to do this, as it has two blocks, is accessible immediately at the start of the game, and even provides Faendal as an easy-to-get follower to help you chop wood. Note that the follower will need to be reinstructed to chop wood each time they finish, so there is a bit of micromanagement involved. When your character finishes his/her own chopping cycle, return to the follower and repeat the process.
A less tedious method of earning passive gold is simply telling your follower to chop wood while you are in a city or settlement, checking in every once in a while as you go about your business.

Money you earn from chopping wood is fixed and is not affected by your Speech skill. This makes the quest one of the few ways to make money without increasing any skills, which will help control your level. This is useful when wanting to train in a certain skill as many times as possible. It is also one of the few ways to earn money without doing any questing, merchanting, or crafting.
With the Hearthfire add-on, doing this quest for Aeri, Gilfre, Grosta, Hert, or Hod will increase their disposition such that you'll be able to cut your own lumber for construction purposes.
Because this is a favor quest which affects the quest giver's disposition, it will count towards the "Help the People" part of the thane quest for the quest giver's hold.

Each unit of firewood weighs 5, and a full use of the chopping block gives 6 wood, for a total weight of 30. If you become overencumbered, which will happen rather quickly, you can drop the entire stack of wood and pick it up by holding the "grab" button to be able to run over to the person to whom you wish to sell it.
Swinging the woodcutter's axe at a chopping block won't produce firewood; you must activate the animation sequence.

Firewood samples found in the wilderness can also be used. Despite the abundance of wood piles which use the same model, these standalone samples can be quite rare. Autumnwatch Tower has three firewood scattered over the floors of the tallest tower. Given the sheer weight of the wood and the fact that only a handful of NPCs will buy firewood at-cost, it is probably not worth the effort to grab these scattered pieces, unless you have a follower to bear the burden.
Like other gathering quests, NPCs do not care if the firewood is stolen.

Some objects in the game world look like wood chopping blocks, but aren't. If it lacks one or both piles of wood along the sides of it, it is not a wood chopping block. When scrolling over a usable block, the "Activate" prompt will appear.

Version 1.2.4 of the Unofficial Skyrim Patch adds woodcutter's axes next to the wood piles in Whiterun, Riften, and Windhelm so that being asked to chop wood won't result in you needing to exit the city and travel to a nearby village just to get an axe.
Version 2.1.2 of the Unofficial Skyrim Patch adds woodcutter's axes next to the wood piles in Kynesgrove, Dragon Bridge, Ivarstead, and Half-Moon Mill for essentially the same reason.
Time doesn't stop while chopping wood so magicka, health, and stamina regenerate while using a chopping block.
Chopped wood can be sold to general goods merchants, though at a much lower price than someone on the list above.
