When I confronted Sibbi about it, he threatened to kill me. I was scared so I told my brother Wulfur. He went to talk to Sibbi for me and... and... Sibbi killed him. My brother wasn't even armed! When I heard what Sibbi did, I fled. Now you've found me, and you're going to tell him where I am."

walkthrough.heading: A Choice in Your Hand
paragraphs: Return to Sibbi and tell him you have got some information about Svidi. He will be very glad. "Good, good. Just point me in the right direction and I'll do the rest." At this point, you will have to make a decision: tell him the truth or lie to him.

Whichever option you choose between the first two, Svidi will not be killed, and Sibbi will give you his key to a long chest found in the basement (at the bottom of the stairs) of the Black-Briar Meadery in Riften, saying "You've done me a great service, my friend. Allow me to compensate you for the information." The chest will always contain one random weapon, two poisons, and some gold, along with the Prowler's Profit gems, if applicable. Sibbi's gratitude will also allow you to take any low-value items from the meadery.

stages.text: Objective 10: Discover Svidi's whereabouts
Objective 20 or 30: Tell Sibbi Black-Briar about Lynly or Lie to Sibbi Black-Briar about Lynly

notes: Sibbi's chest is non-respawning, so its contents will be determined on your first visit to the meadery and won't change after that.
Despite the fact that Sibbi says that Lynly Star-Sung has dark hair, her hair is blonde instead.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.3, addresses this issue. Lynly now has black hair to comply with Sibbi's description.
Killing Lynly will fail the quest, despite Sibbi having dialogue afterwards for when you do. This is caused by the defaultsetstagealias script attached to her alias.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.3, fixes this bug.
The game incorrectly runs the speechcraft check against Lynly herself rather than you, making it impossible to pass without the Amulet of Articulation.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.4, fixes this bug.
If you intimidate Lynly, she does not appropriately harbor bitterness towards you due to her disposition values not being lowered.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.4, fixes this bug.

Sometimes when you go to talk to Sibbi after speaking with Lynly, you can't engage in conversation through the bars, even though there is a pointer over his head and he is up close. You might need to pick the lock and go into his cell.

quick: Speak to Romlyn Dreth.
Make your decision:
Turn in Romlyn to Indaryn.
Deliver the keg to Wilhelm in the inn at Ivarstead.

paragraphs: If you snoop around Black-Briar Meadery, you'll discover a memo to employees lying around speaking out about recent thefts. Speak to Romlyn Dreth and you'll find out that he is the source of the problem. He can be found in the lower level of the meadery at roughly after 1pm and The Bee and Barb in the evening. Romlyn has been selling Black-Briar Mead from underneath the meadery at a lower cost. He states that he can no longer get the mead out of Riften and offers to cut you in on the action if you deliver the mead to his customer.

walkthrough.heading: Delivering the Mead
paragraphs: Should you choose to deliver the mead for Romlyn all you need to do is take it to Vilemyr Inn in Ivarstead. The bartender there is named Wilhelm and will thank you for the delivery offering you some leveled jewelry in return. You can speak to Romlyn again to make additional deliveries.

walkthrough.heading: Turning in Romlyn
paragraphs: All you need to do to turn in Romlyn is speak to Indaryn and select the special dialogue option. Indaryn will thank you and give you some leveled gems.

stages.text: Objective 10 or 20: Deliver Mead to Wilhelm or Show Mead to Indaryn

notes: Either choice will make the low-level items in Black-Briar Meadery freely available, including Black-Briar Mead barrels.

If you turn Romlyn in to Indaryn, he will keep working at the meadery and continue to sell his under-the-table Black-Briar Mead, despite saying "A Dreth never forgets a traitor." each time you talk to him.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.4, addresses this issue. Romlyn will be jailed if you turn him in and he will no longer offer to sell you any mead.

quick: Speak to Ingun Black-Briar.
Gather 20 Deathbells, 20 Nirnroot and 20 Nightshade.
Return them to Ingun.

walkthrough.heading: The Black Sheep
paragraphs: Ingun Black-Briar has fallen far from the Black-Briar tree. Instead of learning the family business with her brother, Sibbi, she can be found devising alchemical recipes in Elgrim's Elixirs. The quality of her experiments seem to indicate a dark nature in this well-to-do girl, as she will allude to when speaking to her. Indeed, the ingredients she has depleted from Elgrim's stores are used to make some very powerful poisons.

walkthrough.heading: Helping Out
paragraphs: Whether you speak to Ingun in Elgrim's Elixirs or find her walking through Riften, rouse her from her musings and ask her if she is an alchemist. She will reply: "I'm aspiring to earn that title, yes. However, the road ahead is paved with loose cobbles and deadly pitfalls. Master Elgrim says I'm a natural; that I have a unique talent. But I fear his approval masks his intolerance for my mistakes. My errant formulas have cost Master Elgrim a fortune in ingredients; some of which are almost irreplaceable."

You are a helpful sort, so ask: "What sort of ingredients do you need?" Ingun will tell you: "To restore Master Elgrim's supply I would need 20 deathbell, 20 nightshade and 20 nirnroot. Am I sensing that you may be interested in gathering these rare ingredients for me?" Answer in the affirmative. Ingun will be pleased: "That means more time for my experiments and less time in the field. Much appreciated."

walkthrough.heading: Notable Harvest Locations
paragraphs: Ingun needs you to hunt down 20 Deathbells, 20 Nirnroot, and 20 Nightshade.

walkthrough.heading: Reward
paragraphs: Ingun will reward you with leveled amount of gold (listed in the table below) for each set of ingredients brought to her.

After you have delivered and been paid for all three samples, it will behoove you to see what else you can procure from her. Hint to her: "That was the last of the ingredients." To which she will reply: "Yes, Master Elgrim will be pleased I've restored his stock of these rare ingredients. I feel I owe a bit more than some meaningless coin for all your diligence. Here, this key unlocks my supply chest at Elgrim's Elixirs. Feel free to take what you need from time to time. I'll be refilling it once every few days or so." The chest is found in the back of Elgrim's Elixirs, and she will restock it with 2 - 5 random leveled potions every few days. She will also remind you of this each time you exit conversation with her as she will say: "Don't forget to check to check your supply chest from time to time." The chest will require the key Ingun gave you each time it resets.

stages.text: Objective 10: Find 20 nirnroot for Ingun Black-Briar (<Global=FFR04NirnCount>/20) Objective 20: Find 20 nightshade for Ingun Black-Briar (<Global=FFR04NightshadeCount>/20) Objective 30: Find 20 deathbell for Ingun Black-Briar (<Global=FFR04DeathbellCount>/20)
Objective 40: Speak to Ingun Black-Briar

notes: It is possible to give the items to Ingun Black-Briar then quickly exit out of the conversation and enter the item menu then drop the items. The quest log will show "Find 20 <item name> for Ingun Black-Briar (0/20)". However as soon as Ingun is told "That was the last of the ingredients" the quest will update accordingly.

You can use this quest to earn the Hero of the People achievement quickly as every time you update your personal inventory from fewer than 20 to greater than or equal to 20 of any of the three ingredients, you will receive a quest objective update. You can therefore remain in a container menu and repeatedly shift these items back and forth in order to quickly unlock said achievement.

quick: Speak to Dinya Balu.
Give out 20 The Warmth of Mara missives in Riften.
Return to Dinya Balu.

walkthrough.heading: The Warmth of Mara
paragraphs: Talk to Dinya Balu after The Book of Love quest and you will be able to provide her with some additional assistance. She will tell you "Riften is drowning in a sea of sin and wickedness and it's my personal mission to let everyone know that the warmth of Mara can see them through." Now, she needs a messenger to bring Mara's words to these poor souls by distributing some missives. Then, she will give you twenty The Warmth of Mara bulletins to give out to the citizens of Riften. You will need to hand out all twenty to complete the quest. Before you start the work, you may ask Dinya for some tips on who might accept the bulletins. She will tell you "Almost anyone in Riften is in dire need of those missives." However, it would be wise to keep away from Mistveil Keep and the city guards.

There are a total of thirty-seven people that will accept the missives. You can talk to them "Here, brother/sister. Blessings of Mara upon you." Although their reactions vary widely, they will always accept them.

Return to Dinya and tell her that you've given away all the missives. She will be quite pleased "Oh, splendid! Just splendid! Mara smiles upon us this day." Then, she will reward you with a random potion.

stages.text: Objective 10: Distribute the Warmth of Mara within Riften (<Global=FFRiften05Served>/20)
Objective 20: Return to Dinya

notes: After you've delivered the 20 missives and return to Dinya Balu, you'll be presented with a dialogue option that says you've run out of missives and require more. If you select this option instead of saying you've delivered them all, Dinya will praise your diligence and give you 5 more missives, which can optionally be passed out. When you deliver each of these "extra" missives, the "Completed" quest update notification will reappear, along with the (total/20) count (i.e. 25/20 after you've delivered the last one). However, if you return to Dinya after delivering the extra missives and tell her you've delivered them all, the dialogue and reward will be identical to what you would have received had you not delivered the extra ones. While it doesn't hurt you to do this, there's no actual benefit. Furthermore, you may or may not be given the "extra" option again; some players report seeing this happen while others report that they only got the option once. It appears as though an additional reward may have been intended but was never actually implemented.
From-Deepest-Fathoms is incorrectly referred to as "brother" when handing her a flier.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.3.2, fixes this bug.
After handing over 19 missives, the option to hand over the 20th may not show. The quest is stuck at this point, and the only way to advance is through console.

The 20th missive should still be in your inventory. If you drop it then talk to Dinya, you should be able to ask for extra missives. After this you should be able to deliver the last missive and complete the quest.

Sometimes, you can give a pamphlet to someone you've already given it to. Quitting and reloading seems to trigger it fairly reliably, but that doesn't appear to be the only factor; certain combinations of saving and reloading can also cause the bug without quitting.
Reloading the same save a second time fixes the issue.

quick: Talk to Talen-Jei about his plans to marry.
Find three flawless amethysts he wishes to place on his engagement ring.
Return to Talen-Jei.

walkthrough.heading: A Proper Setting
paragraphs: Upon speaking with Talen-Jei in Riften, he will reveal his affection for Keerava, the innkeeper at The Bee and Barb. He wishes to marry her, but his "meager earnings" haven't allowed him to obtain the gems needed to complete the setting for a proper engagement ring. If you offer to help, he will tell you he needs three flawless amethysts. There are nine guaranteed gems found in eight different locations. Starting at level 12, you may also buy them from merchants at a base cost of 180 gold, find them as random loot, or get them randomly while mining. When you return to Talen-Jei with the gems, he will thank you, and reward you with a random leveled potion.

stages.text: Objective 10: Get 3 flawless amethysts for Talen-Jei (<Global=FFRiften06Found>/3) (re-displayed as each amethyst is acquired or removed)

notes: After this quest and Taking Care of Business, whether you threatened Keerava or not, Talen-Jei's dialogue may become inconsistent, he will call you his friend in greeting, but tell you to 'just get out of here' (The Bee and Barb) when saying goodbye. This is despite his deposition with you being 1 (friend).
You may be able to do this quest even if Keerava is dead.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.5, addresses this issue. It will now be unavailable if she is dead, and will now fail if she dies after it has begun.

quick: Speak to Marise Aravel.
Find five ice wraith teeth.
Return to Marise.

paragraphs: Wander around Riften and you can find Marise Aravel and her food store at the market. She will introduce her food to you with pride: "My food is the best in all of Skyrim; always as fresh as the day it was collected." If you ask her the reason for this, she will tell you she picked up a trick from a butcher in Elinhir, a small town over the border in Hammerfell. Grinding up ice wraith teeth and using it as a preservative is the key to keeping everything fresh. Then she will ask you to bring five of the teeth to her to replenish her supply. If you ask her where to find ice wraiths, she will warn you of potential danger before suggesting that you travel to Ancient's Ascent. She will also add a marker for the location to your map.

You may buy ice wraith teeth from Alchemy shops, most of which have a 21% chance of carrying 1-4 samples. Five samples can be found in the Hall of Attainment or Jorrvaskr Living Quarters and four in the White Hall. If you prefer to hunt some ice wraiths, you may be able to find them in the wilderness of Winterhold. You can find ice wraiths in the following locations, although for Forsaken Cave, the path to High Hrothgar, and Tolvald's Cave it will depend on the Dragonborn's character level whether you find ice wraiths or different creatures:
Ancient's Ascent, recommended location, actually in Bonechill Passage
Forsaken Cave, outside by the entrance and in the natural cave area just inside
The Midden, down the steps, past the skeleton sunk into the floor, in the icy room (does not respawn)
Throat of the World, the path to High Hrothgar
Tolvald's Cave, outside by the entrance and in the first part of the first zone
Weynon Stones, two ice wraiths will ambush you there

Once you have the ice wraith teeth, return to Marise. She will be quite happy: "Perfect, just perfect! These should help keep my stock fresh for quite a while." She will reward you with an apprentice-level Alteration spell tome (either Magelight or Stoneflesh) and five pheasant breasts. The spell tome is selected when you give Marise the ice wraith teeth, so if you save beforehand, you can reload until you get your preference.

stages.text: (Only displayed if you don't already have the teeth) Objective 10: Find 5 Ice Wraith Teeth for Marise (<Global=FFR07TeethCount>/5)

notes: After completing this quest once, you may receive the first quest objective in your journal again. The counter does not increase upon adding ice wraith teeth to your inventory, and the objective is stuck in your quest log permanently.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.1, fixes this bug.
Collect 10 or 15 Ice Wraith Teeth instead so that once you turn in 5, the counter maxes out at 5 again (thus successfully completing the quest).

quick: Speak to Brand-Shei.
Find Lymdrenn Tenvanni's Journal in Wreck of The Pride of Tel Vos.
Take the journal to Brand-Shei.

paragraphs: Brand-Shei is a Dark Elf trader in Riften. He can usually be found at his stall at the market, or in a cell in the Riften Jail if you've helped Brynjolf frame him for theft. As a Dunmer, he has an oddly Argonian name (such as Beem-Ja, Gulum-Ei, Talen-Jei). In fact, he was raised Argonian. "I ended up orphaned then taken in by a kindly Argonian family in Black Marsh." He hopes one day to find out what happened to him and he has got one clue. When he was found by his Argonian father, he was wrapped in a blanket bearing the symbol of House Telvanni, one of the great houses in Morrowind long ago. He'd like you to keep an eye on anything that might provide him with the answers he is looking for in your travels. If you ask him why was he searching in Skyrim, he will tell you something about a matron who had served for House Telvanni and remind you to investigate a ship named "The Pride of Tel Vos".

Travel to the northeast coast of Skyrim and you can find the wreck of The Pride of Tel Vos. A group of three bandits have a camp here. However, you can hide yourself from them easily. You can also choose to wipe them out and take their treasures. In the northern half of the ship at the waterline, you can find a waterlogged chest containing the item you need: Lymdrenn Tenvanni's Journal. This journal would be the key to the answers Brand-Shei is looking for.

Return to Brand-Shei and give the book to him. He will be very excited. "Yes... yes. This is it! I don't know how you found this stranger, but you've obviously succeeded where I had failed." Then he will offer you the key to his strongbox under his stand in the marketplace. You are free to take anything inside, including some gems, potions, and a random novice level Destruction spell tome.

stages.text: Objective 10: Locate a clue about Brand-Shei's past
Objective 20: Return to Brand-Shei

notes: This quest can be completed by finding the journal in the wreck first, then talking to Brand-Shei afterward.
Since the lockbox's contents are leveled, the Prowler's Profit perk will give you more value.
After completion of this quest, some items in Haelga's Bunkhouse will be free to take, as this is Brand-Shei's residence at the start of the game.
Brand-Shei's journal may not appear in the chest, even when the quest marker points to it.
This can be fixed using the console command setstage FreeFormRiften08 30.
If Brand-Shei's still in Jail when player try to give his journal, his dialogue might stuck on "This City is Corrupt, etc.
Try to wait until Brand-Shei's get out from Jail, or
If you using PC, use console to fix this glitch. (1) Prid 19ddc, then (2) Say e829b
Brand-Shei's dialogue topic about the mystery of his birth no longer makes sense after you give him his journal during this quest.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.1.2, addresses this issue. A condition check has been added to make that topic unavailable when this quest is finished.
Although unconfirmed, it's likely that the name of the journal's author, Lymdrenn Tenvanni, is misspelled and should be Telvanni.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.0, fixes this bug.

quick: Speak to Mjoll the Lioness in Riften.
Find Grimsever in the Dwemer ruins of Mzinchaleft.
Return to Mjoll.

walkthrough.heading: Mjoll the Lioness
paragraphs: Mjoll the Lioness lives in Riften where she spends her time speaking out against the Thieves Guild and talking to her faithful follower Aerin about the evils in the world. Acting on her convictions, she has taken on the responsibility of patrolling the town, which she does every day; from 9am she can be found in the Market, at noon she will be inside The Bee and Barb, and from 6pm she patrols the streets of Riften until midnight. Once you reach level 14, however, Mjoll will have more on her mind than just the Thieves Guild. In her younger days, she traveled and adventured all over Tamriel but lost her favorite blade Grimsever when she ventured into the ancient Dwemer ruin of Mzinchaleft. The dangers of the ruin nearly took her life as well, so she retired from adventuring and settled down in Riften. She admits that she feels defenseless without her blade and has a hard time finding a replacement. You can then offer to help her and, while she will refer to it as a 'fool's errand', she will also let you undertake the task, adding a map marker for Mzinchaleft.

walkthrough.heading: Mzinchaleft
paragraphs: Mzinchaleft is a large Dwemer ruin located in the snowy tundra east of Morthal, northwest of the Hall of the Vigilant. Bandits now inhabit the first zones of the ruin and you will encounter up to six of them guarding the entrance. Fight them, locate the door and prepare for a very long dungeon crawl. Once inside, head down the first two slopes and fight the two bandits residing near the campfire. Proceed through the tunnels until you reach a room with two bandits and a cauldron. Dispose of them and claim some minor loot from the chest. At the intersection, kill the bandit and claim Maluril's Room Key from his body, then use it to unlock the gate. During the Dark Brotherhood quest Kill Maluril, the quarters behind the door will be occupied by Maluril but, during this quest you will find them empty. Read through the Speech skill book A Dance in Fire, v7 then backtrack to the intersection and proceed in a southern direction. In the next chamber you will witness two Dwarven spheres dispose of some bandits before coming after you. Fight them all and keep heading south, following the path as it twists and turns, and disposing of the various automatons along the way.

Before long, you will reach an area with a handle and two gates, and several more handles behind the gates. Pull the only available handle and the gate to the east will open. Pull the new handle and the gate to the south will open. Pull the new handle and backtrack to the previous handle and pull it again. Go into a newly opened chamber to the south and pull the handle. Head south yet again and pull the handle, then backtrack to the previous handle and pull it again. Return to the very first handle and pull it. This opens the two gates to the southeast, giving you access to a valve. You'll find an unlocked chest and a master-locked chest in the room with the valve. Activate the valve and the path will now be clear and provide access to the next zone, Mzinchaleft Depths.

walkthrough.heading: The Depths
paragraphs: When the elevator brings you down into the Mzinchaleft Depths, the first thing you will notice is a dead Falmer and the recognizable sound of a chaurus on the other side of the locked door. The door hides a very large multi-leveled chamber filled with Falmer enemies and plenty of secret areas, so make sure to raid every corner before leaving through the door to the east. Two Falmer enemies wait in the next chamber, so dispose of them and proceed forward, into a tunnel-like system with more Falmer. Watch out for a tripwire triggering a claw trap as you enter the next room and fight even more Falmer and a chaurus. The tents contain minor loot and a dead bandit. Find the tunnel to the north and open a gate to another huge chamber with a fountain in the middle. Fight the inevitable Falmer enemies and head up the bridge to the north. At the top, fight another Falmer and locate the button and activate it. This will open the path in the southwestern part of the chamber. More Falmer wait on the other side, including a boss, so finish them off and head up the stairs to the north and the entrance to the third and final zone, Mzinchaleft Gatehouse.

walkthrough.heading: Grimsever
paragraphs: In the Gatehouse, you will only have to go around the corner before you will encounter the Dwarven Centurion that nearly killed Mjoll the Lioness back in the day. It will attack right away and will be accompanied by a Dwarven Sphere. After the battle, locate Grimsever, which is lying on a table. Find the boss-leveled chest behind bars to the north and pull the nearby handle to gain access. Lastly, if you have the attunement sphere, you can gain access to Blackreach from here. When all is said and done, open the western door and activate the handle to be brought back outside, emerging from an alternate entrance west of the main entrance.

Back in Riften you will find Mjoll patrolling as usual. When you hand her the blade, she will be overly impressed: "Astonishing. To think you actually were able to reach it and yet return to tell the tale. Rarely in my travels have I encountered those who possess skills equal to your own. I see I still have much to learn. If you'd permit me, I'd be honored to accompany you in your travels for a time." Alternatively, if you told her of your hopes to join the Thieves Guild, she will instead say: "When you told me of your intent to join the Thieves Guild, I honestly didn't think we'd have much to speak about ever again. Yet here you are with my weapon that you could have easily sold or kept for yourself. Forgive me for my hasty opinion of you, I see that I was wrong and that there's much I can learn from you. If you'd permit me, I'd be honored to accompany you in your travels for a time." Either way, she will then be available as a follower and a potential candidate for marriage.

stages.text: Objective 10: Locate Grimsever
Objective 20: Return to Mjoll

notes: Grimsever cannot currently be found in Mzinchaleft before Grimsever's Return has been triggered. Contrary to older versions of the game, entering or clearing Mzinchaleft beforehand does not cause the sword to spawn. Its usual location will remain empty until the quest has been triggered.
Grimsever is a one-handed Glass Sword though Mjoll is more proficient in two-handed weapons.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.3, addresses this issue. Grimsever is now a Glass Greatsword to match her skills better.

After completing the quest, Mjoll will be available as a follower, at which point you can "trade" inventory with her and take Grimsever back. Any smithing upgrades made to Grimsever before giving it back to Mjoll will be lost, though you can upgrade it again.

If you are already level 14 or above when you first interact with Mjoll, you must also gain another level after your initial conversation and return to her before the dialogue option to begin this quest becomes available.

The boss fight presents a considerable challenge for a level 14 character, but you don't actually have to defeat the Centurion to get Grimsever. You can make a run for it, pick up the sword on the fly and head straight for the exit.
You will need to level up via skill increases to or beyond level 9 for the quest to be eligible to start. You cannot be console-commanded to an arbitrarily high level and start the quest.
If Mzinchaleft has already been discovered or cleared before Grimsever's Return is started, or you exceed the level requirement the quest may fail to trigger, with its aliases remaining empty.

If the quest cannot otherwise be started, it can be bypassed with the console. Use setstage FreeformRiften09 200 to mark the quest as complete, then prid 00019DF7 to select Mjoll and setrelationshiprank 00000014 1 to set her relationship with the player to Friend. Finally, use additem 00053379 1 to give Mjoll a copy of Grimsever. This reproduces the quest's relevant rewards, allowing Mjoll to be recruited or married normally.
Mjoll might not give you the quest to retrieve Grimsever despite fulfilling the above criteria, and Grimsever may not appear in the Mzinchaleft Gatehouse as stated above.

You may use the console to make her your friend with player.setrelationshiprank 00019DF7 4, allowing you to recruit her as a follower. After using her as a follower for a few days, she may give you the quest, and Grimsever should spawn.
You can use the console code player.additem 00053379 1 to give yourself the sword, then talk with her and give it to her. This may result in two copies of Grimsever being present in the game.

An internal conflict with the first scripted conversation between Mjoll and Aerin about "another run-in with the Thieves Guild" upon entering Riften means that you must level up -after- the scripted conversation has occurred (to level 14 or later) before Mjoll will offer the Grimsever quest.

quick: Speak with Balimund.
Gather fire salts.
Return to Balimund.

paragraphs: If you speak to Balimund at his forge in the center of Riften and ask him about how proud he is of his work, he will tell you that the forge is not as good as it used to be. It is supposed to run on fire salts, but they seem to be wearing off. He estimates that he needs ten fire salts to get the forge back to its original strength:
Details on where to find fire salts are provided on the ingredient page.
Once you have ten salts, return to Balimund and receive a leveled amount of gold:

stages.text: Objective 10: Bring 10 fire salts to Balimund (<Global=FFR10SaltCount>/10) (re-displayed as each fire salt is acquired or removed)

notes: Even though Balimund says that "only genuine" fire salts will work, they are not like the bloodgrass for the Vampirism Cure Quest in Oblivion (e.g. where bloodgrass purchased in a shop doesn't count). Instead, fire salts from any combination of sources will work—from flame atronachs, purchased from merchants, stolen, and/or crafted at the Atronach Forge.

Even though the in-game story is that the fire salts make the forge stronger, neither Balimund's merchant inventory nor the things you can craft at his forge receive any upgrade in quality after completing this quest. The amount of money in his store does increase, as if you had invested in his store (if you have already invested in it, or if you invest later, the two effects do not stack).

quick: Talk to Svana Far-Shield in Haelga's Bunkhouse.
Obtain the Marks of Dibella from Bolli, Indaryn, and Hofgrir.
Confront Haelga.
Return to Svana.

walkthrough.heading: A Worshipper
paragraphs: If you visit Haelga's Bunkhouse in Riften, you may see Svana Far-Shield busy doing some cleaning there. The work is difficult and endless, and she prefers to call it slavery. Ever since her parents died and Haelga took her in, it's been a nightmare. She was surprised to learn that Haelga is such a wretched woman. "So now I'm stuck living here while those pigs she calls customers grope me and say the most awful things." In her opinion, Haelga is disgusting and she takes her worship of Dibella a bit too seriously. According to Svana, Haelga slept with three different men in the last month. Svana would like to see her squirm just once. She happens to know that after Haelga makes love, she gives her partner a token of her affection called a Mark of Dibella. If you collect the marks from Bolli, Indaryn, and Hofgrir (All three men are located in Riften), and confront Haelga with them, it would cause her endless embarrassment. Furthermore, Svana asks that you collect the marks without violence.

walkthrough.heading: Three Lovers
paragraphs: In order to get the three Marks of Dibella, you can use your Speech skills to persuade or intimidate the men into giving their marks to you. Alternatively, you can just pickpocket the marks from your targets. If you kill any of the men, the quest will fail immediately.

Bolli can usually be found wandering in the market or working in Riften Fishery. Talk to him about the mark and he will say "I have no idea what you're talking about. I'd never sleep with anyone besides my good wife, Drifa [sic]." You must pass an average-level Speech check to persuade him.

Indaryn can usually be found at the Black-Briar Meadery, but he will visit The Bee and Barb too. If you talk to him about Haelga, he will be a little angry "You're crazy! How dare you make such an accusation!" You must pass an average-level Speech check to persuade him.

Hofgrir is the owner of the Riften Stables and you can find him there easily. If you ask him to give you the mark, he will pretend to be innocent: "Huh? What are you talking about? I don't even know what that is." You must pass a bugged easy-level Speech check to persuade him (see Bugs).

walkthrough.heading: Two Rewards
paragraphs: Once you have all three Marks of Dibella, return to Haelga's Bunkhouse and show them to Haelga. She will be surprised. "What? How... where did you get these?" Obviously, she doesn't want anyone else to know about it, especially Svana. She will give you a magic scroll to keep you quiet. "If word got out that I'm practicing my Dibellan Arts in Riften, they'll run me out of town."

Bring the news to Svana, and she will be quite happy. "Oh I know. Isn't it wonderful? I bet she squirmed like a skeever when you pulled them out of your pocket." She believes things are going to be a lot different around here with your help. Then she will give you a piece of enchanted armor in return. "I want you to have this. It was my father's but I'm certain you'll put it to good use."

stages.text: Objective 10: Obtain a Mark of Dibella from Bolli Objective 20: Obtain a Mark of Dibella from Hofgrir Objective 30: Obtain a Mark of Dibella from Indaryn
Objective 40: Confront Haelga with the Marks of Dibella
Objective 50: Speak to Svana

notes: Blessing of Dibella (+10 Speechcraft for 8 hours) from the shrine in Haelga's bedroom and Gift of Charity (+10 Speechcraft for 1 hour) from giving alms to Edda or Snilf can improve your chance to persuade targets to hand over marks of Dibella.
After you complete this quest, you will be allowed to take low value items from anywhere in Haelga's Bunkhouse (due to your new friendship with Svana), even items found in her boarders' containers.
Svana will not offer the quest if one of the three lovers was already killed before talking to her.

If you have pickpocketed any of the marks of Dibella by accident before receiving the quest, make sure to find all three before attempting to speak to anyone. You will get a notice to confront Haelga in your miscellaneous quest log. You can talk to Haelga and Svana without the requisite dialogue options and then talk to Haelga again. You will get to give the stones to Haelga after all and your quest will complete and a reward given.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.6, fixes this bug.

After acquiring one of the marks before ever picking up the quest, Svana will urge you to find the rest of the marks though you won't see anything in your quest log. However after obtaining all three, a miscellaneous objective to confront Haelga will then appear and the quest can be taken through to completion from that point on with items received from both Haelga and Svana.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.6, fixes this bug.
When asking Bolli about his relationship with Haelga he will remark that he has never slept with any woman other than his wife Drifa. However, Bolli's wife is Nivenor.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.7, fixes this bug.
Hofgrir Horse-Crusher's persuade check is incorrectly flagged to check his Speech level rather than yours.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.1, fixes this bug.
Hofgrir's intimidation check can be used, instead, which always works.
The Persuade option will succeed if the player has the Persuasion perk. Additionally, the effect of having picked the Persuasion perk at any point will be retained even if the Speech skill is reset.

quick: Talk to Wujeeta about her job.
Give her a healing potion.

paragraphs: If you walk near Wujeeta, she will cry about losing her job and beg for help. Talk to her, and she will reveal that she has an addiction to skooma and that she wants to cure herself. She will ask for a healing potion in order to heal herself. If you probe further she will mention where she got the skooma from, "I got mine off of a merchant ship in Solitude", which ties in with another quest.

You have three options: agree to give her a potion, agree to find one for her, or refuse to help. If you refuse to give her a potion, the option remains to agree to give her one. If you agree to give her a potion, the lowest type of standard healing potion (e.g. Potion of Minor Healing) in your inventory will be removed, and she will reward you with a leveled unenchanted ring while thanking you, "Your kindness will never be forgotten".
Dialogue is closed at this point and the first part of the next quest is immediately added to the miscellaneous quests.

stages.text: Objective 10: Give Wujeeta a healing potion

notes: Healing spells do not work and she does not recognize crafted healing potions. She can only take a standard healing potion.

This is the first of three quests that are required to unlock the option to become Thane of the Rift for Laila Law-Giver or Maven Black-Briar. There are additional requirements noted on that quest's page.
Raising Wujeeta's disposition with this quest will allow you to freely take items from the fish barrels inside Riften Fishery and around the nearby fishing boats.

Wujeeta is not essential, and if she dies before this quest and the next are complete, you cannot become Thane of the Rift unless the Imperials take control of the Rift, either through negotiation or force.

quick: Talk to Alessandra.
Deliver Alessandra's dagger to Andurs in Whiterun.
Return to Alessandra.

walkthrough.heading: A Daughter's Path
paragraphs: Alessandra is the priestess of Arkay in Riften. She tends the Hall of the Dead, located beneath the Temple of Mara, by herself. When you speak with her, you will note a certain bitterness about her position: "I didn't ask for this job, I got stuck with it thanks to my father." Her father was a Priest of Arkay and it was his desire that she follow his footsteps. As a result, her entire life has been spent around the dead, learning the proper burial rituals and prayers. While she seems to have accepted her lot in life, albeit reluctantly, she feels the need to make peace with her father. Unfortunately, her father did not live to see his daughter become a priest. Alessandra holds her father's ceremonial dagger as well as the one she received when she did complete the training. She asks you to journey to the Hall of the Dead in Whiterun (see Bugs) to place her ceremonial dagger with her father's remains, fulfilling her honor-bound obligation to him and making peace with his memory. The dagger needs to be delivered to Andurs, the caretaker at the Whiterun Hall of the Dead, who will inter it with her father's remains. If you agree to help her deliver the dagger, she'll appreciate your help and entrust you with it.

walkthrough.heading: The Pilgrimage
paragraphs: Travel to Whiterun and talk to Andurs in the Hall of the Dead. Hand Alessandra's dagger to him and he will be delighted to see she finally decided to return it to her father: "I will make sure this finds its way to his tomb as soon as possible. Thank you for bringing it, my child."

Return to Alessandra and tell her that you have fulfilled her request. She will tell you she felt a caress on her cheek some time ago and she thinks it was a message from her father: "We've made peace with one another without even uttering a single word and I'm content for the first time in my life." She will then thank you for your selfless act, and tell you that you are welcome to come back and speak to her anytime.

The reward for this quest is one of the following five adept Restoration spell tomes: Close Wounds, Greater Ward, Heal Other, Repel Lesser Undead, and Turn Undead, though there are some bugs with the quest reward.

stages.text: Objective 10: Bring Alessandra's Dagger to Andurs in Whiterun
Objective 20: Return to Alessandra

notes: Alessandra says Andurs is in Windhelm, but he is actually in Whiterun.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.6, fixes this bug.

When completing the quest, Alessandra may not give any reward, though her dialogue suggests otherwise: "Here, please accept this as a token of your selfless action." There is a minimum Restoration skill level requirement of 40 before she gives you anything.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.1, fixes this bug.
When given, the reward is every Restoration spell tome in the list, instead of a single random spell tome.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.0, fixes this bug.
You can put Alessandra's dagger in a display case and complete the mission as though you still had the dagger.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.5, fixes this bug.

quick: Speak to Wylandriah.
Retrieve her spoon.
Retrieve her soul gem.
Retrieve her orichalcum ingot.
Return to Wylandriah.

paragraphs: After asking Wylandriah if she needs help she will enlist your aid to help retrieve some items she accidentally left behind while on her travels. She needs these implements to perform an oddly-inspired experiment. All items can be found in unique containers labeled "Wylandriah's Satchel".

walkthrough.heading: Satchel Locations
paragraphs: Wylandriah's items can be acquired in any order. To find the spoon, go to Ivarstead and enter Fellstar Farm's house. Wylandriah's satchel is sitting on a table. To find the soul gem, go to The White Phial in the market in Windhelm. There are two barrels under the staircase; Wylandriah's satchel is on top of the barrel closest to the door. To find the orichalcum ingot, go to The Frozen Hearth in Winterhold right across from the jarl's longhouse. Wylandriah's satchel is on the bookshelf with the elves ear plants next to Nelacar's room. Return to Wylandriah with the items and she will give you several random scrolls as a reward, but will have no recollection of actually setting you on the task.

stages.text: Objective 10: Retrieve Wylandriah's Spoon Objective 20: Retrieve Wylandriah's Ingot Objective 30: Retrieve Wylandriah's Soul Gem
(Wylandriah's Spoon acquired)
(Wylandriah's Ingot acquired)
(Wylandriah's Soul Gem acquired)
Objective 40: Return to Wylandriah

notes: The orichalcum ingot is a special quest version found only in her satchel, but not named like the other two items.

Fellstar Farm is locked during the day, so you may want to enter at night if you don't want to risk getting caught trespassing. Or, if you are trying to maintain a good character, you can wait until the family stops working in the garden. Then, one by one, they will enter the house. The mother is the last one to enter the house. After she enters, the house becomes unlocked, and you can enter the house without trespassing.
If you pick up one of the items before engaging in the quest, Wylandriah may not ask this favor. Finding all three should trigger an update and allow them to be turned in though.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.4, fixes this bug.

Wylandriah's Soul Gem is fillable, and despite being a quest item it can be used to recharge enchanted weapons. Using the gem to recharge enchanted weapons will consume the gem thus making the quest impossible to complete.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.0, addresses this issue. Wylandriah's Soul Gem has been changed to be non-fillable.
In some cases the items will not show up when you search the satchels, making the quest impossible to complete.

quick: Speak to Bolli.
Deliver a purchase agreement to Kleppr in Markarth.

paragraphs: Bolli can generally be found in the market section of Riften. He will gladly tell you of his ownership of Riften Fishery, and is even willing to share something about his business with you:
Travel to Markarth and talk to Kleppr in his inn:
He will give you a silver ingot, plus one or more leveled ingots in return.

stages.text: Objective 10: Deliver the purchase agreement to Kleppr in Markarth

quick: Speak to Harrald in Mistveil Keep.
Retrieve his blade from Balimund.
Return to Harrald.

walkthrough.heading: The Slain Wall
paragraphs: Harrald is the son of Jarl Laila Law-Giver and lives in Mistveil Keep in Riften. Take a look at him and you may find something strange. As the son of the jarl, he has only a dagger. If you ask him, he will tell you why: "I was practicing in the yard when the guard I was sparring with feinted when I specifically told him to duck! My blade bit right into the stonework next to the keep and needed serious repairs." He'd like you to fetch his blade from Balimund.
Talk to Balimund right outside The Scorched Hammer, "a stone's throw" from the keep. He will give the sword to you and comment on Harrald's laziness and carelessness.
Hand over the sword to Harrald and he will be rather ungrateful. "Took your sweet time getting it to me. Here you go, for your trouble." He will then reward you with two leveled gems.

stages.text: Objective 10: Pick up Harrald's Sword from Balimund
Objective 20: Deliver Harrald's Sword

notes: Although this is not a favor quest, it does count towards becoming thane.
After you finsh the quest, Harrald's disposition towards you won't improve.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 4.3.2, fixes this bug.

quick: Speak with Hafjorg.
Obtain an unusual quicksilver ore sample from Filnjar.
Return the ore sample to Hafjorg.

walkthrough.heading: Helping out
paragraphs: Should you find yourself in Elgrim's Elixirs, commiserate with Hafjorg about how much she has to do at the shop. She will tell you that caring for her husband, Elgrim, is holding her back from getting things done; specifically running an errand to Shor's Stone to retrieve an unusual ore sample. Offer to fetch it for her:

walkthrough.heading: Shor's Stone
paragraphs: In Shor's Stone, seek out Filnjar at his home and smithy. Let him know you are there for the ore, and after some derisive comments about Elgrim, he hands over a sample of quicksilver. He explains that he needs Elgrim to examine this particular piece as its discovery coincided with a strange invasion of frostbite spiders in Redbelly mine:

walkthrough.heading: Four Potions
paragraphs: Bring the sample to Hafjorg. She makes a sarcastic comment about her husband's busy schedule, but had him make you four leveled skill potions to compensate you for your travel:

stages.text: Objective 10: Obtain Ore Sample from Filnjar
Objective 20: Return Ore Sample to Hafjorg

notes: The ore sample is a special variety of quicksilver ore; it cannot be used for smelting.
Although Filnjar has apparently been waiting for a courier for some time, the quest can only be started through Hafjorg.
While it is implied that the special ore is in some way related to the appearance of the spiders at the mine, this is never addressed or brought up again in any other quests.
The quest incorrectly sets disposition for Filnjar instead of Hafjorg upon completion. Although Filnjar is also involved, these quests normally only raise the disposition with the quest giver.
The Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch, version 4.1.4, fixes this bug. (details)

quick: Speak to Madesi in his stall in Riften.
Gather one mammoth tusk, one gold ore, and two flawless sapphires.
Return to Madesi.

paragraphs: Speak with Madesi and ask him about his jewelry. You will learn that he is running low on supplies due to heavy bandit presence on the roads and needs help gathering some components. He requires two flawless sapphires, one mammoth tusk, and one piece of gold ore.
Flawless sapphires, like all gems, can be randomly found or mined. One guaranteed sample can be stolen from the shelves in the Inner Sanctum of the Temple of Dibella in Markarth.

Mammoth tusks can be looted from slain mammoths, as well as bought from hunters and certain merchants. Three guaranteed samples can be found in the College of Winterhold's Arcanaeum; eight guaranteed samples can be found in Halted Stream Camp. The closest one is in Black-Briar Meadery, where it can be stolen from the shelves of a cupboard in Indaryn's bedroom.

Gold ore can be found randomly in containers or in buildings, but an easy place to find some gold veins is in Kolskeggr Mine. There's also Lost Prospect Mine; while the latter is closer, it doesn't have as many veins as Kolskeggr Mine. Alternately, one can just use the Transmute spell to turn one Iron Ore into one Gold Ore.

You can return the items to Madesi as you find them, or all at once. He will give you 100 gold for each item returned (i.e., 200 for the two sapphires). Once you've returned them all, ask Madesi if he needs anything else and he will thank you with a leveled necklace.

stages.text: Objective 10: Find 2 flawless sapphires for Madesi (<Global=FFR18GemCount>/2) Objective 20: Find a mammoth tusk for Madesi (<Global=FFR18TuskCount>/1) Objective 30: Find gold ore for Madesi (<Global=FFR18OreCount>/1)
(Brought two flawless sapphires)
(Brought a mammoth tusk)
(Brought a chunk of gold ore)
Objective 40: Speak to Madesi

notes: Completing this quest counts towards your eligibility for becoming Thane of the Rift.

On a purely money-making basis, this quest is a financial loss. Even at the lowest speech level, you can sell flawless sapphires (including to Madesi himself) for more then the quest reward of 100 per sapphire. At higher speech levels, you can sell a mammoth tusk for more than 100 gold. Purchasing the items for this quest will make the money loss even worse.
Madesi will accept stolen goods in fulfillment of this quest, which may be useful if you are trying to avoid dealing with fences or spending a perk point on the fence perk.
You cannot toggle the objective in your journal for individual items; doing so will instead toggle all 3 items at once or the remaining two if you delivered one.

Halted Stream Camp is the location of a bounty quest, possible location of a Dungeon Delving quest from Amren, and possible location of the Amulet of the Moon quest, making it easy to complete multiple quests at once if you choose to find your mammoth tusk there.
There are no quest markers for delivering the items back to Madesi.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.1, fixes this bug.
The quest may continue to prompt the objective to bring Madesi his items if the objective to do so is in your quest journal.
The Unofficial Skyrim Legendary Edition Patch, version 3.0.9, fixes this bug.

quick: Defeat Hofgrir Horse-Crusher in an unarmed brawl.

walkthrough.heading: Meeting Hofgrir
paragraphs: Meet Hofgrir Horse-Crusher at the Riften Stables, just to the north of Riften. Talk to him about the dangers of living outside the walls, which will lead to him boasting about being the strongest brawler in Skyrim. Make a 100 gold bet with him that you can beat him. This brawl is like any other, and the usual rules apply: no weapons, and no offensive magic. Beware, as he is much tougher than most other brawlers.

walkthrough.heading: Claiming your reward
paragraphs: After winning the brawl, talk to Hofgrir and he will give you your 100 gold back, as well as another 100 gold for winning the bet.

stages.text: Objective 10: Defeat Hofgrir in an unarmed brawl

notes: Hofgrir brawls like other NPCs, though the one difference is that he does a lot more damage per hit than other characters. This isn't quite as notable on the lesser difficulties (Novice, Apprentice, Adept), but it is very notable on the higher ones (Expert, Master and especially Legendary). If you are a lower level/health or are wearing clothes instead of armor when doing this quest on those higher difficulties, it would be advisable to heal during the encounter or you'll be swiftly beaten.
Brawling Hofgrir for this quest while wearing the Ebony Mail can inflict the armor's poison damage effect on him, leading to an assault bounty.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.4, fixes this bug.
If you don't have 200 gold when you attempt the brawl the quest may be uncompletable.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.7, fixes this bug.
This can be fixed using setstage FreeformRiften19 200 followed by resetquest FreeformRiften19.

quick: Talk to Wujeeta after completing the Helping Hand quest.
Report to the jarl about the presence of a skooma dealer in town.
"Deal" with Sarthis Idren, and find evidence to locate his sources.
Return to the jarl with the evidence.

walkthrough.heading: Illegal Trade
paragraphs: After completing the Helping Hand quest, you can ask Wujeeta where she obtained her skooma. She is not forthcoming with the details, however you can pass an easy-level Speech check to persuade her to tell you the truth.
At last, she will reveal her supplier as Sarthis Idren and his base as Riften Warehouse. She explains that the warehouse is always locked and that only the jarl has a key.

The next step is to report the presence of a skooma dealer to the jarl. The current jarl in Riften will acknowledge Sarthis and his illegal operations. However, the dealer has informants in the town guard because he disappears every time they raid the warehouse. Perhaps, an outsider may be able to surprise Sarthis in the warehouse, and "'convince' him to close down his operation". If you accept the mission, you will be given the Riften Warehouse Key to unlock the warehouse.

walkthrough.heading: The Raid
paragraphs: The warehouse is located at the southern end of Riften's docks. Orini Dral is patrolling the warehouse, and will immediately spot you. Sarthis is in the basement and will come rushing upstairs to aid his bodyguard. Orini is a modest opponent, but Sarthis can prove a difficult opponent to defeat.

When they are dead, loot Sarthis' body for his key. Descend the stairs in the northeastern corner, turn around and use the key to unlock the door. On the shelves there are five bowls of moon sugar and six bottles of skooma. On the table there is another bowl of moon sugar and two bottles of skooma. Inside Sarthis' satchel there is a note with information regarding Sarthis' sources. Make sure to read the note to advance the quest.

walkthrough.heading: It's Not Over Yet
paragraphs: Return to the jarl with the evidence and news of Sarthis' demise. The jarl will be grateful, saying, "It's nice to receive good news for a change", but will ask you to continue the crusade, which starts the next quest.

stages.text: Objective 10: Identify Riften's skooma dealer
Objective 20: Report Sarthis Idren to the Jarl of Riften
Objective 30: Enter Riften Warehouse
Objective 40: Eliminate Sarthis Idren
Objective 50: Recover skooma source information
(Starts Supply and Demand)

notes: If Wujeeta dies before you report the skooma dealer to the jarl, you will fail the quest, making it impossible to become thane of the Rift regardless of who the jarl is.
If Sarthis is killed by anyone other than you, you will fail the quest. The key and the note can still be obtained, but no relevant dialogue option will be available from the jarl to proceed.
If you manage to sneak past or Calm Orini, you can spare his life. Only Sarthis has to die for the quest to progress.
This is the second of three required quests that are required to unlock the option to become Thane of the Rift. There are additional requirements noted on that quest page.
The penultimate objective, "Recover skooma source information", will only register as completed if you read the note, unlike most other objectives of this type which only require you to take a note.
Despite Laila Law-Giver telling you to deal with Sarthis 'discreetly', stealth is not required to succeed in the quest.
Even though you were given a key by the jarl, and it is occupied by enemies, you will be considered to be trespassing in the warehouse. If you have a follower they will react as such.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.3.2, fixes this bug.
Due to an engine limitation (see this discussion), the player will still incur an increment in their "Trespasses" stat after reading the note.

There is a way to enter without it counting as trespassing. When you open the door, before you enter, immediately open the menu and make a fast travel. You will see that you will still enter the warehouse. Then load the game that was saved by making the fast travel. You will be in front of the door but now it will be open. Turn into a werewolf and access the warehouse. It will no longer count as trespassing.
If your follower insists on reporting you for stealing the note, you will need to exit the warehouse to ask them to wait.
The quest marker may be stuck at "Recover skooma source information" and point to the apothecary's satchel, even after you have killed Sarthis yourself and taken the Shipment's Ready note.
Reading the note should advance the quest as normal.

quick: Travel to Yngvild.
Collect the four journals.
Return to Vekel.

walkthrough.heading: The Proposition
paragraphs: If you approach Vekel in The Ragged Flagon and ask him for work, he will tell you about some journals that he's been after: "I have a buyer with a very odd taste in literature, looking for some particular books. I'm told they're the ravings of a madman, a wizard named Arondil and his peculiar cravings. It's said to be in four volumes and very hard to come by. My client is offering quite a reward for them, which I'd split with you." If you ask for him to elaborate further on the journals, he will go on to say, "Recently, a woman was found... naked and shivering along the road to Dawnstar. The only information the guard could get from her were tales of strange experiments and Arondil scribbling in his journals."

Asking about Arondil won't get you much, as Vekel says, "Only rumors. He used to have a home in Dawnstar until they burned it down. The people say he was doing unspeakable experiments on reanimation... rituals only a necromancer would perform. After he made for Yngvild, he was never heard from again."

Once you agree to retrieve the journals, he will conclude the conversation with: "Then we have a deal. In his later years, Andoril [sic] moved into some ice caves known as Yngvild. He prefered [sic] the solitude in which to perform his, um... experiments."

walkthrough.heading: Yngvild
paragraphs: Yngvild is an ice cave located on an island northeast of Dawnstar. To access it, find the entrance on the north side by following the pathway up the island. Once inside, you are able to find the first three journals. The first journal is located on a table near two Yngvild ghosts and a leveled draugr. The second journal can be found on a table alongside a woodcutter's axe and a scroll. The third journal can be found on a table just before the door leading to Yngvild Throne Room.

walkthrough.heading: Yngvild Throne Room
paragraphs: Once you enter the main chamber in the throne room, you will see Arondil sitting on his throne with an Yngvild ghost alongside him. The fourth and final part of the journal lies through the door behind him, on a table along with an unusual gem for the quest No Stone Unturned. Once you have retrieved the journals, you can exit the cave and head back to The Ragged Flagon to receive your reward.

walkthrough.heading: Reward
paragraphs: Return all four journals to Vekel and he will remark, "Good. I was hoping you hadn't forgotten about it. As promised, here's your payment for bringing them to me. Got it as part of a fair trade from my client." Your reward for returning the journals is a leveled and enchanted one-handed weapon.

stages.text: Objective 10: Enter Yngvild Barrow
Objective 20: Retrieve Arondil's Journals (<Global=FFRiften21JFound>/4)
Objective 30: Return to Vekel

notes: You don't have to kill Arondil to complete the quest, merely get his journals.
This quest can be started even if you're not a member of the Thieves Guild at all.
Sneaking into the final chamber unnoticed and removing the Soul Gem from the pedestal next to Arondil causes the ghosts near him to attack and kill him.
Objectives for this quest will add themselves to the quest log even if you'd never been to see Vekel about finding the books.
This is no longer the case with version 4.2.4 of the Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.
Vekel will neither reward you on completion of the quest, nor take the journals.

The Official Skyrim Patch, version 1.9.26.0.8, addresses this issue. He will now reward you properly, and the journals will no longer be marked as quest items once the quest is complete, and can be dropped or sold.
As stated above, Vekel does not actually remove the journals from your inventory upon quest completion, even with the Official Patch.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.0, fixes this bug.

This quest can be started without talking to Vekel; if you go to Yngvild and pick up all four journals, you will receive a quest update telling you to return them to Vekel, even if you never spoke to him before.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.0, addresses this issue. He has been given appropriate dialogue to acknowledge the fact that he had never given you the task to find the journals prior.

quick: Observe the conversation between Sapphire and Shadr.
Speak with Shadr.
Speak with Sapphire and either pay or persuade her to clear the debt.
Return to Shadr.

walkthrough.heading: Feeling Blue
paragraphs: Upon your initial entry to Riften, a conversation will take place between Sapphire, a member of the Thieves Guild, and Shadr. She is berating him for not paying his debt, to which he replies that he couldn't because his shipment was attacked. Sapphire alludes to the fact that she was behind it, but doesn't forgive his debt and demands that he pay it. She then walks off towards The Bee and Barb. Shadr is usually on the bridge near the north entry gate (either standing or sitting on the bench), and when you talk to him he will explain his situation. You may then offer to assist him.

walkthrough.heading: Dealing with Sapphire
paragraphs: When you speak with Sapphire you have a number of options for rectifying the situation:

walkthrough.heading: Reward
paragraphs: If you were successful in having Sapphire erase the debt, return to Shadr who is grateful and gives you a leveled potion of invisibility. This will also increase Shadr's disposition towards you, meaning that you may be able to take items from the Riften Stables, including borrowing a horse. If you take Sapphire's offer, whether as a Thieves Guild member or the guildmaster, your cut will be a leveled amount of gold.

stages.text: Objective 10: Speak to Sapphire about Shadr's debt
Objective 20: Return to Shadr

notes: Sapphire has speech options, but none of them perform the proper checks to see if you could succeed. This makes persuading her always succeed by default, no matter what level your Speech skill is.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.4, fixes this bug. (details)

In order to successfully intimidate Sapphire into dropping the debt, you need a Speech level which is unattainable by normal means, as the game setting value for intimidation of foolhardy NPCs is out of balance with the other settings.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.1.2, fixes this bug. (details)

Completing this quest will allow you to ride the horses at Riften Stables for free, due to the horses being owned by the stables faction specifically. It is unrealistic that a small favor like this should earn you free access to horses worth 1,000 gold.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.1.2, addresses this issue. (details) The ownership of the horses was changed to just Hofgrir, rather than the faction, preventing this issue.
Sapphire may not talk to you during this quest.

Opening up the console and using the command resetquest freeformriften22 followed by setstage freeformriften22 10 re-enables the quest trigger dialogue with Shadr. Don't simply reject helping him (as it triggers the bug) and just talk to Sapphire as usual and the quest will proceed as normal. If you do want to reject helping Shadr (and forfeit the quest reward), you will need to use stopquest freeformriften22 to get Sapphire to leave the Bee and Barb and move to The Ragged Flagon.
Telling Shadr you won't help him still pays you the reward and counts toward the Thane quest even though it shouldn't.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.5, addresses this issue. A script variable to prevent that from happening was missing and out-of-date.
The quest may not shut down properly if you refuse to help Shadr with his debt.
The Unofficial Skyrim Legendary Edition Patch, version 3.0.1, fixes this bug.

quick: Befriend the Jarl of Riften by dealing with the Skooma trade.
Complete three additional miscellaneous quests in Riften.
Purchase Honeyside.
Return to the Jarl for your reward.

paragraphs: This is an umbrella quest for several other quests that must be completed if you wish to become Thane of the Rift. The Jarl requires you to buy the house in town as well as completing a number of miscellaneous quests. Once this is achieved you can become Thane.

In order to receive this quest you must first aid the current jarl, Laila Law-Giver or Maven Black-Briar, by dealing with the skooma trade in Riften. This involves completing the quests Helping Hand, The Raid, and Supply and Demand.

With Helping Hand and The Raid already completed, you must now complete three more Miscellaneous Quests specifically in Riften (for a total of five); completion of miscellaneous quests in other Rift settlements does not count, they do not have to be Favor quests like in other holds, and miscellaneous quests in Riften that were added by DLC also do not count. Note that many of the quest givers are non-essential NPCs, so their deaths would result in a loss of potential quests to complete. If they die after you assist them, they still count towards your Thane status. Investing in Rift stores does not count for this Thaneship quest either.
You must also purchase Honeyside, which costs at least 5,000 gold (see bugs). Simply purchasing it is enough, there is no requirement to decorate, although it becomes more useful if decorated.

walkthrough.heading: Reward
paragraphs: After completing the necessary quests and purchasing Honeyside, the journal tells you to return to the jarl. The reward, the Blade of the Rift, is a random, leveled, enchanted weapon. Despite its name, it can be nearly any weapon, including a non-bladed weapon like a Mace. There is a 50% chance that it will be one-handed and a 50% chance that it will be two-handed. You will also receive a housecarl named Iona, who will be waiting for you at Honeyside.

stages.text: Objective 10: Speak to the Jarl of Riften
Objective 30: Return to the Jarl of Riften
Objective 20: Purchase Honeyside from Riften's Steward

notes: Unlike every other Thane quest, the "Assist the people of <Hold>" part does not appear in the journal, and must be completed before the Jarl will make you the offer. A new quest "Speak to the Jarl of Riften" will appear under Miscellaneous when you have completed enough miscellaneous objectives.

The quests which gain the favor of the jarl—Helping Hand, The Raid and Supply and Demand—are required tasks to complete before becoming named Thane of the Rift even if the Empire takes Riften, although you will be allowed to buy Honeyside immediately.
The guest bedroom in Honeyside will also be decorated at the end of this quest.
"The Blade of the Rift" is never actually given as a reward: instead, you will receive a generic un-renamed enchanted weapon.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2, fixes this bug.
The reward you receive is generated randomly at the beginning of the game, so will always be iron.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2, fixes this bug.

Visiting Honeyside for the first time before becoming named Thane of Riften may prevent you from ever being able to be named Thane of Riften. After purchasing the house, immediately speak with the Jarl to avoid this bug.
The Official Skyrim Patch, version 1.4, fixes this bug.
It is possible that the dialogue with the Jarl will not start, no matter how many people you've helped.
In the console, enter setstage FreeformRiftenThane 10. The quest should progress normally from there.
Sometimes the "Speak to the Jarl of Riften" step gets stuck in the miscellaneous section of the journal.
In the console, enter setstage FreeformRiftenThane 10, and then setobjectivecompleted FreeformRiftenThane 10 1.
If you have fully completed this quest and the Jarl changes during the civil war, you are unable to become thane again.

quick: (Optional) Learn about the love triangle from the townspeople.
Talk to Sven or Faendal about the love triangle.
(Optional) Talk to the other man involved in the love triangle (Sven if you talked to Faendal first or vice versa).
Give the letter to Camilla Valerius.
Return to the man you decided to help to finish the quest.

walkthrough.heading: The Triangle
paragraphs: When you visit the small town of Riverwood, the local beauty, Camilla Valerius, has sparked the interest of two bachelors in town. The local bard, Sven, and the Wood Elf hunter Faendal, are both vying for Camilla's favor; and will resort to slander and libel to win it.

walkthrough.heading: What a Tangled Web We Weave
paragraphs: If you approach Sven first, at the Sleeping Giant Inn, you will come to know of his love for Camilla, and about his suspicions about Faendal's involvement in her life. Sven will then ask you for a favor: deliver a fake letter supposedly written by Faendal to Camilla, seemingly breaking things off with her due to her being an Imperial, and him a proud Bosmer. You may also speak to Faendal first. He can be found chopping wood near the lumber mill or wandering the village. Faendal also has feelings for Camilla and a desire to see Sven out of the picture. He asks you to deliver his own fake letter designed to disrupt Sven's wooing by outlining out the household chores he has planned for Camilla. With either letter, you can go straight to Camilla, or show the supposed letter to the other man, prompting them to hand over their own forged letter for you to deliver.

walkthrough.heading: When We Practice to Deceive
paragraphs: When you decide who you want to help, either Sven or Faendal, deliver the letter to Camilla. Camilla is usually at the Riverwood Trader, but at night she can sometimes be found at the Sleeping Giant Inn. When you talk to Camilla, you have two ways of proceeding. You can lie to her and give her the forged letter as is, or tell her the truth about the ruse. In either case, she will effectively break off her interactions with the loser. Speak with the winner to collect your reward.

stages.text: Objective 10: Deliver Faendal's letter to Camilla Objective 20: (Optional) Tell Sven about Faendal's letter
Objective 110: Deliver Sven's letter to Camilla
Objective 110: Deliver Sven's letter to Camilla Objective 120: (Optional) Tell Faendal about Sven's letter
Objective 10: Deliver Faendal's letter to Camilla
Objective 210: Talk to Faendal
Objective 220: Talk to Sven
Objective 220: Talk to Sven
Objective 210: Talk to Faendal

notes: It is not possible to complete this quest in a manner that has both Sven and Faendal become available as followers and have their dispositions friendly towards you.

Despite the events of this quest, Camilla is also a marriage candidate for you, and can be married once her disposition is increased, such as by completing the quest The Golden Claw. However, this does not in any way alter the events or dialogue of this quest, and all participants will act as if Camilla is still available. If Camilla relocates to one of your houses, and you helped one man win her over, his programming will still have him seek her out even at your house.
If this quest is still running when marrying Camilla, it is still possible to finish it by delivering the letter on behalf of one or the other even though this scene no longer makes sense to allow.
The Unofficial Skyrim Legendary Edition Patch, version 3.0.1, addresses this issue. Marrying Camilla while the quest is still active will now cause it to fail.
Orgnar may still mention the love triangle after the quest is finished.
The Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch, version 4.2.6, fixes this bug.

quick: Speak to Rogatus Salvius at Salvius Farm.
Agree to take a letter to his son.
Deliver Rogatus's Letter to Leontius Salvius at Old Hroldan Inn.

walkthrough.heading: Just Another Day on the Farm
paragraphs: Salvius Farmhouse is just to the east of Markarth Stables as you approach Markarth. The farm is tended by Rogatus Salvius and his wife Vigdis, and Salvius will be outside during most of the daylight hours. Speaking to him will reveal a caustic nature and a long list of complaints. At the moment, he is upset at his son who works at the Old Hroldan Inn and never visits. He'll ask you to do him a favor by delivering a letter admonishing his son for his familial neglect.

walkthrough.heading: Some Things Never Change
paragraphs: Old Hroldan Inn is across the hold, almost directly east of Markarth. Traveling along the road will take you near a few Forsworn encampments, but should be relatively safe. It can also be approached by traveling over the mountains to the west of Rorikstead. Leontius Salvius is typically outside chopping wood or on the porch during the day. He can be found inside the inn at night. He'll thank you for the letter, wistfully reproaching the content, and pay you twenty-five gold for delivering the letter.

stages.text: Objective 10: Deliver Rogatus's letter to Leonitus [sic]

notes: This quest is nearly identical to Delivery radiant quests, but is not included in their radiant scheme.
Rogatus may not have any dialogue when you try to return his letter.
Try the usual methods, such as restarting, resetting, cache clearing, and resting. Coming back after doing other things may work as well.
If pickpocketed back from Leontius, the letter will still be marked as a quest item and can't be dropped.
Typing player.removeitem 000931c2 1 into the console will remove it from the player's inventory.

quick: Speak to Avrusa Sarethi.
Collect 20 Jazbay Grapes.
Return to Avrusa Sarethi.

paragraphs: Avrusa Sarethi needs a large amount of jazbay grapes in order to cultivate nirnroots. She's running low and unable to search out the ingredient herself, as she is preoccupied with her energetic sister and farm chores. She asks you to hunt down twenty grapes for her current nirnroot crop. As Avrusa notes, jazbay grapes are somewhat hard to come by. The plants are indigenous to the volcanic tundra region of Eastmarch, and while desolate, the tundra is fairly easy to traverse with a few lesser animals and non-hostile giants.
There are a few locations where it can be found in greater quantities than usual. Along with the quantities available, they are:
49 around Steamcrag Camp (Eastmarch)
47 around Witchmist Grove (Eastmarch)
35 around Eldergleam Sanctuary (Eastmarch)
33 around the Atronach Stone (Eastmarch)
31 around Bonestrewn Crest (Eastmarch)
26 around Kynesgrove (Eastmarch), especially along the road heading southeast
25 around Mistwatch (Eastmarch)
24 around Broken Limb Camp (Eastmarch)
23 around Cronvangr Cave (Eastmarch)
22 around Riverside Shack (Eastmarch)

Once you have collected twenty samples, head back to Avrusa who will thank you for your aid and reward you with five random potions. You can return to Sarethi Farm periodically to harvest Nirnroot and Crimson Nirnroot.

stages.text: Objective 10: Find 20 Jazbay (<Global=FFSarethi01JazCount>/20) (re-displayed as each jazbay grape is acquired or removed)
Objective 20: Bring the Jazbay to Avrusa Sarethi

notes: This quest may leave behind the objective to collect the jazbay grapes due to calling the objective completion before the final item swap is done.
The Unofficial Skyrim Legendary Edition Patch, version 3.0.1, fixes this bug.

quick: Speak to Captain Wayfinder on his ship at the dock in Dawnstar.
Retrieve the salts from the given location.
Return to Captain Wayfinder and receive your reward.

walkthrough.heading: Captain Wayfinder
paragraphs: In central Dawnstar, you will find the ship The Sea Squall permanently docked, with inexperienced sailor Captain Wayfinder and his team of disrespectful crewmembers wandering around on deck. Talk to Wayfinder and ask him about the ship and he will provide a bit of background information on his questionable status as captain. He will also hint at problems with his latest shipment, some fine-cut void salts from the College of Winterhold that have gone missing. When asked what happened to the salts he will reveal: "Sailors are what happened to them. They got drunk and ended up losing the merchandise in some cave. If you're not afraid of little exploring, I'll pay good gold to get those salts."

walkthrough.heading: Find the Salts
paragraphs: At this point, it is no longer possible to reject the favor and a map marker will point towards one of eight radiant locations.
Possible locations: Brood Cavern • Clearspring Tarn • Forsaken Cave • Harmugstahl • Hillgrund's Tomb • Rebel's Cairn • Swindler's Den • Yngvild
Travel to the selected location and locate the fine-cut void salts in the boss-leveled chest, then head back to Dawnstar and the Sea Squall.

When you hand him the salts, a grateful Captain Wayfinder will hand you a leveled amount of gold, with his thanks: "That's the first bit of good news I've had since I set sail a year ago. Here's your cut."

stages.text: Objective 10: Find the Fine-Cut Void Salts for Wayfinder
Objective 15: Bring the Fine-Cut Void Salts to Wayfinder

notes: In the Prima Official Game Guide, this quest is referred to as Salt of the Seas.
The fine-cut void salts that you are asked to find are actually just regular void salts, except it is a unique sample of the salts that have been given a different name.

All eight samples of fine-cut void salts spawn in the possible locations when you first visit Dawnstar. Finding them will not start the quest and only the sample indicated after speaking to Wayfinder will function as a quest item and net you the reward.

If the game decides to send you to a location where you already found the salts, and you still have the original sample in your inventory, a new sample will spawn at the location, but you will miss out on the map marker.
If you find any of the samples before starting the quest, the fine-cut version can be consumed like normal void salts.
Trying to consume the salts selected for the quest results in the rather rare error message "You cannot eat quest items."

The fine-cut void salts may stay in your inventory after receiving the payment and finishing the quest. This often happens if you have regular void salts in your inventory (or if you carry another sample of the fine-cut version) when you return to Captain Wayfinder. They are no longer a quest item.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2, fixes this bug.
It's possible to run across a second batch of fine-cut void salts in another location. If you've already completed the quest, you can turn them in again for another reward.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.0, fixes this bug.

If you find a sample of Fine-Cut Void Salts prior to obtaining the quest, it will automatically put the quest in your Miscellaneous log. If you then speak to Captain Wayfinder and pick any topic other than, "I have the Fine-Cut Void Salts", he will finish his dialogue and then never speak to you again, making it impossible to finish the quest. This can sometimes be fixed by using the console command setstage freeformshipsDawnstar 20. When it works, this ends the quest and removes the fine-cut void salts from your inventory.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.9, fixes this bug.

quick: Speak to Kjar onboard his ship at the Windhelm docks.
Travel to the random location and kill the bandit leader.
Return to Kjar for your reward.

paragraphs: Kjar, ship master of The North Wind currently anchored at the docks in Windhelm, will ask you to hunt down and kill a runaway crew member. The sailor had formed a group of bandits, who are currently hiding out in one of seven random locations. Travel to the location and kill the bandit leader there. Return to Kjar, who will give you a year's salary (a leveled gold reward).
