Guard: "Look, you've already been told you're not allowed here. Turn around and go back the way you came." Alik'r: "We're causing no trouble. All we ask is to look for her." Guard: "I don't care what you're doing, after what happened you're lucky I don't toss you in jail. Now get lost." Alik'r: "We will be back. This is not over."

One of the warriors will then approach you, tell you that they're looking for a Redguard woman who may be in Whiterun. He will also tell you that since they're not welcome in Whiterun, they'll be in Rorikstead.

walkthrough.heading: Finding the Missing Woman
paragraphs: Go to The Bannered Mare. The Redguard is a woman named Saadia. There will be a new dialogue option to tell her that some Alik'r warriors are looking for a Redguard woman. She will ask to speak to you privately. Follow her upstairs to her room, where she will draw her dagger on you, being suspicious of you - however, she quickly calms down. She explains that her real name is Iman, and that she is a noble of House Suda in Hammerfell. According to her, the Alik'r are assassins sent by the Aldmeri Dominion to deport her back to Hammerfell for an execution, as she spoke out against the Aldmeri Dominion. She asks you to help her get rid of the threat, and points you to the Dragonsreach Dungeon where one of the Alik'r warriors were captured.
It is up to you to pass judgment and choose who to help during the quest. At this point, you can make a choice:
Speak to the Alik'r warriors in Rorikstead and tell them of Saadia's location.
Follow Saadia's instructions in order to help her.
There are other alternative routes (see below) that allow you to reap even greater rewards.

walkthrough.heading: Defend a Helpless Dissident...
paragraphs: If you decide to help Saadia, go into the dungeon of Dragonsreach and speak with an Alik'r Warrior that was captured. Talking to him reveals that he was caught sneaking into Whiterun and was captured. As a result, the other Alik'r have abandoned him, and he agrees to tell you where Kematu and the other Alik'r are hiding on the condition that you pay his fine of 100 gold.
Talking to him again before paying his fine will allow you to say the following - however this may cause a bug (see bugs):

The same dialogue will occur after you pay his fine, but there will be an option to tell him you have paid his fine. However, talking to him a second time before paying his fine may cause a bug (see bugs).

You will have to bribe the guard to set him free. Picking a guard's pocket (or murdering a guard in the jail) for the key to Whiterun's jail cells will unlock his cell - however, he will fail to register this, and insist that you bribe a guard. When you do, the guard will say "Done. Convince him to stay out of the city while you're at it." After paying 100 gold to a guard, the prisoner will tell you that the leader of the Alik'r is in a cave west of Whiterun called Swindler's Den.
If you hang around the Dragonsreach dungeon after the prisoner gives you the information, he will tell one of the guards that his fine has been paid, but the guard won't take him seriously.

Prisoner: "Guard! My fine's been paid, now set me free!" Guard: "Sorry, my ears aren't so good. You say somethin'?" Prisoner: "I said my fine has been paid! Now let me out!" Guard: "Right, right... Oh, look at that. I seem to have lost my keys. Might take me a while to find them. You just sit tight. I'll get around to it eventually." Prisoner: "Curse you!"

If you have already cleared out Swindler's Den, a new dialogue option will appear when speaking with Saadia, revealing to her that you already know where the Alik'r are and allowing you to skip this part of the quest.

walkthrough.heading: Swindler's Den
paragraphs: Upon reaching Swindler's Den, you will find that it's full of bandits. Two bandits in the first room will discuss the Alik'r warriors hiding in the treasure room.

Bandit 1: "I'm not sure I like these Alik'r warriors hiding out here. They seem like trouble." Bandit 2: "Keep it to yourself. They're not paying us to talk. They'll be gone as soon as they've found whoever they're looking for. And we'll have all the more coin."
Make your way through the network of tunnels until you reach a passage flooded with water with a waterfall at the end. When you approach the waterfall, the Alik'r leader Kematu will say:
If you run past the waterfall when Kematu tells you avoid any more bloodshed, he will say this when you approach him:

As soon as you walk through the waterfall, Kematu should initiate conversation. If he doesn't, you can approach Kematu and talk to him manually. He explains that unlike what Saadia suggested, the Alik'r are not assassins. He claims that Saadia is wanted by the noble houses of Hammerfell for treason, for selling the city of Taneth out to the Aldmeri Dominion during the Great War. He asks you to help him bring her to justice, by leading her to the Whiterun Stables under the pretense that the Alik'r are coming for her, where he will be waiting to take her into custody.

If you still wish to help Saadia, telling Kematu at any point during the dialogue that you still intend to kill him will cause Kematu and his men to become hostile after telling you that he had hoped you would see reason.

Fighting the host of Alik'r warriors can be made easier by using the bear traps at the mouth of the winding path that leads into the cave where Kematu awaits. The warriors get hung up in the path, allowing the traps to be reset. Success is facilitated by focusing on your high-offense attack while retreating. Once your stamina or magic is depleted, turn and run for the traps, being careful to jump over them as you pass. It is also possible to simply exit the conversation with Kematu (or tell him that you will help lure Saadia away), sneak into the room just ahead, and snipe all the warriors with your bow.
Once the Alik'r are dead, loot Kematu's corpse for scimitars and bonus gold, then return to Saadia in the Bannered Mare for your reward.

walkthrough.heading: ...Or Bring a Traitor to Justice
paragraphs: If you decide to help the Alik'r capture Saadia, Kematu or the Redguards with whom you spoke in Rorikstead will ask you to lure her to the stables outside of Whiterun. Go back and talk to Saadia in The Bannered Mare, where you can lie to her, telling her that the Alik'r are coming for her, and that a horse is waiting for her at the Whiterun Stables. Once Saadia gets to the stables, she and Kematu will have a brief exchange before Kematu will use a paralysis spell on her. Talk to him for your reward.

Kematu: "We meet at last, my dear lady." Saadia: "What is this? What have you done?" Kematu: "Oh, come now. You didn't really expect to manipulate people forever, did you? Your luck had to run out sometime."

walkthrough.heading: Alternative Routes
paragraphs: While Kematu and Saadia are talking at the stables, you can still kill Kematu before he casts the spell on Saadia. This will get you the reward from Saadia and the 100 gold that Kematu is carrying, without having to fight the rest of the Alik'r. Saadia will be annoyed that you didn't warn her of what you were going to do, but she will thank you nonetheless.

Alternatively, allow Kematu to cast the spell on Saadia and collect the 500 gold reward, thus ending the quest, then kill Kematu to undo the spell on Saadia. At this point, Saadia will be hostile right away, so use a Calm spell on her, then talk to her, and she will give you the 500 gold reward for killing Kematu. You can then loot Kematu's body to get 100 gold, Hammerfell Garb and Redguard Boots, and two scimitars. Once the Calm spell ends, Saadia will become hostile again - this is a permanent state, so even if you leave the area, she will attack the next time you meet her. This is not a problem, as Saadia is not essential, and killing her will not give you a bounty. Looting her will give you gold and jewels. Both characters will be dead, but you will have gained 1100 gold, as well as random jewels, scimitars, and their clothing.

stages.text: A group of men calling themselves the Alik'r are looking for a Redguard woman in Whiterun. Objective 10: Find the Redguard woman
Objective 20 or 21: Speak with Saadia or Inform the Alik'r of Saadia's location

The barmaid at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun is apparently a fugitive noble from Hammerfell. She claims that she is on the run from assassins sent by rival houses in her homeland and needs someone to stop them before they find her. Objective 25 or 26: Talk to the Alik'r Prisoner or Inform the Alik'r of Saadia's location
Objective 50: Find a way to enter the Alik'r hideout
Objective 75: Enter the Alik'r hideout
Objective 100: Kill Kematu
Objective 101: Kill Kematu or talk to him
Objective 125: Kill Kematu OR Convince Saadia to meet Kematu
Objective 100: Kill Kematu
Objective 100: Kill Kematu
Objective 160: Return to Saadia

The leader of the so-called "assassins" I've been asked to eliminate claims that Saadia betrayed her people to the Dominion and they are here to bring her to justice. I've agreed to lead her into an ambush at the Whiterun stables. Objective 175: Lead Saadia to the Whiterun Stables
setstage MS08
Objective 199: Speak with Saadia
I've helped Saadia escape the clutches of the Alik'r sent after her. With their leader defeated, she believes the rest of them will scatter, affording her some much-needed safety for now.
After making arrangements with Kematu, I've delivered Saadia to him. He assures me that she will be taken back to Hammerfell alive, though after that her fate is no longer in his hands.

notes: The Prima Official Game Guide refers to the band of Alik'r warriors as the "Alik'r Coterie".

The Alik'r prisoner will never actually be set free, even if you pay his fine. If you retrieve the key, either by stealing it from a guard or killing one for it, unlocking the prisoner's cell does not result in anything noteworthy. He will just act as if jailed normally.
According to the game scripts, Saadia was meant to follow until you reach Whiterun Stables but for some reason the AI package was put as escort.

It is entirely possible to kill Saadia, as she is not essential. If you do so, her urn will show up in Whiterun's Hall of the Dead. However, if you merely turn her over to Kematu, there will be no urn in the Hall of the Dead, as the quest's script 'disables' her rather than killing her.
Killing Kematu or his guards before starting the quest will count as murder.
If you do not directly kill Kematu (i.e., Frenzy or Fury on him or the Alik'r), the quest will be stuck on "Kill or talk to Kematu". See Quest Stages and skip to step 160 to progress the quest.
The Official Skyrim Patch fixes this bug.
If you kill the Alik'r warriors in the Swindler's Den, two Alik'r warriors will sometimes end up constantly appearing in Whiterun by the entrance.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.1, fixes this bug.
If you kill the Alik'r warriors in the Swindler's Den, encounters where Alik'r warriors harass a Redguard woman may still occur.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.1, fixes this bug.
After you hand Saadia to Kematu, sometimes Kematu and the Alik'r keep staying in Swindler's Den. No more conversation options are possible and the dungeon cannot be cleared.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch fixes this bug.
Entering SetLocationCleared 00018EE2 1 into the console also resets the dungeon.
The cell where the Alik'r Warrior gets sent to cannot be unlocked.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.4, addresses this issue. The door will now open with the Whiterun Jail Key like all the others.
It is possible for NPCs who aren't guards to run the scene when talking to the Alik'r prisoner due to poor conditions on the alias check.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.1.2, fixes this bug.
Entering Swindler's Den without talking to the Alik'r Prisoner may result in the objective to talk to the prisoner never being removed from your journal.
The Unofficial Skyrim Legendary Edition Patch, version 3.0.10, fixes this bug.
Entering setpqv MS08 DungeonFound_var 0 into the console before talking to Saadia also clears the objective correctly.

If you speak to Kematu you'll be offered a topic that prompts "Why are you after Saadia?". This option is incorrectly assigned to him when it was instead meant to be assigned to the 2 Alik'r Warriors you initially meet if you tell them you know where to find Saadia.
The Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch, version 4.3.2, fixes this bug.

If you choose to betray Kematu after escorting Saadia to the stables, the quest log may fail to register "Speak with Saadia" as complete no matter if you talk to her soon after defeating Kematu or once she is back to The Bannered Mare, although the game will consider the quest as finished.

Using the alternative route mentioned above, sometimes killing Kematu after he casts the paralyze spell on Saadia will not cause her to turn hostile but will still allow you to report that the Alik'r have been taken care of, hence getting both rewards.

Sometimes if you enter conversation with the jailed Alik'r warrior a second time before speaking to the guards to pay his fine, his next dialogue option will come up early. Despite entering the new line of conversation, he will not give you the required information and your quest will not update. Paying his fine will not progress the dialogue further at this point.
You can reload a save to fix this, or bypass this step and go to Swindler's Den directly.

quick: Read the Steward's Note.
Take the ledger copy at Arcadia's Cauldron.
Read the Business Ledger Copy.
Investigate the Hall of the Dead.
Check the stables.
Investigate the Silent Moons Camp.
Find the Assassin on the upper floor of Dragonsreach when the Jarl is unoccupied.
Retrieve the Bow of Shadows.
Speak to the Jarl's Steward.

walkthrough.heading: An Assassination Plot
paragraphs: Talk to the current steward of Whiterun (typically either Proventus Avenicci or Brill) and ask if he has anything for you. He will hand you a note, explaining that he is concerned of an assassination plot on the Jarl of Whiterun from an anonymous informer. He dare not tell it to you out loud due to the Jarl already having plenty on his plate, as well as the fact that he is unsure of its credibility.
The steward would like you to visit Arcadia's Cauldron and look through their business ledger to spot any suspicious purchases; to this end he has asked Arcadia to leave you a copy to peruse.

walkthrough.heading: Suspicious Purchases
paragraphs: Head to Arcadia's Cauldron and you will find the business ledger on the counter. Unlike the typical business ledgers, this one you can pick up; do so and look through it to find that two people - a Priest of Arkay and a Nord Stable Boy - have made purchases of poisons. Time to investigate and look at their motives for doing so.

walkthrough.heading: The Hall of the Dead
paragraphs: Enter the Hall of the Dead and then the Whiterun Catacombs; note that if you have not entered this location before there will be hostile skeletons in this area - either kill or avoid them. Once you enter, descend down the flight of stairs to your left and you will find a dead skeever, a block of cheese, the poison in question and a note, explaining that the poison had been applied to the cheese in an attempt to rid the place of the skeever infestation.

walkthrough.heading: Whiterun Stables
paragraphs: Exit Whiterun proper and down the path to the stables, where you will find a dead Nord behind a haystack of the leftmost stall. Beside him will be a lunar steel weapon. Loot the Nord and find upon him a note as well as a spell tome of Detect Life; like before, read the note and find that the Nord has been posing as a stable boy. The note also states that he was supposed to meet a Dark Elf at this location instead of at Silent Moons Camp and the spell tome was to help the Nord in locating him as the Dark Elf snuck up on him the last time, though he was apparently unable to get the spell working.

walkthrough.heading: Off to Silent Moons Camp
paragraphs: Now that you have your next destination, make your way to Silent Moons Camp. Your objective is at the very back, so if you are so inclined you may opt to go around and hop over the wall, but whichever way you choose, a journal of an assassin will be lying on a table just outside the room containing the Lunar Forge. Again, pick it up and read it, finding largely ramblings but an important detail: the author of this book shall be waiting on the second floor of Dragonsreach, waiting for an opportune time to strike and kill the Jarl.

walkthrough.heading: Back Where We Started
paragraphs: Return to Dragonsreach and head up the stairs on the right of the main hall to the second floor, then turn around and make your way out onto the balcony. The area looks clear, but once you reach the end you will find the Dark Elf assassin in question, who had been hiding under a cloak of invisibility; at this point he will become hostile and attack you. (You may also cast Detect Life to locate him if you have learned it from the spell tome you should have obtained earlier, however as he will cease to be invisible once you get close it is not necessary.) He is quite decently armed and can pose a fatal threat if you're of lower level, but luckily you have allies who will help if you lure him downstairs.
Note: Rather uniquely, the assassin is marked as protected, which means he cannot be killed by other NPCs and the killing blow must be dealt by the player.

The assassin will not appear if the Jarl is occupied, and will not appear if you haven't started the quest Bleak Falls Barrow. The Jarl is considered occupied when the following quest stages are active:
Bleak Falls Barrow - Stage 10: When Jarl Balgruuf is showing you to Farengar.
Dragon Rising - Stages 10, 12, 13, 15, 20, 110, 120, 130, 150: During the scenes inside Dragonsreach at the beginning of the quest and after the Greybeards summon you to High Hrothgar.
The Fallen - Stages 25, 27 - When persuading the Jarl about to trap Odahviing in Dragonsreach.
At any point during Battle for Whiterun, Battle for Solitude, or Battle for Windhelm.
Once the assassin is dead, loot his corpse and find the Bow of Shadows. Speak to the steward again and gain a monetary reward.

stages.text: With the death of King Torygg, it seems not even the Jarls are safe in Skyrim, and security comes at a premium. Given the need for capable warriors, I should speak with the steward and see if he has any work for me. Objective 10: Speak to the Jarl's Steward
In Whiterun, I spoke to the Jarl's steward and asked him if he had any work. He handed me a note with details on a job. Objective 20: Read the Steward's Note

In Whiterun, I spoke to the Jarl's steward and asked him if he had any work. He handed me a note with details on a job. Reading the note, it seems there may be a potential assassination plot against the Jarl. The steward wants me to visit the local alchemist and check if anyone has purchased any poisons. Objective 30: Take the ledger copy at Arcadia's Cauldron

It seems there may be a potential assassination plot against the Jarl. At the steward's direction, I visited a local alchemist and took a copy of her ledger. I should read it to see if anyone has recently purchased any poisons. Objective 40: Read the Business Ledger Copy

It seems there may be a potential assassination plot against the Jarl. At the steward's direction, I visited a local alchemist and took a copy of her ledger. I read it and found two people had purchased poisons. A priest at the Hall of the Dead, and a stable boy. Objective 50: Investigate the Hall of the Dead Objective 60: Check the stables
Objective 70: Investigate the Silent Moons Camp

At the Silent Moons Camp, I discovered a journal from an assassin who intends on killing the Jarl of Whiterun. He intends to take the shot from somewhere unoccupied, using the Bow of Shadows to conceal himself. It's likely he will only appear when the Jarl is not tending to any other business. I should find him and take him out before he can carry through with the plot. Objective 80: Find the Assassin on the upper floor of Dragonsreach when the Jarl is unoccupied

At the Silent Moons Camp, I discovered a journal from an assassin who intends on killing the Jarl of Whiterun. After following his trail, I found him in Dragonsreach and eliminated him. Objective 90: Retrieve the Bow of Shadows

At the Silent Moons Camp, I discovered a journal from an assassin who intends on killing the Jarl of Whiterun. After following his trail, I found him in Dragonsreach and eliminated him, taking the Bow of Shadows for myself. Objective 100: Speak to the Jarl's Steward

At the Silent Moons Camp, I discovered a journal from an assassin who intends on killing the Jarl of Whiterun. After following his trail, I found him in Dragonsreach and eliminated him, taking the Bow of Shadows for myself. I then returned to the steward and received my reward.

notes: The foray into Silent Moons Camp is a chance to pick up the six Lunar Iron/Steel weapon variants.
The deceased Nord in the Stable carries the Detect Life spell tome which is a good chance to pick it up early on. Detect Life can help level Alteration quickly and is otherwise hard to obtain.
If you finish Bleak Falls Barrow, Dragon Rising, The Fallen, Battle for Whiterun, Battle for Solitude or Battle for Windhelm and the Jarl is not occupied, the assassin does not appear.

This can be resolved using console commands to manually advance the quest. Using: prid FExxx82F, kill, setstage ccBGSSSE038_Quest 80, openactorcontainer 1 This will kill the Assassin, update the quest so that he is dead, and allow the player to loot his inventory to take the Bow, which advances the quest once more so that you can talk to the Steward and collect the reward, ending the quest. You can use player.additem FExxx807 1 to get the Bow of Shadows

Alternatively, using the console command prid FExxx82f and then enable or placeatme FExxx808 may allow the assassin to spawn in correctly, letting the player kill them normally and finish the quest as intended.

quick: Talk to Stalleo outside Treva's Watch.
Enter Treva's Watch through the secret tunnel.
Open the Treva's Watch main gate.
Talk to Stalleo.

walkthrough.heading: Stalleo
paragraphs: You will find Stalleo next to a campfire along the narrow dirt road just outside of Treva's Watch. Mistaking you for a mercenary, he will tell you that invaders kidnapped his family and took possession of the fort while he and his bodyguards were away fighting in the war. He will tell you that his family is inside, and ask you to use a nearby secret tunnel (Treva's Watch Escape Tunnel; the "back door" in your journal) to access the fort, fight your way through, and then use a lever from inside to open the front gate for him.

walkthrough.heading: The Back Door/Secret Tunnel
paragraphs: Enter the nearby tunnel indicated by your objective marker. Inside, and around the first corner, three bandits stand at the top of some steps. Shooting down the lamp above them will cause an explosion. A fourth bandit lurks in the adjoining room. You will also find some chests and soul gems there.

There is a bear trap on the floor in the next hallway. Follow the hallway and ascend the stairs to find a bandit working at an anvil in the room straight ahead of you. He is facing away, facilitating a sneak attack.
Through an open doorway is a small storage room containing the corpses of two Nords and an Imperial. It is possible that this is Stalleo's family, but they are not identified as such.

walkthrough.heading: Treva's Watch
paragraphs: Enter through the door into Treva's Watch. Two bear traps lie on the floor just around the turn. Ahead, you will hear two bandits conversing at the top of a stairway. Dispatch them and climb the stairs to find a short ramp ahead leading up to a somewhat crooked hallway. There are two bandits in a bedroom fairly near and to the right. Use caution when engaging these bandits, as the noise from this battle can alert 1-4 other bandits in nearby rooms, including a Bandit Chief and a powerful spellcaster. One way to try to avoid this is to provoke the initial two bandits, then immediately run back in the direction that you came, letting them chase you to fight out of earshot of their allies.
In the bedroom, you can find a few potions, including a Potion of Brief Invisibility. Directly across the hall from this, behind a locked door, is a small treasure room.

At the end of the hallway, turn right. If you have not already killed the Bandit Chief, he or she will be sitting at a desk in the bedroom up ahead to the left. Again, a noisy battle here can attract the attention of a large nearby group of bandits. The chief will be facing away at a desk, so if you can make it into the room undetected, a sneak attack is possible. A Spell Tome: Bound Sword sits on the chief's desk.

Proceeding further into the fort, you will next find yourself on the upper tier of a large dining hall where several bandits are seated. Be prepared for a tough fight, as they will swarm you once alerted and at least one of them will be a powerful mage. A fourth bandit will likely be drawn into the fray from the nearby kitchen area.

Make your way through the kitchen and pantry then proceed through a wooden door. To the left is a pressure plate that activates a spike wall trap which can permanently pinch you against the stone wall. This is most likely to happen if a follower or enemy steps on the trap and you manage to get behind the spike wall after it is activated. Proceed around it with caution and make sure that a follower does not set it off.

After passing through a medium-sized room containing more smithing materials, you will reach a spiral staircase leading upwards into the fort's tower. Climbing it, you will find two more bandits, including another Chief, and a boss chest. It is also possible to ignore the tower and continue on to complete the quest, but you will miss some treasure. The room at the top contains the enchanting skill book Twin Secrets, and a Spell Tome: Courage sits on a wooden table near the Arcane Enchanter. Up on the tower roof is another chest. You can save yourself some trouble later by standing at the east and south edges of the tower roof and killing with ranged attacks all of the bandits below you on the rooftop encampments and in the courtyard.

If you took the stairway, return down and turn right into the hallway. Three leveled bandits await in a guards' room off the left of the hallway. This room contains two locked, empty jail cells. Past that room is a dart trap activated by a pressure plate.

Beyond this trap, a door to the left exits into the fort's front courtyard. Continuing straight past this door leads to a pressure plate trap which will release a swinging mace down into the area in front of the chest you can see ahead. Standing on the plate and waiting for the mace to fall will let you avoid receiving any damage.

walkthrough.heading: The Courtyard
paragraphs: Once you exit the door, you will find the lever immediately to your left. Unless you have killed all or some of them from the roof of the tower, there will be five or six bandits patrolling the courtyard, most of them guarding the front entrance from elevated platforms and rooftops. If you use the lever to open the entrance gate, Stalleo and his bodyguards will rush in from outside to help you fight them. Stalleo is a wizard and can help greatly in battle, but if you prefer, you can fight the bandits here on your own before opening the gate to let him in.

When all the bandits are dead, letting Stalleo know that he's regained possession of his home will complete the quest. When he asks about his family, you only have the option to say that you did not find them. He will then reward you with the Spell Tome: Detect Life.

stages.text: I must find a way to reach the gate lever on the inside of Treva's Watch. Objective 10: Use the backdoor to gain access to Treva's Watch
I must find a way to reach the gate lever on the inside of Treva's Watch. Objective 20: Use the lever to open the gate to Treva's Watch.
I've opened the front gate, I should return to Stalleo for my reward.
I have discovered a back way into Treva's watch and was able to open the main gate from the other side.

notes: After the quest has been concluded, Stalleo and his men will return to their campsite and remain there for the duration of the game, leaving the fort to eventually become occupied by new groups of bandits and their chiefs.

If there is a concurrent radiant quest from the Companions, either for a fragment of Wuuthrad or a set of the Silver Hand's plans, then you will encounter Silver Hand members and their leaders instead of normal bandits. Defeating them will have the same effect as if they were normal bandits.

It is possible to get into the Treva's Watch courtyard without using the tunnel to enter the fort's interior. You can jump the rocky path to the left of the tunnel or climb the hill behind the fort (which give you an excellent vantage point from which to attack the enemies guarding the courtyard). However, doing this may not update the quest unless you enter and immediately exit the tunnel.
If you clear out Treva's Watch before accepting the quest, you can complete it by closing and then reopening the lever. This may leave all objectives marked as incomplete.
Bandits in the first level of the tunnel will not follow you out to Skyrim, and will remain in the same initial positions when you enter the tunnel again.
One Iron Ore vein can be found by walking west to the riverbank from the westernmost part of the fort's exterior.
One treasure chest behind a tent on the rooftop perimeter may be hard to see if you're not looking for it.

Brurid, the man Stalleo holds responsible for the current situation, is mentioned in conversation by bandits in the fort as being present but he is never encountered. However there are *two* Bandit Chiefs in here, and there is evidence in some of the in-game files that one of them was supposed to be Brurid.
The Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch, version 4.3.3, addresses this issue. Brurid now appears as one of the bosses.

Likewise, there are three dead bodies in here (all Nord or Imperial) within the castle, but there is no evidence as to whether they are Stalleo's missing family or not, and when you talk to Stalleo and he asks whether you've seen his family, your only option is to say no, and he replies by saying he hopes they escaped. The family are never seen in-game.
There is evidence that Stalleo's original reward was supposed to be a different Spell Tome: Spectral Arrow, which is found nowhere else in the game and not sold at any vendors.

You will need to complete the entire conversation with Stalleo in order to begin the quest. If you don't, he will stay at his camp, irrespective of whether you've opened the gate or dealt with the bandits.
The quest objectives don't update to indicate completion.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.3.2, fixes this bug.
A sqs query resolves this.
If you had previously cleared the dungeon and opened the front gate before the quest starts, you'll still need to repeat everything.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.3.3, fixes this bug.

paragraphs: If someone you were friends with has died, they will leave you a sum of gold in their will. A courier will approach you and say, "I've got a letter and a lot of gold. Something about it being your inheritance? Oh, and... sorry for your loss." He will hand over a random amount of gold and a letter of inheritance from the court of the hold that the person lived in.

walkthrough.heading: Reward
paragraphs: The base reward is 100 gold multiplied by your relationship rank with the victim. A fixed 10% tax is then applied.

notes: This quest does not appear in your journal.
Sometimes your friend can be a generic NPC, such as an Arch Necromancer.
Sometimes the note comes within mere minutes after the person has died.
It is possible to receive inheritance from people that you have killed yourself.
If you raise a friendly NPC with the master conjuration spell Dead Thrall, you may receive their inheritance after they are killed in combat, regardless of whether you have received it before.

Rich victims were intended to have a base reward of 1000 gold, but no NPCs in the game are flagged as rich. Similarly, the tax applied can vary, but nothing ever alters its value from its default of 10%.
If you already have a letter in your inventory, the new one will stack with the old one and the names will be the same on all of them.

quick: Speak to Aventus Aretino inside the Aretino Residence in Windhelm.
Kill Grelod the Kind in the Honorhall Orphanage in Riften.
Return to Aventus for your reward.

walkthrough.heading: Initiating the Quest
paragraphs: It seems a strange boy named Aventus Aretino is all the talk in Windhelm. By asking around town you will likely hear that Aventus is attempting to perform the Black Sacrament, a ritual designed to summon a Dark Brotherhood assassin. Once this topic arises in a dialogue, the objective "Talk to Aventus Aretino" will appear in your journal as a miscellaneous quest. Speaking to the children at Honorhall Orphanage in Riften will also lead you to Aventus' door.

walkthrough.heading: Aventus Aretino
paragraphs: You will find Aventus in the Aretino Residence in Windhelm. If entering Windhelm through the main gate, immediately turn right and proceed up the stairs. Continue straight ahead, passing the house on your left, and turn left around its far corner. You should now be heading north, with the house on your left and a crumbling stone wall on your right. The Aretino Residence is a short distance ahead. If this is your first visit to the area, Idesa Sadri will be outside Aventus' house trying to dissuade Grimvar Cruel-Sea from playing with poor Aventus, warning him that, "...Aventus Aretino walks a dark path". You can ask Idesa for more information, and she'll tell you that Aventus' mother recently died, and is performing the Black Sacrament to contact the Dark Brotherhood. She will, however, admit that she doesn't know why he's doing it.

If you have previously entered the house without the objective in your journal, it will be added at this point. To speak with Aventus, pick the lock on the door where you will discover Aventus performing the Black Sacrament, chanting over and over again. He is so engrossed in the ritual that he fails to notice you. When you speak to him, he will be overjoyed and mistake you for the assassin he was trying to summon, "I did the Black Sacrament, over and over. With the body, and the... the things. And then you came! An assassin from the Dark Brotherhood!"

He will tell you about his mother's death and that afterward he was sent to Honorhall Orphanage in Riften, where he was subjected to the cruelties of its headmistress, Grelod the Kind. He escaped the orphanage and returned to his home where he set about performing the Sacrament to get his revenge and to ensure that neither he or his friends will have to suffer any more. He expects you to kill Grelod, further stating, "She's a monster." You can ask for further details, but whatever the course of your conversation with him, it will conclude with your journal advancing the Innocence Lost quest. He will also ask you not to harm Constance Michel, Grelod's servant, because she was kind to him and the other orphans.

walkthrough.heading: Grelod The Dead
paragraphs: Travel to Honorhall Orphanage in Riften. Here Grelod the Kind is a cruel tyrant, verbally abusing her charges, "Nobody needs you, nobody wants you", and that her nickname is a term of endearment that she has bestowed on herself and imposed on the children. Killing Grelod does not constitute a crime so you may kill her in whatever fashion you see fit, however attacking any of the children or Constance is a crime. Whatever manner you choose will be successful as she only has one point of health.

While Constance runs about in a panic once Grelod dies, the orphans will come to gloat over the body, expressing reactions ranging from philosophical reflection, "Kill one person, and you can solve so many problems. I wonder at the possibilities", to simple joy, "Hurrah! Hurrah!" If spoken to, each of the children will share one or more thoughts and feelings about her death.

Return to Windhelm and speak to Aventus. He will greet the news with happiness and show his gratitude by giving you a family heirloom, which is "Supposed to be sort of valuable", however the dinner plate is only worth 100 gold. This quest counts as a favor quest for Aventus, who is a citizen of Eastmarch.

walkthrough.heading: Alternate Path
paragraphs: If you have killed Grelod prior to starting the quest, then when you speak with Aventus for the first time you can tell him that you killed her. He will state that "I knew the Dark Brotherhood was good... just not that good! You killed the old hag before I even asked!" There are no negative consequences to the quest and the reward is the same.

stages.text: Objective 10: Talk to Aventus Aretino

I heard a rumor that a boy named Aventus Aretino, in Windhelm, has been attempting to contact the Dark Brotherhood. I should find this boy and speak with him, and find out why he wants to contact a guild of assassins. Objective 5: Talk to Aventus Aretino

The mother of Aventus Aretino recently died, and the boy was sent to live at Honorhall Orphanage in Riften. He thinks I'm a Dark Brotherhood assassin, and wants me to kill the Orphanage's sadistic headmistress, Grelod the Kind. Objective 20: Kill Grelod the Kind
Objective 30: Tell Aventus Aretino that Grelod is dead
I killed Grelod the Kind, and Aventus Aretino rewarded me with a family heirloom. Now the boy can return to Honorhall Orphanage, and live out his childhood peacefully.

notes: If you revisit the orphanage after completing the quest, the children will make general comments about things being better with Grelod gone. Guards in the city will also make similar comments about the latter.

After killing her, guards may say "Been a murder, over in Riften. Some old lady who runs an orphanage. Those poor children must be heartbroken." Guards in Riften may also suggest some suspicion toward you with "That old woman who runs the orphanage has been murdered. Say, didn't I see you coming out of there...?"

Followers with a morality value of 3 won't kill Grelod if you order them to do so. Although Grelod is cruel and killing her doesn't result in a bounty, she is classified as an "innocent" or non-hostile NPC until attacked, making her death a "crime" in the eyes of the follower's programming. The fact that Grelod has only 1 health point adds to that reasoning.
After the quest, Aventus will always view you as his savior regardless if you join or eliminate the Dark Brotherhood.
Finishing the quest will prevent further assassination attempts against you, regardless if you join or eliminate the Dark Brotherhood.

After Grelod is killed, Constance Michel will run around in a panic. She will remain in this state even if you return days or weeks later, only returning to normal once Innocence Lost has been completed by speaking to Aventus Aretino.
If you have installed Hearthfire, Constance will assume ownership of the orphanage once the quest is finished and allow you to adopt children from there. You'll get a letter from her as well.
If you don't have Hearthfire installed, Constance will continue to run around in a panic after the quest is finished, even if you return days or weeks later.
You cannot adopt Aventus after this quest, regardless if you have Hearthfire installed or not.
If you bring Serana to Aretino's house before the quest has begun, she and Aventus may perform the Black Sacrament together.
If you bring her there during or after quest, she will still attempt to perform the ritual by herself.

Although you will note in your journal that Aventus can return to the orphanage at the completion of the quest, he never does so. He will remain alone in his home. If spoken to there, he will say that he's planning on growing up to be an assassin, "like you". If you talk to him right after killing Grelod, he will say "I'll give them some time to clean up the mess."
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.3, fixes this bug.
After completing the quest, the ritual mess that's still sitting in Aretino's house won't be cleaned up.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.4, addresses this issue. The ritual items will be removed the next time the house resets.

The fix from Unofficial Skyrim Patch 1.2.3 created another bug. Although Aventus now returns to Honorhall Orphanage after completion of the quest with Unofficial Skyrim Patch 1.2.3, he doesn't sleep there.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.3.3, fixes this bug.

The fix from Unofficial Skyrim Patch 1.2.3 created a third bug. Although Aventus now returns to Honorhall Orphanage after completion of the quest with Unofficial Skyrim Patch 1.2.3, he does so too early. He should be delayed until the player has actually left the city, which is when the courier will begin tracking you down to deliver the note.
The Unofficial Skyrim Legendary Edition Patch, version 3.0.1, fixes this bug.

The fix from Unofficial Skyrim Patch 1.2.3 created a fourth bug. Although Aventus now returns to Honorhall Orphanage after completion of the quest with Unofficial Skyrim Patch 1.2.3, he can sometimes be found stuck trying to navigate his way to the city because Fort Greenwall may not yet be cleared when he leaves Windhelm.
The Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch, version 4.0.7, fixes this bug.
Even if you kill Grelod in another room, her body may teleport to the main room upon death.

quick: Speak to Azadi in Shor's Stone.
Read Azadi's Note and wait for a courier to deliver another letter to you.
Travel to Purewater Run and speak to Fijeh.
Read Fijeh's instructions.
Head to the Vilemyr Inn in Ivarstead, and speak to Sirayar.
Return to Fijeh at Purewater Run.
Travel to Sunderstone Gorge where you can either attack the caravan on your own or meetup with the Remnants.
Head back to Purewater Run and speak to Rakeed and Fijeh.

walkthrough.heading: Azadi
paragraphs: To begin this quest, speak to Azadi in Shor's Stone where you can either brawl him or speak him down:
After defeating him in a brawl:
He will then hand you a note and disappear. Read the note and wait for a courier to deliver another letter to you.

walkthrough.heading: Purewater Run
paragraphs: Once you have read the courier's letter, you will need to travel to Purewater Run. Once you arrive, speak to Fijeh:
All three options will lead to the following dialogue:
Alternatively, you can tell him:

He will then hand you instructions which explain that the Remnants have agents that have lived in Skyrim for over 20 years, that one lives in the Miner's Barracks in Karthwasten and the other should be waiting for you in front of Vilemyr Inn in Ivarstead.

walkthrough.heading: Karthwasten
paragraphs: Head to the Miner's Barracks in Karthwasten, where you will find Josla sitting behind the barracks. Speak to her:

She will then hand you a note which states that she overheard that a Hammerfell noble from Sentinel would be crossing the border in the next few days and paid a hefty coin purse to the Thalmor to ensure safe passage to Blacklight. She suspects that the noble is Ismal and that Rakeed would most likely be with him.

walkthrough.heading: Ivarstead
paragraphs: Head to the Vilemyr Inn in Ivarstead, where you will find Sirayar:
He will then hand you a note which states that the wagon will be passing by Sunderstone Gorge.

walkthrough.heading: Ambush the Thalmor
paragraphs: Return to Fijeh at Purewater Run:
He will then hand you the key to the remnant supply chest that can be found near him. Unlock the chest and it contains:
Remnant Agent Armor
Remnant Agent Boots
Remnant Agent Gloves
Remnant Agent Hood
Remnant Shield
Remnant Scimitar of Fire x 2
Potion of Extended Invisibility x 2
The Ebon Arm
Travel to Sunderstone Gorge where you can either attack the caravan on your own or meetup with the Remnants.
Meet up with the three Remnants and they will charge to the caravan alongside you. You will have to fight four Thalmor soldiers and Ismal, who wields Boneshaver.
Once the Thalmor and Ismal have been dispatched, rescue Rakeed:

When freed he will then turn himself invisible and disappear. The three remaining Remnant Agents can attacked if you want to gain even more enchanted Remnant sets of armor and weapons, but they are powerful enemies, well-equipped with healing and invisibility potions in addition to their dual-wielded fiery scimitars. After securing Boneshaver from Ismal's corpse, head back to Purewater Run where Rakeed and Fijeh are waiting:
You will receive the gold you and Fijeh agreed on, and both Rakeed and Fijeh will vanish with the casting of Invisibility spells. This ends the quest.

In addition to the rewards from the chest, you will now be able to smith the Remnant Armor, Boots, Gloves, Hood, Shield and Scimitars. These are the unenchanted versions of the Remnant Agent armor pieces and scimitars that you picked from the chest (all of which are enchanted except for the shield): they are to be found in the Steel menu, but require the Advanced Armors perk (on the left side of the Smithing tree) to forge, or to temper properly.

stages.text: A fighter in Shor's Stone has been rumored to have been causing trouble by trying to start fights with anyone who passes by. I should see if there's a way to get him to stop being such a nuisance. Objective 10: Speak to the fighter in Shor's Stone

I accepted Azadi's challenge in Shor's Stone, and must now defeat him in an unarmed brawl. Perhaps if I beat some sense into him, he will go someplace else. Objective 15: Defeat Azadi in an unarmed brawl

I convinced Azadi to stop bothering the residents of Shor's Stone without a fight. He handed me a note, and then vanished into thin air. I should read what the note has to say. Objective 20: Read Azadi's note
I defeated Azadi in an unarmed brawl. After the fight, he handed me a note, and then vanished into thin air. I should read what the note has to say. Objective 20: Read Azadi's note
Azadi's note was mysterious, only saying that "they" would somehow contact me. I should expect to receive a letter from a courier soon. Objective 30: Wait to be contacted by courier
I received a letter from someone named Fijeh by courier. I should read what it has to say. Objective 40: Read Fijeh's letter

I received a letter from Fijeh, who seemed to know about my encounter with Azadi. Fijeh and Azadi are members of a secretive group of spies and warriors from Hammerfell called the Remnants. Fijeh is trying to rescue a fellow Remnant that was captured by the Thalmor, aided by a Thalmor sympathizer. Fijeh would like my assistance in helping track down his brother in arms. He asked to meet in Purewater Run, in the hills near Markarth. Objective 50: Travel to Purewater Run
Objective 55: Talk to Fijeh
I met Fijeh in Purewater Run. He handed me a set of instructions detailing the next step of the mission to rescue Rakeed. Objective 60: Read Fijeh's instructions

Fijeh has requested that I gather intelligence about the whereabouts of the captured Remnant from two spies, in Karthwasten and Ivarstead, by speaking a special phrase to them: "The ravens take flight once more." Objective 70: Find the Remnant spy behind the Miner's Barracks in Karthwasten Objective 80: Find the Remnant spy in front of Vilemyr Inn in Ivarstead
I spoke the secret phrase to Josla, a Remnant spy in Karthwasten. She handed me a note that should contain information about the whereabouts of the captured Remnant. Objective 75: Read Josla's note

After speaking to a Remnant spy, I learned that Rakeed will be transported through Skyrim very soon under heavy Thalmor guard by caravan, along with the Hammerfell noble that aided in his capture. Their destination is the city of Blacklight in Morrowind. I should seek out the spy in Ivarstead to learn more.
I spoke the secret phrase to Sirayar, a Remnant spy in Ivarstead. He handed me a note that should contain information about the whereabouts of the captured Remnant. Objective 85: Read Sirayar's note

After speaking to a Remnant spy, I learned that Rakeed will be transported to Morrowind through Skyrim by crossing the border to the southwest from Hammerfell, and should be traveling the road near Sunderstone Gorge. I should seek out the spy in Karthwasten to learn more.

I have gathered information from both of the Remnant spies that reside in Skyrim. It seems that the Thalmor will be transporting Rakeed to Morrowind very soon, crossing the border into Skyrim from the southwest and traveling the road near Sunderstone Gorge. I should return to Purewater Run and discuss the next step with Fijeh. Objective 100: Return to Fijeh

Fijeh has handed me a key to the Remnant supply chest. We plan to attack Ismal's caravan as soon as everyone is gathered at the attack location. Alternatively, I can approach the caravan and get the job done myself. Objective 110: Obtain the Remnant equipment from the supply chest Objective 120 or 125: Join the Remnant warriors to begin the assault or Approach the caravan alone
I've begun my assault on Ismal's caravan in my attempt to free Rakeed.
I met the Remnant warriors near Ismal's caravan. We now need to find Rakeed and free him from the Thalmor. Objective 130: Free the hostage
Rakeed has been rescued from the Thalmor caravan. I should speak to Fijeh one last time now that the mission is complete. Objective 160: Return to Fijeh

Fijeh thanked me and paid me for my efforts. And with that, Fijeh cast an invisibility spell and disappeared along with Rakeed. I should investigate the Remnant supply chest that Fijeh gave me a key to unlock.

Fijeh thanked me and paid me for my efforts. And with that, Fijeh cast an invisibility spell and disappeared along with Rakeed. I searched the supply chest that Fijeh gave me a key to unlock, and discovered a set of Remnant weapons and armor.

Fijeh thanked me and paid me for my efforts. And with that, Fijeh cast an invisibility spell and disappeared along with Rakeed. I searched the supply chest that Fijeh gave me a key to unlock, and discovered a set of Remnant weapons and armor.

notes: When Rakeed is rescued he is wearing a white variant of the Execution Hood which was always in the game files yet unobtainable and marked as unplayable.
Both Josla and Sirayar can have the code phrase repeated to them indefinitely resulting in an unlimited number of their notes.
Azadi may not initiate dialogue when speaking to him and will only respond in generic dialogue such as "Need something?" and "Huh?"
When you talk to Azadi and choose the brawl option, he may not initiate combat. This will give you a bounty for assault if you attack him.

When you win the brawl with Azadi, he may only say "You're tougher than you look. You got me, fair and square." and not say the second line "Thank you. Here, this is for you.", so you will not get his note. Talking to him again will only result in "Need something?" and "Huh?"
To fix this, use the console command setstage ccEDHSSE003_Quest 22. Afterwards talk to Azadi and he will have the proper dialogue and give you the note.

quick: (Optional) Read Ahzidal's Descent.
Investigate Kolbjorn Barrow and speak to Ralis Sedarys.
Agree to help Ralis fund his excavation by donating 1,000 gold and wait for a message from him.
Visit Kolbjorn Barrow and defeat the draugr.
Find a way deeper into the barrow, and then speak to Ralis again.
Donate 2,000 gold to fund the excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow and wait for another message from Ralis.
Return to Kolbjorn Barrow, clear the draugr, and search for missing miners.
Speak to Ralis, fund 3,000 gold to his excavation, and await another message.
Return to Kolbjorn Barrow and clear the draugr.
Speak to Ralis, fund 5,000 gold to his excavation, and await another message.
Return to Kolbjorn Barrow and locate Ralis.
Defeat Ahzidal and confront Ralis; decide what to do with him.

walkthrough.heading: A Strange Partnership
paragraphs: Just northeast of the Old Attius Farm is Kolbjorn Barrow. Outside Kolbjorn Barrow is a lone Dunmer named Ralis Sedarys. Go up and talk to him and he'll explain that he is a treasure hunter and has come with news that he has located a treasure in the barrow, but he cannot afford to excavate it alone and requests a donation of 1,000 gold, with a promise of a share of any treasure discovered.

walkthrough.heading: First Visit
paragraphs: A few days after you give him the money, a courier will give you a note about the barrow. Head off over to the barrow, and Ralis will explain that the draugr have been disturbed, and they have killed all the miners. He asks you to go in and kill the draugr and then find a way further into the barrow. After you have killed the draugr, take the Skull off the altar to open the next area, Go into the next room and pick up the Ahzidal's Boots of Waterwalking. (If the skull has been knocked off the pressure plate on the altar during the fight it must be lifted back onto the plinth and removed once more, or you can "walk" onto it and off by getting on the altar). Go back and talk to Ralis. He'll then ask for 2,000 gold to hire some more miners.

walkthrough.heading: Second Visit
paragraphs: Several days afterward you'll get another note asking you to come back to the barrow. There are more draugr and two of the miners are missing. He asks that you locate the missing miners and to kill the remaining draugr. Before you get to Mireli, there is a gate with 4 handles arranged vertically to the right of the gate. Do not pull the third (from the top), as it releases a dart trap. Pull the switches in the following order: first, second, fourth, first. In the last section of the mine near the corpse of Mireli is a handle (near the floor on the other side of the wall with candles, a soul gem and coins) that can be turned to reveal a secret room where Ahzidal's Ring of Necromancy can be found. Note that although you will hear the sounds of a nearby word wall, it will not be accessible until a later visit.
Ralis now wants 3,000 gold to hire some mercenaries.

walkthrough.heading: Third Visit
paragraphs: You will receive a third letter a few days later, asking you to return to the barrow. When the courier delivers the letter, he will tell you "Another letter from Ralis. He's starting to scare me a little", a portent of things to come. Ralis will tell a similar story as last time: that there are yet more draugr, and that this time they have killed all the mercenaries that he hired. Enter the barrow and kill the draugr. To access Ahzidal's Gauntlets of Warding, pull the chain to the right of the iron doors that lead to the staircase into the newly excavated section, then backtrack around the corner where they will be sitting on a pedestal that was previously unavailable. Then, head down the stairs, avoiding the trap, and kill the new draugr. When you reach the open chamber, you must ensure all the pressure plates are lit for the gate to open and reach Ahzidal's Ring of Arcana. (The Light Foot perk does not prevent you from lighting the pressure plates.) The timing is a bit tight; if you can't get it, using Slow Time seems to work, or you can run along the joint between two rows of tiles, depressing both rows at once, for a total of three runs across the grid. You can also circumvent the puzzle entirely with Telekinesis. A pit filled with deep water surrounds the plinth that the ring is on. At the bottom you can find a coin purse, a burial urn and a leveled battleaxe. Once you're done here, head up the stairs and back out of the barrow to talk to Ralis who now wants 5,000 more gold. He will then send you one last note, which simply reads "You're needed."

walkthrough.heading: A Poor Investment
paragraphs: When you get the final note, return to the barrow and look for clues at the camp, then head into the barrow and clear it out. You are finally able to reach the word wall which teaches a word for the Cyclone shout. On reaching the room with all the pressure plates on the floor, follow the passage to the left. A gate will close behind you will have to fight three draugr. The gate blocking access to Ahzidal's Armor of Retribution can be opened by rotating the two animal totem pillars until the whale symbols are facing you, then pulling the lever on the floor. Rotate the two animal totem pillars until the eagle symbols are facing you and pull the lever on the floor again to open the gate you came in, and the gate over the spiral staircase. At the bottom of the staircase, the gate blocking access to Ahzidal's Helm of Vision can be opened by rotating the two animal totem pillars until the snake symbols are facing you, then pulling the chain next to the door. There is a giant pool of oil encompassing almost the entire room, so it is recommended that you intentionally ignite it safely from the staircase as pulling the chain with an incorrect pillar arrangement will cause several flame spout traps to blast the area in front of the gate. Removing the helm from its pedestal will activate another flame spout trap that is aimed back towards the gate. You may use Telekinesis again, but the flame jet will still travel far enough to ignite the oil. There is a Stalhrim source to the left of the helm chamber.

After battling several leveled draugr, you will eventually find Ralis completing the ritual to awaken a dragon priest named Ahzidal. Defeat Ahzidal, loot his eponymous mask, then speak to Ralis, who will explain that he was under a spell. You can then choose to kill him or let him live, in which case he will become available as a follower. If you kill him, you may loot Hoarfrost, a unique ancient Nordic pickaxe, from his corpse. You can also take it from him if you spare him.
You can find the Black Book Filament and Filigree at the end of the exit tunnel.

stages.text: Outside Kolbjorn Barrow, I met Ralis Sedarys, an explorer who came to Solstheim in search of relics within the barrow. But when he arrived, he found it buried by the ash. He had all but given up on excavating it, but if I can supply the funds, he offered to make me a partner in his expedition. Objective 40: Fund the excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow (1000 gold)

Ralis Sedarys came to Solstheim in search of the Relics of Ahzidal, powerful items said to have been sealed in Kolbjorn Barrow, but found it buried by ash. I agreed to fund his expedition to excavate the Barrow. He set to work, saying he'd send a courier when he had progress to report. Objective 75: Wait for a message from Ralis
I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow. I should visit the site and see how the work is going. Objective 100: Visit the Kolbjorn Barrow Excavation

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the dig has come to a halt. The excavation had reached a dead end when Draugr within the tomb awoke, killing several miners and causing the rest to flee. Objective 130: Clear the Draugr from Kolbjorn Barrow Objective 140: Find a way deeper into the Barrow

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the dig has come to a halt. The excavation had reached a dead end when Draugr within the tomb awoke, killing several miners and causing the rest to flee. I defeated the Draugr, but now need to find a way past the dead end.

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the dig has come to a halt. The excavation had reached a dead end when Draugr within the tomb awoke, killing several miners and causing the rest to flee. I found a way past the dead end, but must deal with the Draugr before work can continue.

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the dig has come to a halt. At his request, I defeated the Draugr and found a way past the dead end. Objective 150: Speak to Ralis

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but in order to continue, he needs more gold to hire replacements for the workers that have been killed. Objective 160: Fund the next phase of the excavation (2000 gold)
I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow. He told me to return in a few days to see how work was progressing. Objective 175: Wait for a message from Ralis
I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow. I should return and see how the work is going. Objective 200: Return to Kolbjorn Barrow

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the site has stopped. Most of the miners were killed by another wave of Draugr attacks, and two more are unaccounted for. Objective 230: Clear the Draugr from Kolbjorn Barrow Objective 240: Search for the missing miners

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the site has stopped. Most of the miners were killed by another wave of Draugr attacks, and two more are unaccounted for. I dealt with the Draugr, but still need to locate the missing miners.

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the site has stopped. Most of the miners were killed by another wave of Draugr attacks, and two more were unaccounted for. I found the bodies of the missing miners, but still need to deal with the Draugr threat.

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the site has stopped. At his request, I dealt with the Draugr and found the bodies of the missing miners. Objective 250: Speak to Ralis

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but the ongoing Draugr attacks means he needs more gold in order to hire more miners and guards to protect them. Objective 260: Fund the next phase of the excavation (3000 gold)
I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow. He told me to return in a few days to see how work was progressing. Objective 275: Wait for a message from Ralis
I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow. I should return and see how the work is going. Objective 300: Return to Kolbjorn Barrow

I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but Draugr have attacked the miners again, and only a few managed to escape. Ralis asked if I could wipe them out so the excavation could continue. Objective 330: Clear the Draugr from Kolbjorn Barrow
I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but Draugr again attacked the miners. Once again, I slew the Draugr so work could proceed. Objective 350: Speak to Ralis

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but once again, he needs more gold to hire increasingly reluctant miners and guards to work on the site. Objective 360: Fund the next phase of the excavation (5000 gold)
I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow. He told me to return in a few days to see how work was progressing. Objective 375: Wait for a message from Ralis
I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow. I should return and see how the work is going. Objective 400: Return to Kolbjorn Barrow

I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' ill-fated excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but when I returned to his mining camp, I found only blood and corpses. Ralis himself was nowhere to be seen. Objective 410: Locate Ralis

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' ill-fated excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but when I returned to his mining camp, I found only blood and corpses. Deep within the barrow, I found Ralis performing a ritual to release Ahzidal, the Dragon Priest that had been sealed there.
Objective 450: Defeat Ahzidal

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' ill-fated excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but when I returned to his mining camp, I found only blood and corpses. Deep within the barrow, I found Ralis performing a ritual that released Ahzidal, a powerful Dragon Priest I fought and defeated. Objective 475: Confront Ralis

Ralis Sedarys came to Solstheim hoping to find the Relics of Ahzidal and release their maker from his imprisonment in Kolbjorn Barrow. When he found the barrow buried by the ash, he convinced me to fund its excavation, using the miners as blood sacrifices for his rituals. I saw through his lies and decided to kill him for his crimes. Objective 480: Kill Ralis

Ralis Sedarys came to Solstheim hoping to find the Relics of Ahzidal and release their maker from his imprisonment in Kolbjorn Barrow. When he found the barrow buried by the ash, he convinced me to fund its excavation, using the miners as blood sacrifices for his rituals. I saw through his lies and killed him for his crimes.

Ralis Sedarys came to Solstheim hoping to find the Relics of Ahzidal, but fell under the spell of their maker, a powerful Dragon Priest entombed in the barrow. He convinced me to fund its excavation, but was compelled by Ahzidal to use the miners as ritual sacrifices. Ralis had no control over his actions, so I allowed him to live and depart the barrow in peace.
Objective 10: Speak to Ralis Sedarys at Kolbjorn Barrow
Objective 20: Investigate Kolbjorn Barrow

notes: In total you will require 11,000 gold to complete the excavation.
The time between each investment and the next courier message is three full days (72 hours).
If you visit between messages, there will be miners and possibly guards working. They have generic dialogue reflecting the current state of the quest.

Throughout the quest, a series of journals can be found, giving insight into Ralis' state of mind. Take care when reading them as the disappearance of the camp will not occur if you take his journals from the camp prior to the final condition. They may also be stuck in your inventory permanently if you do so. The disappearance condition is that Filament and Filigree is read and Ahzidal is obtained, the two actions' order doesn't matter.
You can find Ahzidal's unique heavy armor set and rings:
Ahzidal's Boots of Waterwalking are available after the first phase of digging.
Ahzidal's Ring of Necromancy may be found after the second phase.
Ahzidal's Gauntlets of Warding and Ahzidal's Ring of Arcana can be acquired after the third phase.
Ahzidal's Armor of Retribution and Ahzidal's Helm of Vision become available after the fourth phase.

The Ring of Arcana may not be on its plinth when you get to it—shouts from the draugr in the adjacent chamber can knock it into the pit of water. If this occurs, equipping the Telekinesis spell can help you locate it (due to its longer range compared to the standard cursor).

You may hear the chanting of the nearby word wall after the second phase has occurred, but you won't be able to access it until the fourth phase. You might be able to access it during the third phase if you stand close enough to the wall.

The grate that opens to allow you to descend to meet Ahzidal on your final visit is controlled by the familiar pillars and is well-marked. The eagles on the opposite wall must be set on the corresponding pillars.

The iron gate blocking the pedestal that holds Ahzidal's Armor of Retribution is not so obvious, however. As you enter the room, on the walls to either side there will be pull chains just to the right of an arch-way. If you pull the chains, this will activate rotating doors which will reveal that behind the arch-ways are two more pillars, each with the sign of the fish. The pillars behind the chairs need to be matched to these to open the gate and obtain the armor. Setting both pillars to the Eagle (and activating the lever) will open the door downstairs. The pillars here perform an uncharacteristic double-duty by opening two separate portals.
The fastest way to complete this quest would be to commit a murder, and serve the jail time rather than pay a bounty. This will cause seven in game days to pass each time, allowing quick completion.

Ralis may hire the miners, but never get anywhere with them - despite the passage of days (or even months), the courier never arrives, and when you check the dig site, they haven't reached the entrance.
Check the site once, talk to Ralis, then sleep in a bed on Solstheim for 24 or 48 hours. Repeat for each stage.
If the courier never arrives with Ralis' letters, you can bring him to you by bringing up the console, and typing and entering prid 00039FB7 .
Then type and enter moveto player
Finally, you can talk to the courier to trigger his letter delivery dialogue.

Upon entering Kolbjorn Barrow for the second time, the door by Mireli might drop down prematurely and lock you out of the room instead of locking down your retreat. Manually reopening the door will not help as it will just become an invisible barrier blocking your entrance. To reach Mireli and complete the quest, go back to the big hollow room and jump onto the platform. Alternatively, reload to a save before having entered the barrow for a second time.

Upon entering Kolbjorn Barrow for the fourth and final time, you are instructed to find Ralis Sedarys (stage 410). At some point before reaching the chamber with Ralis and Ahzidal, the quest may immediately progress to confronting Ralis (stage 475). It is possible that Ralis will be flagged as hostile towards the draugr and Ahzidal (or vice versa), and a brawl will ensue before you reach the chamber. Since Ralis is considered an essential NPC until you choose the dialogue option to kill him, upon reaching the chamber you will find Ralis chanting, as if to summon Ahzidal, but Ahzidal and the draugr are already dead. Approaching Ralis will trigger the normal dialogue (choose to kill or spare him). If he is spared, he will continue chanting as he runs away. He will still be chanting when approached at The Retching Netch.

Once you finish the quest, the excavation site is supposed to clear up once you're far enough away. However, the script controlling this incorrectly polls the alias on Ralis when it should have been polling a static object at the site. This can result in the possibility that the registered update would fail to be renewed, leaving the quest open forever.
The Unofficial Dragonborn Patch, version 2.0.3, fixes this bug.

Ralis' journals can be found on a table outside of the barrow excavation. Taking them after completion of the quest will permanently mark them as quest items, and it will be impossible to ever remove them from your inventory.
The Unofficial Dragonborn Patch, version 2.0.3, fixes this bug.
You can remove the journals from your inventory by storing them in Ahzidal's ash pile, but they will still be marked as quest items.

They may be removed via the console by typing Player.removeitem xx018108 1 and repeating for the IDs xx01810F, xx018110, xx018111, and xx0181CB. The xx on each ID will vary; see this page for details.

Ralis' journals can also be permanently marked as quest items if you complete the quest and leave the barrow without collecting the Black Book. This glitch actually seems to depend on the passage of time. Completing the Black Book quickly may cause the glitch to not be fixed. Waiting a few extra hours before leaving the dungeon should fix it.
Upon entering Kolbjorn Barrow for the third time, one of the draugr that you must kill may be outside of the map.
Leaving and reentering Kolbjorn should fix this issue.

If you haven't picked up Ahzidal's Ring of Necromancy yet during the 2nd investment, it will disappear during the 3rd investment if you try to go back and grab it. It can be retrieved if you return to barrow after the third investment but before receiving the next letter.
If Ahzidal is killed as he rises from the ground, his corpse and ash pile may be below the ground and not lootable.

Upon entering Kolbjorn Barrow for the fourth time, the doorway leading to the lower section of the tomb may be blocked by rubble. Though this rubble can be walked through, as it has no collision, it can make it difficult to find where to go.
At the second phase, you may find the third phase area accessible instead of being sealed off, allowing you to get Ahzidal's Gauntlets of Warding and the Ring of Arcana early.
All of the generic miners present, both male and female, have "opposite gender animations" marked.

quick: Offer to investigate Shroud Hearth Barrow after Wilhelm complains it might be haunted.
Explore the barrow and track down the "ghost."
Take Wyndelius' diary to Wilhelm for your reward.

walkthrough.heading: A Haunted Barrow
paragraphs: When visiting Vilemyr Inn in Ivarstead you may overhear the innkeeper, Wilhelm, warning Lynly Star-Sung about a ghost in the nearby barrow. If you are intrigued and like a good ghost story, Wilhelm will inform you that Shroud Hearth Barrow, an ancient Nord crypt just outside of town, is haunted and warns you away from it as well. When pressed further, Wilhelm will confess to seeing the spirit and complain that the haunting is harming his business. If you volunteer to investigate the haunting, Wilhelm will think you daft and tell you of Wyndelius Gatharian, an adventurer who went to explore the barrow a year ago. Screams were heard in the night, and the adventurer was never seen again. Alternatively, you can go directly to the barrow without speaking to Wilhelm beforehand.

walkthrough.heading: Ghost Hunting
paragraphs: Enter the barrow. At the first intersection, you might see Wyndelius' ghost through a locked gate to your right, asking you to leave. The first part of the barrow has no enemies, only several traps that you must navigate through. Head left to a room with four levers and pull the two middle levers (the ones closest to the door) to open the two metal gates. The right side lever triggers an arrow trap. In the next room, to the right is an apprentice-locked door. Directly behind it is a pressure plate that activates a spike trap. It is, however, nowhere near the pressure plate so walking slowly over it will leave you unharmed. Beyond the spike trap is a booby-trapped chest. Moving back, pull the chain to open the next gate and continue on. There is a spike trap here too, but once again moving slowly over it will work. Eventually, behind an unlocked door, you will find Wyndelius.

walkthrough.heading: Philter of the Phantom
paragraphs: Wyndelius will attack you on sight, unless he is sleeping, which allows you to perform a sneak attack or a stealthy inspection of the room. If you kill him, his ruse is revealed; he is not a ghost at all, and his spectral appearance was due to a potion called Philter of the Phantom. On the table you will find his journal, which explains why he pretended to be a ghost. However, killing Wyndelius is not necessary to complete the quest; you need only recover the journal. Take the journal to Wilhelm and, in exchange, he will reward you with the sapphire dragon claw, the very item Wyndelius gave his sanity and life to possess. The claw is needed to explore the rest of the barrow, which contains a word wall with a part of Kyne's Peace shout.

stages.text: Objective 10: Investigate Shroud Hearth Barrow
Objective 20: Bring Wyndelius's Journal to Wilhelm

notes: The claw will be marked as a quest item until the player clears the barrow.
If the barrow is left alone long enough to reset, Wyndelius' body will remain dead while replenishing a new bottle of Philter of the Phantom.

If you pick up the journal before speaking to Wilhelm, you'll instead be given the option to say "Actually, you need to take a look at this." and give him the journal. The quest will still proceed as normal.
After you finish the quest, Wilhelm will occasionally say "Now that our "ghost" has been unmasked, I hope we see more visitors in town than just the occasional pilgrim." when you talk to him.
If the puzzle door does not work, check here for possible fixes.
The sapphire dragon claw may still be marked as a quest item after you finish the quest, which prevents you from removing it from your inventory.
Re-visiting Shroud Hearth Barrow after it has respawned, and clearing it again, may remove the quest item marking from the claw.

If Unrelenting Force is used during the fight with Wyndelius, his journal may be knocked off the table and impossible to find, making the quest impossible to complete. Obtaining the journal and the claw through console commands will not make the quest continue, and the quest will remain unfinished even if you clear the entire barrow.

Even after you finish the quest and solve the mystery of the ghost, Wilhelm and Lynly will still engage in conversation and act if the ghost still exists, causing him to tell her to stay away from the barrow.

quick: Speak to any bard in Skyrim.
Speak to Viarmo at the Bards College.

paragraphs: Speak to any Bard you meet in Skyrim. Bards can be found wandering around the countryside or in taverns and inns. The bard will suggest that you should investigate The Bards College. Following their advice, go to Solitude and speak to Viarmo.

stages.text: Objective 10: Investigate the Bards College

notes: Starting this quest after you have already joined the Bards College will make this quest incompletable, permanently leaving this objective in your quest journal.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.2.4, fixes this bug.
You can clear the "Investigate the Bards College" quest by using the console command SetObjectiveCompleted MS05Start 10 1.
Having King Olaf's verse before investigating the Bards College may make this quest incompletable, permanently leaving this objective in your quest journal.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.3.3, fixes this bug.
This can be fixed with the console command ResetQuest MS05Start followed by SetObjectiveCompleted MS05Start 10 1.

quick: (Optional) Read Boethiah's Proving.
Travel to the Sacellum of Boethiah and speak to the Priestess of Boethiah.
Sacrifice a follower on the Altar of Sacrifice.
Kill all the cult members.
Go to Knifepoint Ridge and kill Boethiah's current champion.

walkthrough.heading: Starting the Quest
paragraphs: You can start the quest any time after reaching level 30, either by reading a copy of Boethiah's Proving or traveling directly to the Sacellum of Boethiah and talking to the Priestess of Boethiah or killing every one of the cultists. If you wait, you may be attacked randomly in the world by Boethiah cultists, who will have a copy of Boethiah's Proving on their corpse.

walkthrough.heading: The Shrine of Boethiah
paragraphs: First, you will have to make your way to the Sacellum of Boethiah. Follow the road northeast from the Windhelm Stables up to Traitor's Post. Nearby is a road that leads into the mountains, up to the Sacellum. When you arrive at the Sacellum you will find two cultists fighting in a small arena. There are some more cultists and a Priestess of Boethiah watching them. Speak to the priestess. She will tell you that you need to prove that "your tongue can wield a lie". If you kill the followers of Boethiah, the Daedric Prince will appear and give the quest instructions herself; this will only change the order in which you complete the tasks. If you approach the shrine at level 29 or below, the quest won't start, and there will be no one there.

walkthrough.heading: The Sacrifice
