Using the wait function for an hour or so right outside the door may remedy the problem.
Alternatively, using console commands "prid xx0177DA" and "moveto player" while standing at the entrance will place Neloth next to player allowing the quest to progress.
When you go from the Reading Room to the start of the ruins, instead of speaking and continuing onward, Neloth may stand silently at the top of the stairs, thus disallowing any further progress.
Sometimes the control cube will vanish making further progression into the ruins impossible.
Loading an older save file may cause the cube to reappear; however, this will not always work.
You may be unable to follow Neloth into the Aqueduct, even though he enters without any problems.
To rectify this, just reload a previous save.
You may be unable to place any cubes in the control switches, even though you have them.

Double-check that you actually have a control cube in your inventory. The red control pedestal in the main part of the Aqueduct doesn't show its "Activate" option unless you have a cube available. For reference, there should be two in the top-most blue pedestals in the Great Chamber and one in the blue pedestal in this chamber.

Use the console to select the bugged pedestal, then use "placeatme 04028110" to get a new working pedestal. Then without selecting anything else, using "disable" to remove the bugged pedestal, and you will be able to click the new non-bugged one. You may also need to do the same to the object that it was supposed to activate "placeatme 040173b7" using "disable" to remove the bugged stairs. The object will be spawned already activated if you have used the new un-bugged pedestal

If this happens on the door leading to the last cube, using console command movetoqt then the quest id will relocate your character to the quest arrows on the map. Do this repeatedly and recollect the 3 cubes you've used (2 in main area, 1 in aqueduct area next to Neloth). Use the command again and it will take you to the one behind the bugged door. Collect it and use the command one last time and it will take you back out to the main area where you just grabbed the 2. Put them back and head back toward the aqueduct area. Neloth will be coming out and the quest will continue properly from there.
Sometimes, leaving the area, fast travelling anywhere and then returning may also fix the problem.
PS4 - Returning to the main chamber and using the last cube on a boiler and then returning may allow the pedestal to be activated.
You may retrieve the first four cubes, but will only have three in your inventory. If this happens, all the previous rooms will flood. You must have four cubes to proceed.
Reload a previous save.

A Control Cube can be removed from one of the two that lowered the water level. The scavenged cube can be used to start the steam engines (objective 40, stage 230) before the water level raises again.
Neloth may linger outside of Nchardak, not moving with you or toward the entrance.
Killing and resurrecting him through the console will cause him to continue following you.
You may not be able to lower the three bridges in the aqueduct room.
Fast traveling with this quest active may cause crashes

quick: Go to Four Skull Lookout and acquire the Crusader's armor.
Equip any piece of the armor.
If required, pray at each of the nine shrines.

paragraphs: Start the quest by equipping any piece of Crusader's armor, found at Four Skull Lookout, between Karthwasten and Karthspire. If your Infamy (see notes) is higher than 0, and you are wearing a relic of the crusader, this quest will be started on an independent 12 hour cycle, or when any relic is updated (equipped/unequipped) with the following message: "Your crimes have made you unfit to wield the Crusader's Relics. Make the pilgrimage to repent your sins and once again seek the favor of the gods."
Once the quest has started, you will be required to cleanse your soul by visiting the various shrines, similar to the Oblivion quest.

All items may be equipped and unequipped freely, regardless of your Infamy. However, the active effect 'Relics of the Crusader' will impose Health and Stamina 300 regeneration penalties and Carry Weight is reduced by 100 while you are 'unfit'.

The shrines of Arkay and Stendarr are the easiest to find as they have a map marker for them. The shrine of Julianos is the hardest, as it just barely emerges from the snow and only a half-buried skeleton is there to mark it.

stages.text: I have committed acts that have made me unfit to wear the Crusader's Relics. I will need to make a pilgrimage to nine shrines in order to repent. Objective 10: Pray at the shrines (0/9)

notes: Infamy is the total of your: Murders + Assaults + Pockets Picked + Horses Stolen + Items Stolen + Trespasses + Jail Escapes.
Trespasses and Assaults are the main ways players can quickly become frustrated by the armor, due to being put into situations that are not usually considered morally wrong.
Examples include:

-Initiating combat, or using a negative spell effect against a target who has not been marked in red on the compass, even if they are actively committing a crime like attacking civilians, The entry sequence in Markarth is an example, as are dragon attacks. Some enemies who are always inherently hostile can be attacked without consequence, though there are exceptions most would not expect, like many bandits technically being "neutral" and only being "hostile" when you get too close
-Your follower/summon/horse doing the above listed "crime" (it will count towards you.)
-Using dragonrend on a target that has not been marked in red on the compass. (including Alduin the World-Eater)
-Attacking a resting draugr (sometimes, inconsistent).
-"Trespassing" in Hod's home when it's open, much like the Dragonsreach Jarl's Quarters. (it's not usually counted as trespassing once you gain affinity with the related owners)
-Trespassing in the Thalmor embassy.
-Killing Astrid when she abducts you.
-Cannibalism/feeding as a vampire (this one actually makes sense but may not always be considered as most players would not think it would count as assault)
Some actions notably do not increase these infamy values like one might expect. These can be helpful for players that are committed to using this armor long term.
Examples include:
-Lockpicking or opening locks using the Tower Stone ability, or Fenrik's Welcome.
-Melee Killcams will not count as assaults (but will count as murder if the target was innocent)
-Killing Grelod the Kind is not murder or assault if killed with a melee killcam.
-Transforming into a werewolf/vampire lord, because transformations add to a bounty directly rather than being counted as a crime in the statistics page (though feeding usually counts as assault.)
-Other actions that add a bounty but change nothing else in the crime statistics page. (notably some quests will do this)

The armor will not always start the Pilgrims Path quest immediately when you reach your 1 infamy limit, though will almost always update once you equip/re-equip a new piece of armor. This can make the armor seem even more unfair and arbitrary.
If you get too close to a shrine, the regular effect may be triggered and your progress won't update. If this happens, step back from the shrine a little and try again.

The quest can restart while it is already in progress if your Infamy increases. This will cause all of your current shrine progress to reset, but those shrines will no longer be displayed as quest targets.
In the Console, use the setstage X where X is the index of the location, as displayed in the table, above.
The quest can clear the map while it is in progress. This will retain your current shrine progress, but other shrines will no longer be displayed as quest targets.
The quest can restart while it is already in progress without an increase in infamy. This will cause all of your current shrine progress to reset.
Worshipping at the Shrine of Mara may not register, requiring you to use the console to complete the quest.
The Shrine of Dibella incorrectly gives the Blessing of Akatosh.Mod Notes: POIReach16, ccMTYSSE001_ShrineActivator doesn't have the custom properties set on the TempleBlessingScript.

The quest will trigger if anything causes a criminal act to be registered, even other bugs. For example, attacking a sleeping Draugr will erroneously incur an assault bounty, triggering the quest when any relic is re-equipped.
The quest will trigger even while doing a quest objective that requires a crime.
The quest can apparently restart even after completion, even if you have not gained any infamy since completing it, even if all you do is wield one of the weapons to try and put it on a weapon rack.

quick: Exit the dungeon.
(Optional) Search the dungeon for more information.
Defeat the Pit Fighter.
Defeat the sabrecats.
Defeat the Champion.
(Optional) Take the champion's treasures.
Escape the Pit.
Retrieve your belongings.

walkthrough.heading: The Pit Dungeon
paragraphs: After you choose the power option during A Dying Wish, you will pass out and awaken in a dungeon only wearing ragged robes and ragged boots. Exit the cell and you can explore the hallway and other cells. One cell has a dead hunter in it, and another a dead Thalmor soldier with a full set of Elven light armor. You can also pick up a set of iron armor and a health potion on the table in the main hallway. The optional objective "Search the dungeon for more information" refers to Prisoner's Note, in a bucket in one of the cells.

walkthrough.heading: The Pit
paragraphs: As you enter the arena, you will have to fight a Pit Fighter and a wolf. Once they have been killed, the two sabre cats will be released from their cages and you will have to kill them. The pit champion, Neski Skull-Sabre will then enter the arena, kill her and you can then loot her body for the Bittercup, Grand Champion's Sword, and the Grand Champion's Helm. She also carries the note On the Bittercup.

There is a large number of dead bodies laying about the pit, these are; a Breton, hunter, reaver, master vampire, Khajiit, Wood Elf, and the corpse of an Imperial soldier. There are also two skeletons that can be looted as well.

walkthrough.heading: Watchtower Barracks
paragraphs: You will then have to pull the lever next to the door in order to enter the Watchtower Barracks. Climb the stairs and you will have to enter the room on the left in order to kill the Pit Boss and the two Pit Bandits. Loot the pit boss for the pit key, which can be used to retrieve your belongings from the chest in the previous room with an iron door. There is also a note next to the chest, with a flawless diamond, amethyst and an emerald on top of it.
You can then unlock the door to Skyrim, where you will be near the Falkreath Watchtower. The quest will then be complete.

stages.text: I passed out after performing a ritual at a hagraven altar, only to wake up in a dungeon. A note seems to imply I'll need to fight my way out, using whatever weapons I can find.

I passed out after performing a ritual at a hagraven altar, only to wake up in a dungeon. With no context on where I am or how I got here, I'll need to figure out how to escape. Objective 10: Exit the dungeon Objective 15: (Optional) Search the dungeon for more information

I passed out after performing a ritual at a hagraven altar, only to wake up in a dungeon. After walking out of the prison area, I found myself in an arena face to face with a pit fighter. Objective 20: Defeat the Pit Fighter

I passed out after performing a ritual at a hagraven altar, only to wake up in a dungeon. After walking out of the prison area, I found myself in an arena face to face with a pit fighter, and killed him. The fight was far from over, however, as two sabre cats were subsequently released from their cages. Objective 30: Defeat the sabrecats

I passed out after performing a ritual at a hagraven altar, only to wake up in a dungeon. Upon walking out of the prison area, I found myself in an arena fighting both mortals and beasts. After finishing off the first two waves, I must now defeat the arena champion. Objective 60: Defeat the champion Objective 65: (Optional) Take the champion's treasures

I passed out after performing a ritual at a hagraven altar, only to wake up in a dungeon. Upon walking out of the prison area, I found myself in an arena fighting both man and beast. After finishing off the champion, the other bandits reacted poorly. I should find a way out of here using the champion's doorway. Objective 70: Escape the Pit

I passed out after performing a ritual at a hagraven altar, only to wake up in a dungeon. Upon walking out of the prison area, I found myself in an arena fighting both man and beast. After finishing off the champion, the other bandits reacted poorly. I escaped their arrows and entered the barracks. I should now look for my belongings. Objective 80: Retrieve your belongings

I passed out after performing a ritual at a hagraven altar, only to wake up in a dungeon. Upon walking out of the prison area, I found myself in an arena fighting both man and beast. After finishing off the champion, I entered the barracks and retrieved my belongings.

I passed out after performing a ritual at a hagraven altar, only to wake up in a dungeon. Upon walking out of the prison area, I found myself in an arena fighting both man and beast. After finishing off the champion, I entered the barracks, retrieved my belongings, and escaped the fortress.

notes: In the Pit, most attacks can be avoided by jumping on top of the hay stacks, especially while battling Neski.
It is possible to use the Ritual Stone to reanimate the dead bodies. At lower levels, this will make the fight significantly easier.
All belongings that can't be dropped will stay in the inventory, which could prove useful.

The upper gallery containing archers seems to be inaccessible. But after regaining your equipment you can wreak vengeance on them from below, for example with a bow or by conjuring an ally at the gallery level, or use destruction spell Unbounded Storms.

quick: Enter the Ragged Flagon through the Ratway.
Meet Karliah in the Ragged Flagon.
Speak with Brynjolf in the Ragged Flagon.
Go to the backyard of Riftweald Manor.
(Optional) Deal with Vald.
Enter the house through the top door.
Go to Mercer's office.
Take the plans.
Return to Brynjolf.

walkthrough.heading: A Thief Among Thieves
paragraphs: Head to the Ragged Flagon through The Ratway. Meet Karliah after entering through the door to the Ragged Flagon and follow her as she leads you to the Cistern, where Brynjolf, Delvin and Vex are waiting with knives drawn. Karliah pleads clemency and hands over the journal you translated in the previous quest as proof of her innocence. Brynjolf is shocked at the revelations contained within and determines that they must open the vault to see the truth. Follow them as they head to the vault and watch as Delvin and Brynjolf use their respective keys to open it. As soon as the doors open, Brynjolf will let out a cry of horror at seeing the place completely empty; not a single gold coin is left. While Delvin is distraught at seeing their fortune gone, Vex's reaction is more violent; she pulls her dagger out and vows to kill their treacherous Guildmaster immediately. Brynjolf manages to calm the situation and asks to talk to you after assigning the other two to keep an eye out for Mercer. Tell him everything and he'll instruct you to break into Mercer's home to look for clues. However, the place is guarded by a Nord lout named Vald who is quite insistent on keeping people out. Brynjolf suggests you speak to Vex about him, since she was at one point intimately acquainted with Vald. Vex suggests the best course of action would be to erase Vald's debt with Maven Black-Briar or run him through and take what you need off his body. You must pass a hard-level Speech check to persuade him to give you the key.

If you don't wish to kill Vald yourself, and don't want to pay the debt, you can sneak to the back of the house and shoot the ramp contraption. Vald will become hostile and chase after you. Lead him to the marketplace or any other area with guards and they will kill Vald. Loot his body and take the key. It is also possible to climb up the exterior of the Temple of Mara, by jumping onto the braziers and from there scaling the roof. From there, you can use Whirlwind Sprint to reach the balcony without ever interacting with Vald.

walkthrough.heading: A Plot Revealed
paragraphs: Get a good vantage of the mechanism under the ramp and attack it using a ranged weapon (magic, bows, and shouts all work). The ramp will crash down, providing access to the second floor and the rest of the house.

The first room is unguarded. The next has a single guard who should be facing the west wall, allowing you to sneak past easily. The stairs down are to the northwest. At the bottom, another guard will be patrolling.

When you reach the bottom of the stairs, immediately face east and there will be closed doors. Head through them. On the northeastern corner to the barred front door you'll see a Suspicious Cabinet. Open it and then open the false back panel. Inside is a stairway down to the cellar, which leads to an underground system of tunnels.

After avoiding the pressure plate by the metal gate that you see when you first enter the tunnels, make a left and head south towards a room filled with circle-shaped traps. Looking at the tiles, head south two squares, west two squares, north two squares, west two squares, and south two squares in order to avoid the traps.

The hallway after the trap room has a pressure plate trap right around the corner that will launch a series of darts in front of the plate. Past this trap there is a chest on the right, which was on the other side of the metal gate at the beginning.

Following the hallway, you come to a hallway filled with timed pendulum blades and battering rams. Sprinting is a useful way to get past them. Once at the other end, head down the ramp and stop at the closed door. There is a dart trap trigger on the left side of the door. On the other side of the door are, among other things, Mercer's plans, a note titled Many Thanks, a copy of the Sneak skill book The Red Kitchen Reader, and Chillrend in a case. On the desk is the Bust of the Gray Fox, which can be sold to Delvin as part of The Litany of Larceny quest. There is also a stash of jewels hidden in the bowl on Mercer's desk.

Continue along the path until you reach the entrance to the Ratway Vaults. Fall down the hole (you may be attacked by some Vagrants and Lowlifes even if you had previously cleared the Ratway) and turn right to reach the Ragged Flagon. Return to Brynjolf and hand over the plans.

stages.text: I'm on my way back to the Ragged Flagon to meet up with Karliah. Using the information obtained from Gallus's journal as proof, I hope to convince Brynjolf of Karliah's innocence and Mercer Frey's betrayal. Objective 10: Meet Karliah at the Ragged Flagon
Objective 20: Follow Karliah

Brynjolf has been convinced of Karliah's innocence and Mercer's betrayal after investigating the Guild's treasure vault and finding it empty. Of greater mystery is the fact that the vault can only be opened with two keys and is utterly impervious to lockpicking. How Mercer Frey could have breached it is a mystery to us all. Objective 30: Speak to Brynjolf
The hunt is on and I'm on my way to Riftweald Manor, Mercer Frey's estate in Riften, to locate a clue as to his current whereabouts. Objective 40: Infiltrate Mercer's House
Objective 42: (Optional) Speak to Vex about Vald
Objective 50: Discover evidence of Mercer's location
I've discovered some plans in Riftweald Manor. This must be where Mercer Frey is headed. I should bring these the [sic] Brynjolf as soon as possible. Objective 60: Speak to Brynjolf

Brynjolf is convinced Mercer Frey intends to perform one final heist before departing Skyrim for good. According to the plans I discovered in Riftweald Manor, he's after the "Eyes of the Falmer," two gems of enormous value. If we have any hopes of intercepting Mercer, we need to proceed to their location immediately.

notes: If Vald's debt has been cleared by fetching Maven her quill and you decide to go with Brynjolf's suggestion of shooting down the ramp to the second floor, Vald becomes hostile upon seeing you for "missing" the shot.

Three leveled generic bandits guard the inside of the house. However, three unique NPCs might've once been meant for this task. Three Nord bandits named Hrolmir, Skeggr, and Reves exist in the files, but they are very unfinished. All of their editor IDs are prefixed with TG07, though, the internal identification of the quest.
It is possible to scale the roof of Riftweald Manor and approach the balcony from above, negating the need to activate the ramp.
The quest marker in Riftweald Manor is not positioned at the quest target and is thus not useful here.
Vald and the Marauders will attack each other if you lure the Marauders out of the house.
Members of the Thieves Guild will have varying reactions if you attempt to talk to them before proving Karliah's innocence.

If you loot Mercer's Plans from Riftweald Manor prior to completing Hard Answers you will be unable to progress through The Pursuit. Instead Karliah will stand outside Snow Veil Sanctum and not move or speak with you.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.0, addresses this issue. The barrel people were using to gain early access to Mercer's house has been moved to avoid this from happening.
Dropping the plans and entering console command setstage tg07 10 will start the quest normally.
When Brynjolf goes to open the vault door, it may already be open. This was likely because the door wasn't owned by him and so could be pushed open by any NPC who wandered too close.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.4, fixes this bug.

It's possible that Vald won't come talk to you at the gate when you bring him the note to clear his debt, becoming hostile towards you instead. This can occur if you've walked too close to the yard after the quest has started, but before erasing Vald's debt.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.4, fixes this bug.
You may be unable to lower the ramp to Riftweald Manor.

The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.5, addresses this issue. The trigger enabler needed to be on its own enable marker in order to avoid being disabled when Vald's triggers get turned off after freeing him from his debt.
If you have picked the lock to Mercer's back yard, Vald will be hostile and offer no talk option for the peaceful solution.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.1.1, addresses this issue. The gate has been set to only open with the house key.
To fix this, close the gate and wait outside the yard until he stands in front of you, then talk to him through the gate.
It is possible to tell Vald you erased his debt even if you had not yet been to Maven Black-Briar to turn in the Quill of Gemination.
The Unofficial Skyrim Legendary Edition Patch, version 3.0.1, addresses this issue. A bad stage check on one of the dialogue lines in this quest was responsible for that.
If you kill Vald, there is a chance his corpse may linger in Mercer's backyard forever.
The Unofficial Skyrim Legendary Edition Patch, version 3.0.8, addresses this issue. Vald's corpse had no cleanup script assigned.
If you enter Riftweald Manor prior to starting the quest, Mercer's Plans may already be present in the treasure room.

The Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch, version 4.3.7, addresses this issue. The note will now be disabled until the quest has begun. The fix from USKP 1.0 that blocked roof access prior to the quest has also been undone.

If you accept a quest from Vex after the vault but before you talk to Brynjolf, you may not be able to speak to her about Vald. Though there will be a quest marker above her head, you will not get the option when speaking to her.

There's a chance that neither the front or back gates to Riftweald Manor will become accessible, nor can the ramp be shot down by an arrow. Vald will also refuse to talk to you regardless of whether or not you complete Vald's Debt quest. If this happens, the only way to proceed forward is to scale the rooftops to the upper balcony, where the ramp would have fallen if shot by arrow. This is the only door that will open.
It is possible to release the ramp using the console command activate 4ec0b

The quest will fail to properly update to stage 50 if you enter Riftweald Manor any way other than the door at the top of the ramp. To prevent this, make sure you enter or exit the manor from that door before going into the treasure room and picking up Mercer's plans.

quick: Talk to Wujeeta after completing the Helping Hand quest.
Report to the jarl about the presence of a skooma dealer in town.
"Deal" with Sarthis Idren, and find evidence to locate his sources.
Return to the jarl with the evidence.

walkthrough.heading: Illegal Trade
paragraphs: After completing the Helping Hand quest, you can ask Wujeeta where she obtained her skooma. She is not forthcoming with the details, however you can pass an easy-level Speech check to persuade her to tell you the truth.
At last, she will reveal her supplier as Sarthis Idren and his base as Riften Warehouse. She explains that the warehouse is always locked and that only the jarl has a key.

The next step is to report the presence of a skooma dealer to the jarl. The current jarl in Riften will acknowledge Sarthis and his illegal operations. However, the dealer has informants in the town guard because he disappears every time they raid the warehouse. Perhaps, an outsider may be able to surprise Sarthis in the warehouse, and "'convince' him to close down his operation". If you accept the mission, you will be given the Riften Warehouse Key to unlock the warehouse.

walkthrough.heading: The Raid
paragraphs: The warehouse is located at the southern end of Riften's docks. Orini Dral is patrolling the warehouse, and will immediately spot you. Sarthis is in the basement and will come rushing upstairs to aid his bodyguard. Orini is a modest opponent, but Sarthis can prove a difficult opponent to defeat.

When they are dead, loot Sarthis' body for his key. Descend the stairs in the northeastern corner, turn around and use the key to unlock the door. On the shelves there are five bowls of moon sugar and six bottles of skooma. On the table there is another bowl of moon sugar and two bottles of skooma. Inside Sarthis' satchel there is a note with information regarding Sarthis' sources. Make sure to read the note to advance the quest.

walkthrough.heading: It's Not Over Yet
paragraphs: Return to the jarl with the evidence and news of Sarthis' demise. The jarl will be grateful, saying, "It's nice to receive good news for a change", but will ask you to continue the crusade, which starts the next quest.

stages.text: Objective 10: Identify Riften's skooma dealer
Objective 20: Report Sarthis Idren to the Jarl of Riften
Objective 30: Enter Riften Warehouse
Objective 40: Eliminate Sarthis Idren
Objective 50: Recover skooma source information
(Starts Supply and Demand)

notes: If Wujeeta dies before you report the skooma dealer to the jarl, you will fail the quest, making it impossible to become thane of the Rift regardless of who the jarl is.
If Sarthis is killed by anyone other than you, you will fail the quest. The key and the note can still be obtained, but no relevant dialogue option will be available from the jarl to proceed.
If you manage to sneak past or Calm Orini, you can spare his life. Only Sarthis has to die for the quest to progress.
This is the second of three required quests that are required to unlock the option to become Thane of the Rift. There are additional requirements noted on that quest page.
The penultimate objective, "Recover skooma source information", will only register as completed if you read the note, unlike most other objectives of this type which only require you to take a note.
Despite Laila Law-Giver telling you to deal with Sarthis 'discreetly', stealth is not required to succeed in the quest.
Even though you were given a key by the jarl, and it is occupied by enemies, you will be considered to be trespassing in the warehouse. If you have a follower they will react as such.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.3.2, fixes this bug.
Due to an engine limitation (see this discussion), the player will still incur an increment in their "Trespasses" stat after reading the note.

There is a way to enter without it counting as trespassing. When you open the door, before you enter, immediately open the menu and make a fast travel. You will see that you will still enter the warehouse. Then load the game that was saved by making the fast travel. You will be in front of the door but now it will be open. Turn into a werewolf and access the warehouse. It will no longer count as trespassing.
If your follower insists on reporting you for stealing the note, you will need to exit the warehouse to ask them to wait.
The quest marker may be stuck at "Recover skooma source information" and point to the apothecary's satchel, even after you have killed Sarthis yourself and taken the Shipment's Ready note.
Reading the note should advance the quest as normal.

quick: Read The Restless at The Winking Skeever.
Gain access to the cell in Castle Dour Dungeon by whatever means necessary and read Kevon's Note. Take the map.
Travel to Orphan's Tear and find the boat to Blackbone Isle.
Enter Blackbone Isle Grotto and take Cyrus' Boots, Cyrus' Clothes, and Cyrus' Sabre.
Fight your way back out to the boat.

walkthrough.heading: A Pirate's Life
paragraphs: To begin this quest, you will need to go to The Winking Skeever in Solitude. On one of the tables inside, you will find a book titled The Restless which describes the later life of Cyrus, the protagonist of The Elder Scrolls Adventures: Redguard. It mentions Blackbone Isle, a long-lost island in the Sea of Ghosts said to house an ancient treasure. The last person to visit the island reportedly died in the nearby Castle Dour dungeons.

Head to the dungeons in order to figure out how to gain access to the cell containing the pirate's corpse. You can speak to a Solitude Guard seated outside the cell and pass an easy Persuasion skill check to convince him to open the cell for you. A starting level character of any race can pass this speech check by activating the Shrine of Dibella in the Temple of the Divines just outside. Alternatively, you can commit a crime yourself and get thrown in jail, although there are obviously some disadvantages to using this method. Once inside, you will find the skeletal corpse of Kevon next to a note you need to read. It will reveal that a map to Blackbone Isle can be found beneath a loose brick within the cell wall. Grab it and head for the coast.

walkthrough.heading: Old Pirate Den
paragraphs: Your next destination after escaping Castle Dour is a coastal shipwreck known as Orphan's Tear. Although this location is usually inhabited by bandits, on this occasion you will encounter a gang of Blackwater Brigands led by Celeste. This encounter will actually add an unnamed miscellaneous objective to your journal directing you to kill Celeste and claim her unique sword, the Blackwater Blade. This is secondary to the current quest, but you will likely end up killing Celeste in any case as the brigands are hostile and are guarding the only boat to Blackbone Isle.

Once the threat has been neutralized, activate the small boat to sail to Blackbone Isle. The entirety of the small island consists of a shoreline crawling with undead; indeed, you will likely be attacked the minute you arrive. You may explore the island's exterior if you wish, but the quest will direct you to the entrance of Blackbone Isle Grotto located right next to the boat. The grotto is similarly filled with undead, and houses a well preserved ship named Dead Man's Dread. Fight your way through the ship's undead inhabitants until you reach the captain's quarters on the lower level. Here you will find the Captain's Journal explaining the fate of the ship, as well as Cyrus' Sabre hanging above the desk. Take the sabre, and loot the chest next to the captain's bed to obtain Cyrus' Clothes and Cyrus' Boots. All three of these relics of Cyrus need to be taken to progress the quest.

Attempting to leave the ship with your new items, you will quickly discover that angry Ghost Sailors have arisen to defend their final resting place. Fight your way back to the entrance and face the Ghost Captain out on the deck of the ship. With all the spirits defeated, you can safely make your way back to the boat and leave Blackbone Isle.

walkthrough.heading: A New Player Home
paragraphs: Although the quest formally concludes after making your escape, you will soon receive a mysterious note from a "restless soul" via courier, advising you to convert Dead Man's Dread into a player home. Return to the ship via the boat at Orphan's Tear to complete this objective and claim the island as your own. The ship contains several crafting stations and storage containers, as well as multiple copies of the unique clothing items added by the Creation.

You will also find a map inside the ship that can be used for instant transport to Solitude, Dawnstar and Windhelm. You can also unlock the two other markers on the map to allow travel to Castle Volkihar (technically Icewater Jetty) and Raven Rock by first discovering these locations.

stages.text: I've heard stories of lost shipwrecks strewn across the Sea of Ghosts. If I head to the Winking Skeever in Solitude, I may be able to find more information on there [sic] whereabouts. Objective 10: Browse books at the Winking Skeever

I've heard stories of lost shipwrecks strewn across the Sea of Ghosts. At the Winking Skeever in Solitude, I found a lead on a ship said to have traveled to Blackbone Isle. Apparently, the last person to visit the island died in Castle Dour Dungeon. Objective 20: Find the pirate's corpse in Castle Dour Dungeon Objective 5: (Optional) Convince the guard to give you access to the jail cell Objective 15: (Optional) Get arrested and go to jail in Solitude

At the Winking Skeever in Solitude, I found a lead on a ship said to have traveled to Blackbone Isle. Apparently, the last person to visit the island died in Castle Dour Dungeon. I found his corpse which hinted at the location of a hidden map. Objective 25: Examine the loose brick

At the Winking Skeever in Solitude, I found a lead on a ship said to have traveled to Blackbone Isle. Apparently, the last person to visit the island died in Castle Dour Dungeon. I found his corpse and the map he hid under a loose brick. I'll need a boat to travel to the location, perhaps I can find a spare at the wreck near Orphan's Tear. Objective 30: Find a spare boat and travel to Blackbone Isle
After finding the map to Blackbone Isle, I traveled to the remote location using a boat at Orphan's Tear. Objective 40: Investigate Blackbone Isle
After finding the map to Blackbone Isle, I traveled to the remote location using a boat at Orphan's Tear. After entering a cave, I found Dead Man's Dread docked inside the grotto.

After finding the map to Blackbone Isle, I traveled to the remote location using a boat at Orphan's Tear. After entering a cave, I found Dead Man's Dread docked inside the grotto. Inside the ship were two items of note, Cyrus' Sabre and outfit. Objective 50: Escape the grotto

After finding the map to Blackbone Isle, I traveled to the remote location using a boat at Orphan's Tear. After entering a cave, I found Dead Man's Dread docked inside the grotto. Inside the ship were two items of note, Cyrus' Sabre and outfit, which were protected by guardians of the ship. I managed to escape the grotto with both items.
Objective 10: Kill the Blackwater Brigand Boss
Objective 20: Retrieve the Blackwater Blade
Objective 10: Read the pirate's note
Objective 20: Claim Dead Man's Dread

notes: Originally, this quest was automatically added to your journal upon installing the Dead Man's Dread Creation. This was updated with the release of the Anniversary Edition, and you are now required to locate the book yourself to begin the quest.

You will only encounter undead in the exterior areas of Blackbone Isle if you have either the Bone Wolf or Plague of the Dead Creations installed. If you have neither Creation installed, the island will instead be inhabited by six harmless rabbits.
The Ghost Captain and the other spirits will not follow you below deck. This can be exploited by running back inside the ship to heal.
The skeleton of Kevon is in the same cell as the Crumbling Mortar and can still be used to escape if it has never been used beforehand

Blackbone Isle has a map marker to fast travel to the location but once there you can only leave either via the rowboat or, after claiming the ship with the Pirate's Note, a map on a table aboard the ship will give an additional option to fast travel to four different ports back on Skyrim.
If you are arrested, the optional objective won't be marked as complete until you move further away from the door than where you start.

quick: Reach level 5 and read the anonymous letter.
Travel to the ritual site north of Southfringe Sanctum.
Find and read the Necromancer's Journal to complete the quest.

paragraphs: After reaching level 5, a courier will approach you and deliver an anonymous letter. Read the letter to learn that a group of Necromancers plan to perform an ancient, dangerous summoning ritual to conjure an army of zombies. The ritual site is located high in the mountains southeast of Helgen, just north of Southfringe Sanctum (map).

Once you arrive at the ritual site, you will find a group of decomposing zombies standing over the bodies of the slain Necromancers. Clearly the ritual was successful, but the Necromancers lost control of their summoned undead. Defeat the zombies and approach the body of the Necromancer marked by the quest marker. He will be holding a leveled spell tome (Spell Tome: Conjure Zombie for lower levels, or Spell Tome: Conjure Foul Zombie for levels 11+) as well as a journal. Read the journal to complete the quest and learn of the consequences of the ritual. You can also loot the area for two additional copies of Spell Tome: Conjure Zombie.
Following the conclusion of the quest, you will have a chance to encounter zombie horde world interactions randomly in the wilderness.

stages.text: I've found an urgent anonymous letter. I should read it and see what it's regarding. Objective : Read the Anonymous Letter

I've received an anonymous letter asking me to help stop a group of Necromancers who are planning to raise an army of Zombies. I should investigate the ritual site. Objective : Investigate the Ritual Site
Read the Necromancer's Journal Objective : Read the Necromancer's Journal

I found the Necromancer's ritual site, but it's too late. I also found a journal detailing what transpired here. They appear to have already conjured the risen dead, possibly across all of Skyrim. I'll need to be vigilant, especially during the late night hours.

notes: At release, this quest had no level requirement and the anonymous letter would be automatically added to your inventory upon installation. This was changed in Patch 1.6 with the release of the Anniversary Edition.
The unmarked location "The Headless Skeleton" can also be found here, with it being next to the pine tree.

quick: To start this quest head to the Frozen Hearth inn within Winterhold.
Go inside and into one of the rooms to find Seeks-Ancient-Artifacts' Journal, v1.
Head to the Frostroot Cave and find the Nchuanthumz entrance.
Access Nchuanthumz's Manufactory
Find the Argonian Seeks-Ancient-Artifacts's body near a control panel. Examine the corpse for clues.
Read Seeks-Ancient-Artifacts' Journal, v2.
Use one of the two buttons to activate the Dwarven Sphere Overseer.
Collect 3 Dwemer Cogs, 3 Dwemer Actuators and a Dwemer Oil.
Return to the Dwarven Sphere Overseer and bring the manufactory back online.
Collect a Centurion Dynamo Core and use it to construct a Dwarven Spider Renovator.
Summon the Dwarven Spider Renovator to clean a section of the house.
Wait 24 hours for the renovations to finish. A few rooms will be fully renovated and furnished.
Repeat this 2 more times to fully renovate the home.

paragraphs: Go to The Frozen Hearth in Winterhold, Seeks-Ancient-Artifacts' Journal, v1 is on a table in the left room when facing to the innkeeper, read it to start the quest. Quest maker will direct to Frostroot Cave. Head to and enter the cave, fight three bandits and walk along a short way to Nchuanthumz.

Once you enter Nchuanthumz, head straight and deal with a few skeevers and three bandits until you reach the lift to Nchuanthumz's Manufactory. Use the lift and then continue straight forward until you reach the corpse of Seeks-Ancient-Artifacts, examine the body to find a Dwemer Actuator and his second journal.

The journal lists the items required to repair the assembly lines, with the required items being one Dwarven oil, three Dwemer cogs, and three Dwemer Actuators. The room already contains everything you need. You should already have one Dwemer Actuator from Artifacts' own inventory; the other two are on the two tables on either side of the room, alongside the cogs and the oil. Collect all the required items and activate the Dwarven Sphere Overseer button. The quest markers will direct you to press either the right or left button to do so.

The Dwarven Sphere Overseer will emerge from the scuttle on the right side of the room. Follow the Dwarven Sphere Overseer and give it the repair parts by interacting with it. You can then activate the manufactory; if you already have a Centurion Dynamo Core then you can head straight to the room on the left, however if you don't have one, go to the room on the west side of the manufactory to find a destroyed Dwarven Centurion Master, whose body has a core on it.

Place the Centurion Dynamo Core into the Dynamo Actuator and then activate the button next to it. This will build a Dwarven Spider Renovator, head back to the lift and go back up to Nchuanthumz. There are three sections of the house to clear with the spider, each takes 24 hours once the spider is summoned using one of the levers. Once all three sections are complete, the quest will finish and you will have a fully furnished Dwarven house.

stages.text: Travelers throughout Skyrim have discovered ancient Dwemer ruins full of perilous traps and buried treasure. I've heard rumors, however, of one such sanctuary being used as a home. I should check the surrounding inns for clues on its whereabouts. Objective 5: Search for information at The Frozen Hearth

I have discovered the journal of an Argonian named Seeks-Ancient-Artifacts. It details an expedition to Skyrim to find a lost Dwemer sanctuary, Nchuanthumz. If I travel to Frostroot Cave, I might be able to pick up their trail. Objective 10: Discover Nchuanthumz

I've discovered Nchuanthumz but did not find the expedition team. Perhaps if I gain access to his partner's Manufactory, I can learn what happened to them. Objective 30: Access Nchuanthumz's Manufactory
I've made my way into Nchuanthumz Manufactory and can now explore the area to see what secrets are inside. Objective 40: Explore the Manufactory

I've made my way into Nchuanthumz Manufactory and can now explore the area to see what secrets are inside. Near a control panel, I found a dead Argonian explorer. I should inspect his body for clues. Objective 50: Examine the corpse for clues

I've made my way into Nchuanthumz Manufactory and can now explore the area to see what secrets are inside. Near a control panel, I found an Argonian explorer with a journal on his body. Objective 54: Read Seek-Ancient-Artifacts' journal

Inside Nchuanthumz Manufactory, I found an Argonian explorer with a journal on his body. It detailed how I might be able to summon a dwarven sphere overseer and provide it with the parts needed to repair the assembly lines in the manufactory in order to bring it fully online. Objective 49: Summon the Dwarven Sphere Overseer Objective 55: Collect Dwemer Cogs for the Manufactory (0/3) Objective 56: Collect Dwemer Actuators for the Manufactory (0/3) Objective 57: Collect Dwemer Oil for the Manufactory (0/1) Objective 58: Return the collected parts to the Dwarven Sphere Overseer

I provided the dwarven sphere overseer with the requisite parts and can now bring the manufactory back online. I should be able to use the manufactory to restore the sanctuary using the constructs that can be built there. Objective 60: Turn on the Manufactory

The Nchuanthumz Manufactory is now online. I can build a spider construct at the assembly line using a centurion dynamo core. With the spider construct, I can use it to further restore the sanctuary on the ground floor. Objective 80: Construct a Dwarven Spider Renovator

Using the Nchuanthumz Manufactory assembly line, I built a spider construct to help renovate the house. Once I summon it using the levers on the ground floor of the sanctuary, I must wait a full day for renovations to complete. Objective 90: Summon the Dwarven Spider Renovator to clean a section of the house Objective 70: Wait 24 hours for the renovations to finish

Using the Nchuanthumz Manufactory assembly line, I built a spider construct to help renovate the house. After summoning the construct on the main level of the ruin, I was able to fully restore the home.

quick: Find Selveni Nethri trapped in webs in Southfringe Sanctum and cut her down.
Help her escape the cave.

walkthrough.heading: Caught in a Web
paragraphs: When exploring Southfringe Sanctum you will find a Dunmer conjurer named Selveni Nethri trapped in a spider's web. Obviously she is frantic to escape and pleads with you to cut her down.

walkthrough.heading: A Cursed Necromancer
paragraphs: Apparently Selveni's dealings as a necromancer resulted in her daughter being taken from her and sent to the orphanage in Riften. Selveni had gone to Riften to see if she could get her daughter out, but learned her daughter had already been moved. When she returned to the coven, Bashnag accused her of trying to sell him out to the Thalmor. She was cursed and chased off. Because of the curse she has been weakened and can't cast a spell to save her life. She isn't able to escape the Sanctum until the way out is safe, and she is desperate to locate her missing daughter.

walkthrough.heading: Clear the Way
paragraphs: You have probably already faced the many resident frostbite spiders on your way in. While it isn't necessary to kill Bashnag and all his fellow spellswords to ensure her safety, the quest will fail if Selveni dies before escaping. Let her know when the way out is clear. She will thank you and move along the path in the spider area to get out of the cave by herself. When she has exited the cave, the quest will be completed. There is no follow-up to this quest, as Selveni's daughter does not appear anywhere in Skyrim and Selveni herself disappears for good once she is out of your sight.

notes: There are numerous internal references that show many changes to this quest. Originally, it took place in Boulderfall Cave (which is also referred to as Boulderfall Pass), and Selveni was to be a werewolf, rather than a necromancer.

An unused message internally known as dunSouthfringeQuestObjective also refers to this, it reads: "Help Selvani [sic] Nethri escape Boulderfall Pass." The name of this particular message "Pack Animals", might've originally been the name of the quest (as it isn't actually named in the final game's files), and seemingly referred to Selveni's lycanthropy.
She may refuse to move after being cut down.
Try talking to her until she moves. This might continue past any meaningful conversation, but she should eventually move.
In many cases, Selveni can get stuck near the entrance. Some things that can be tried to unstick her are:
Talk to her.
Use your equipment, spell, or shout to get her unstuck, such as Unrelenting Force, a Paralysis spell, or blocks.
Use the wait feature for one hour.

Leaving and reentering the location may also work. In that case, she will disappear from the cave, and the journal will update the quest as completed. You may be forced to go back to Southfringe Sanctum after a long time roaming other places to solve this quest with this method, though.
Hitting her with an arrow may also help push her towards the entrance. However, do not use a powerful bow and arrow combination or you will risk killing her.
Selveni may even escape but the quest journal indicates that it never completed.
This quest is set up as a Miscellaneous quest but increments the Side Quests achievement when it isn't supposed to.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 2.0.6, fixes this bug.

quick: Talk to Vex in The Ragged Flagon about shill jobs and receive the evidence.
Enter the house and put the item into the targeted chest.
Report back to Vex for your reward.

walkthrough.heading: A View to a Shill
paragraphs: After you are a full member of the Thieves Guild, you will want to start thieving for fun and profit. By now, you will have met Vex. She handles all the burglary, shill, sweep and heist jobs. In order to earn some gold and help Vex with her goal of restoring the Guild to its former glory, ask her for a shill job. She will inform you that a client has requested someone be taken out. Unlike the Dark Brotherhood, the guild does this by planting evidence in their home and tipping off the guard.

walkthrough.heading: The Plant
paragraphs: Vex will give you a stolen item that needs to be placed as evidence. The item is a randomly-selected gem or unenchanted piece of jewelry (circlet, necklace, or ring); see Leveled Lists for full details. The item is identical to a standard item, except that "Stolen" has been added to its name.
The quest can send you to any wealthy house, which amounts to twenty-nine possible houses. You may be assigned the same location more than once.

You need to enter the selected house undetected and find the designated chest. Open the chest and place the stolen item in it. Although there may be multiple containers in the house, only the chest indicated by your quest marker will work; if you attempt to put the stolen item into the wrong container, you will be told that you can't remove the item from your inventory. If you are sent to jail while the quest is active, for any reason, you will fail the quest. Getting caught in the house or killing anyone living in the house will also result in failing the quest. You are not responsible for tipping off the guards after placing the evidence.
Once you have planted the evidence, return to Vex for a leveled gold reward.

stages.text: Objective 10: Plant the <Alias=Evidence> in <Alias=WealthyHome> in <Alias=City>

I've been told to plant the <Alias=Evidence> in <Alias=WealthyHome> in <Alias=City>. I need to complete this job without killing any of the location's residents or getting caught and spending time in jail.
I've planted the <Alias=Evidence> in <Alias=WealthyHome> in <Alias=City>.
I've successfully completed the job and received my share of the pay.
By killing a resident at the task's location, I've failed this job and was forced to forfeit my share of the pay.
During the course of this task, I was arrested and sent to the local jail. I've therefore failed the job and was forced to forfeit my share of the pay.
Before the task could be completed, I decided to quit. I've therefore failed the job and forfeited any pay I might have received.

notes: Even if you complete the job successfully, there are no obvious repercussions for the person you have framed. They do not go to jail or otherwise become inaccessible.
If one of the house's occupants dies for any reason while the quest is active (even if you are not responsible), you will fail the quest.
Despite the Stolen indication in the item's name, the item given to you will not be flagged as stolen.

If you have already participated in the quest Battle for Whiterun it becomes impossible to enter some homes in Whiterun, namely Heimskr's House and Severio Pelagia's House. However, they can still be assigned as a possible quest destination.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.1, fixes this bug.
Quit the job and retake it for another location (you can load a previous save to avoid a failed quest if you wish).
You can use the console command coc, followed by the editor id of the house.

The chest you must plant the Stolen Flawless Ruby in Uthgerd's home may already contain a Flawless Ruby. If you steal the contents before planting the Stolen Flawless Ruby and already have a stolen flawless ruby in your inventory, it does not register that you have planted the one given to you by Vex. Placing the ruby in the chest that is labeled Stolen Flawless Ruby does nothing in regards to completing the quest objective, and taking it back out simply adds it to your already existing inventory of flawless rubies. If you autosave on travel, just reload the Uthgerd's House save and place your current flawless ruby inventory into another container or drop on the ground.
The "stolen item" might disappear from your inventory for no obvious reasons and you'll be unable to complete the quest.
To fix this, use setstage tgrdu 10 in the console and it will take the quest back to the stage that Vex gave your character the item.
Quit the job and retake it for another location (you can load a previous save to avoid a failed quest if you wish). This will give you a different item as evidence.
The item disappearing may be due to the item being a gem, and the stolen gem being used to smith a piece of jewelry.
These quests don't remove the planted evidence from the target chest when you finish them.
The Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch, version 4.3.7, fixes this bug.

quick: Meet Amaund Motierre inside Volunruud.
Take his letter and amulet to Astrid.
Take the amulet to Delvin Mallory.
Return to Astrid with the letter of credit.

walkthrough.heading: The Prodigal Returns
paragraphs: When you last left the Dark Brotherhood sanctuary, Astrid was still in turmoil regarding your sudden promotion to Listener, and the ensuing duties the role required. Once you have fulfilled any of the contracts Nazir gave you after completing Whispers in the Dark (Narfi, Beitild, Ennodius Papius, Hern, Lurbuk), go back to the sanctuary. Astrid will approach you and tell you that she has finished thinking. She agrees that it would be madness to just ignore the Night Mother's demands and tells you to travel to Volunruud to meet with Amaund Motierre.

walkthrough.heading: The Stars Aligned
paragraphs: When you enter Volunruud, a skeleton sits in a small alcove immediately to your left. It will attack you as you pass, so conduct a preemptive strike while it slumbers, or sneak past it. Near the skeleton are Heddic's Volunruud notes; reading them will start Volunruud's dungeon quest. Completing the quest gives you a word of Aura Whisper, a useful shout for assassins, but the quest is not necessary to meet Motierre. After the skeleton, the first room is straight ahead. There are three paths, but the one you want is the leftmost one. Open the door and you'll find the client waiting with Rexus, his bodyguard. Motierre will be impressed and a bit unnerved that you have arrived. He informs you that he has multiple targets in mind, all culminating in a shocking end--the assassination of the Emperor. The bodyguard will then give you two items: a valuable jeweled amulet "to cover expenses" and a sealed letter with further instructions to deliver to Astrid. Return to the sanctuary and deliver these items to Astrid.

walkthrough.heading: Back at the Sanctuary
paragraphs: When you return, Astrid is anxious to know the goings-on. When you tell her of Motierre's grand design, she will be excited by the prospect of such glory for the Brotherhood and starts with preparations. She wants to study the letter further, but in the meantime, asks you to take the amulet to Delvin Mallory, a Thieves Guild member located at the Ragged Flagon in the Ratway in Riften. She wants the amulet appraised and sold, if Mallory is interested.

walkthrough.heading: The Wheels in Motion
paragraphs: Upon inspecting the amulet, Mallory will inform you that it is a one-of-a-kind item and is only given to members of the Elder Council. He agrees to purchase it and hands you a letter of credit, which is to be delivered to Astrid—as per their "standard arrangement".

Return to Astrid with the letter. When you explain what Mallory told you about the amulet she will be delighted, musing that Motierre is probably a member of the Elder Council looking to get himself promoted. With that, she is all smiles and action; she informs you that the first step to completing the new directive will be for you to attend a wedding and assassinate the bride.

stages.text: I returned to Nazir, but he directed me to speak with Astrid immediately. Perhaps she's made up her mind about me seeing Amaund Motierre in Volundruud. [sic] Objective 5: Speak with Astrid

Astrid has agreed to let me see Amaund Motierre in the dungeon known as Volunruud, as commanded by the Night Mother. I'm to speak with Motierre, and find out what he wants. Objective 10: Speak with Amaund Motierre Objective 20: Deliver the letter and amulet to Astrid

Amaund Motierre has commissioned the Dark Brotherhood to kill several people, all of which will lead to the assassination of a primary target - the Emperor of Tamriel himself. I am to report this information back to Astrid. Objective 20: Deliver the letter and amulet to Astrid

I've given Astrid the amulet and sealed letter provided to me by Amaund Motierre. I'm to take the amulet to a fence named Delvin Mallory, in the Riften Ratway - to gain any information I can, and sell it if Mallory is willing to buy. Objective 30: Show the amulet to Delvin Mallory

Delvin Mallory has informed me that the amulet provided by Amaund Motierre indicates he is a member of the Emperor's Elder Council. Mallory was willing to purchase the amulet in exchange for a letter of credit, which I must now deliver to Astrid. Objective 40: Report back to Astrid
After meeting with Amaund Motierre, I learned he is a member of the Elder Council, and wants the Dark Brotherhood to kill several people, all of whom lead to a primary target - the Emperor himself.

notes: If you read the letter Amaund Motierre gives you inside Volunruud before delivering it to Astrid, she will mention it in conversation after showing it to her, criticizing your actions as "sloppy". This has no effect on the quest other than the additional dialogue.
You can directly go to Volunruud rather than speaking to Astrid first, but the quest won't start until she talks to you.
There is a chest in Amaund's chamber within the ruins which is free to loot, containing some leveled valuables and gold.
If you go to Amaund before getting the quest, the quest will not be altered. If you return to the Sanctuary, Astrid will simply tell you to go to Volunruud before ending the conversation.
Asking Astrid for more details on the wedding murder will have her speaking like the civil war is still ongoing, even if you've already completed that questline.
If you are a member of the Thieves Guild when you take the amulet to Mallory, he will ask if the assistance you need is for the guild, prompting you to say it is for the Dark Brotherhood instead.

quick: Talk to Skjor.
Meet with Skjor at night.
Enter the Underforge.
Participate in the blood ritual.
Talk to Aela the Huntress.
Kill the werewolf hunters.

walkthrough.heading: A Secret Meeting
paragraphs: After completing another set of radiant quests, the usual job providers will once again point you towards Skjor. Aela will say: "Still eager to please. This is good. Skjor may be right about you. He has something special planned for you. Better talk to him.", while Farkas and Vilkas will say: "Skjor was looking for you before. Talk to him before doing anything else."

Skjor turns out to be less talkative than usual and will request a meeting after dark near the Underforge, a secret crypt underneath the smithy of Eorlund Gray-Mane. At night, Skjor will wait for you near the secret entrance, determined to make you a stronger member of the Companions. He will then open the secret entrance and encourage you to follow.

Inside the Underforge, you will encounter Aela the Huntress in her lycanthropic form, standing next to an empty fountain. Skjor will introduce her as your 'forebear', and will inform you that this is to be kept secret from Harbinger Kodlak Whitemane, and will then ask if you are prepared. When you are ready, Skjor will cut open Aela's wrist, filling the fountain with her blood. Activate the fountain and receive the Beast Form power, which causes you to black out.

walkthrough.heading: Rampage
paragraphs: You wake up outside the Underforge, now as a werewolf, where you will find all of Whiterun's residents are now hostile to you. If you head into the streets, citizens will flee and guards will attack you, leaving you no choice but to avoid them or kill them. Due to your beastly appearance, you will not gain a bounty for assaulting anyone. After a certain amount of time, you will black out once again.
The easiest way to avoid unwanted casualties is to simply wait a while after exiting the Underforge, as this causes your werewolf bloodlust to wear off, and the next scene to continue.
Another option is to go back into the Underforge as soon as you've transformed, and use the secret exit that leads you out of the city.
You can also simply avoid any attackers if you do not wish to kill any people in the city, you'll black out regardless of whether you killed anyone or not.

walkthrough.heading: The Silver Hand
paragraphs: This time, you wake up in the middle of nowhere, with a concerned Aela looking over you. Your gear has been unequipped, but you haven't lost anything; simply re-equip to prepare for battle. Aela will congratulate you on surviving the initiation and inform you that the Silver Hand, a group of werewolf hunters, have inhabited Gallows Rock and will not hide the fact that they should be slaughtered right away. She also informs you that Skjor already entered the fort. From this point, Aela will act as your follower, dismissing your current follower if you have one. Head west towards the fort. A number of Silver Hand members will guard the exterior area, so dispose of them and enter the fort.

walkthrough.heading: Gallows Rock
paragraphs: The first room is a sealed-off area, so pull the chain next to the severed werewolf head and proceed forward. The fort is buzzing with enemies and werewolves in cages, both living and dead, all seemingly exposed to torture by their captors. Be on the lookout for the One-handed skill book The Importance of Where in the huge southern chamber, the Smithing skill book The Last Scabbard of Akrash near the workbench, as well as several locked and unlocked chests. Aela will comment on the first dead werewolf you find, which is found next to a set of rare Torture Tools.

When you reach the northwestern chamber, Aela will rightfully warn you about Silver Hand leader Krev the Skinner, so be prepared. When the chamber is cleared, a worried Aela will run up onto the podium and discover the dead body of Skjor, obviously killed due to his lycanthropy. Once you speak with her, the quest will end and you will have to find your own way out, through the door to the northeast that was previously barred. Three new radiant quests are now available back in Jorrvaskr and you will have to complete two of them (for Aela) before you can access the next major quest. However, if a certain amount of time has passed, you may only have to do one radiant quest to begin Blood's Honor.

walkthrough.heading: Achievements
paragraphs: One achievement is unlocked once you speak with Aela after surviving the initiation:
Blood Oath (10 points/Bronze) — Become a member of the Circle

stages.text: Aela and Skjor want to speak to me about some kind of special mission for the Companions. Objective 5: Talk to Skjor
Skjor and Aela say they have some sort of special assignment for me. I'm supposed to meet them underneath the Skyforge tonight. Objective 10: Meet with Skjor at night
Objective 15: Enter the Underforge
Objective 20: Participate in the blood ritual

I have ascended to the Circle which leads the Companions, and now share their blood as a werewolf. To celebrate my new status, Skjor and Aela have invited me to attack a Silver Hand camp nearby. Objective 25: Talk to Aela
Objective 30: Kill the werewolf hunters

I have ascended to the Circle which leads the Companions, and now share their blood as a werewolf. Aela led me to a Silver Hand stronghold where Skjor fell in battle. She has enlisted me on her quest for revenge.

notes: You don't need to wait until nightfall to meet Skjor. If you leave the Companions' compound, enter another building, and exit the building you entered, he will make his way to the entrance to the Underforge by the time you return, and the quest will continue like normal.

If you sleep before meeting with Skjor and Aela, you will retain the effects of being Rested, Well Rested or Lover's Comfort until time expires. Your beast's blood will prevent you from getting them again unless you cure your lycanthropy after the Companions questline is completed, so do not sleep in any of the many beds in the Silver Hand base.

If you have Dawnguard installed, this is your first opportunity to start acquiring werewolf perks. If you're in Whiterun, you can kill and feed on guards and citizens for werewolf experience. Guards killed will respawn eventually, but citizens will stay dead.

Once you enter the Underforge, you can talk to Aela in her beast form. If you have the Special Edition, Nintendo Switch version, or Anniversary Edition, you can also engage in conversation with Aela in her beast form (you'll hear her voice as well).

Unless you have the Ring of Hircine, transforming is not immediately possible during the Gallows Rock section. This is because Beast Form is considered a greater power, thus there is a one day cooldown before you can transform again. Simply waiting 24 hours will refresh this and allow you to use your new gift to fight the Silver Hand.
Version 2.1.0 of the Unofficial Skyrim Patch turns Gallows Rock into a no-reset zone, and makes it unclearable during this quest.
After being killed in this quest, Krev the Skinner will eventually respawn with the rest of the dungeon.
The Unofficial Skyrim Patch, version 1.3.1, addresses this issue. A generic boss will spawn instead.
At the end of running around on your rampage through Whiterun, the screen will fade and load the next sequence in the quest. After it finishes loading, the game automatically closes for no reason.
Simply restarting the game and trying again should fix this.
Sometimes, you can transform again after the Rampage stage, but before the Gallows Rock stage, enabling you to fight the Silver Hand in Beast Form and ignoring the 24 hour cooldown.
Sometimes, you won't go on the rampage through Whiterun and instead skip straight to the part where you are with Aela, although the 24-hour cooldown period is active.
Skjor always says "Not now. The Underforge, tonight." even if it is nighttime due to either/or dialogue conditions.
The Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch, version 4.3, addresses this issue. Both dialogue conditions have been merged together.

quick: Talk to Evette San.
Persuade Vittoria Vici to hand over the goods.
Return to Evette.

walkthrough.heading: The Spiced Wine
paragraphs: Evette San is a food vendor who is famous for her Spiced Wine. You can find her at her market stall in Solitude during the day. She may ask you "You wouldn't have a few minutes to run down to the docks would you?" If you are willing to help her, she will tell you "I've got a shipment of Spices the East Empire Company is holding up. I need someone to convince them to release it."

Get out of the city and follow the road down to the harbor area. You can find Vittoria Vici near the East Empire Company Warehouse during the day. Talk to her about Evette's shipment. Vittoria will say, "Ah yes. If she wants to pay the two thousand gold tariff than we'll be all set." At this point, you can try to persuade or bribe Vittoria. You must pass an easy Speech check to persuade her. You can also pay the 2000 gold tariff for the shipment.

Return to Evette with the good news and she will be very happy. "Thank you so much. I swear it's a fight with them every shipment." Then she will give you two bottles of Spiced Wine for your troubles. You can also take more drinks from her stall freely.

stages.text: Objective 10: Convince <Alias=Target> to release the Spiced Wine shipment
Objective 20: Tell <Alias.ShortName=Questgiver> that <Alias.ShortName=Target> agreed to release the shipment

notes: If the Dark Brotherhood quest Bound Until Death is completed, this quest will become unavailable.

quick: Locate and read the Smuggler's Trade Notes at the bandit camp west of Dragonsreach (map).
Obtain the Smuggler's Ledger from Modig Gilgar at his besieged cart near the Western Watchtower (map).
Enter Brittleshin Pass and take the Staff of Hasedoki from Ivara of Olenveld.

walkthrough.heading: Smuggled Goods
paragraphs: Travel to an unmarked bandit camp located beneath a cliff, west of Dragonsreach (map). Once there, you must deal with the hostile bandits and locate the Smuggler's Trade Notes (not to be confused with the Smugglers' Note located nearby). Reading it will reveal that the smugglers were recently approached by an Orc looking to purchase the Staff of Hasedoki, a legendary artifact which they had recently sold to someone else. The smugglers sold this Orc the location of the buyers, planning to intercept and ambush him. Be wary if you are looting the camp, as opening the nearby chest will cause more bandits to spawn.

The ambush site is located along the road west of Whiterun, next to the ruined house near the Western Watchtower (map). The Orc in question, Modig Gilgar, will be found standing over the bodies of multiple bandits. He will turn hostile if you get too close, so you are left with the option to either kill him or pickpocket him to obtain the Smuggler's Ledger. Reading this will reveal the location of the buyers: Ivara of Olenveld and Lushak gra-Ragdam, located in Brittleshin Pass. Be sure to check Modig's cart for loot, including a copy of To Raise the Living as well as a container named Modig's Satchel which holds minor loot.

walkthrough.heading: A Path to the Soul Cairn
paragraphs: You must now venture to Brittleshin Pass, and enter either through its north or south entrance. Taking the southern approach will result in marginally fewer enemies to face. The enemies in question are bonemen, which appear in addition to the usual undead skeletons encountered in Brittleshin Pass.

You will need to make your way to the inner sanctum, where the boss level necromancer would usually be present. In his place, you will find Lushak gra-Ragdam and Ivara of Olenveld, two necromancers who will be hostile on sight. Beware Ivara, as she wields the Staff of Hasedoki. She can repeatedly use the staff to immobilize you. Once you've defeated them both, the remaining bonemen will disappear, leaving you free to loot and exit the cave. Lushak carries copies of Arkay the Enemy and The Black Arts On Trial, the latter being an Illusion skill book. Ivara carries copies of The Light and the Dark, Ivara's Notes, and Souls, Black and White, as well as the Staff itself. Reading her notes will reveal that the two necromancers traveled all the way from the island of Olenveld to open a portal to the Soul Cairn and offer Hasedoki's soul to earn the favor of the Ideal Masters. Loot his Staff from Ivara's corpse to end this plot and complete the quest.

The Staff creates a permanent 40-point ward protection while being held, and when cast it will ragdoll and forcefully knock targets backwards. (This includes you during your fight against Ivara.) If the target then dies within 60 seconds, they will be soul trapped.

stages.text: On the road west of Whiterun I encountered and killed a hostile Orc besieged by bandits. On his body was a ledger that offered additional clues. According to the ledger, the current owners of the staff are two necromancers holed up in Brittleshin Pass.
I've heard rumors of smugglers near Whiterun trading black market items. I should investigate the area to see what I can uncover. Objective 10: Investigate the Smuggler's Den
I've found a smuggler's note which may provide further information on their transactions. Objective 20: Read the smuggler's trade notes

I've found a smuggler's note which detailed the sale of a powerful staff to a necromancer somewhere west of Whiterun. While the location was not written in the note, it was apparently sold to an Orc who was interested in obtaining the staff. As the smuggler's planned to ambush and rob the Orc, I should go to the location and find out what happened. Objective 30: Go to the site of the ambush
On the road west of Whiterun I've encountered a hostile Orc besieged by bandits. It appears conversation is not an option. Objective 40: Kill or pickpocket the Orc
On the road west of Whiterun I encountered an Orc besieged by bandits. I've found a smuggler's ledger on his person that may tell me where he was headed. Objective 55: Read the smuggler's ledger
On the road west of Whiterun I encountered and killed an Orc besieged by bandits. I should check his body for clues on where he was headed. Objective 50: Check the Orc's body for clues

On the road west of Whiterun I encountered and killed a hostile Orc besieged by bandits. On his body was a ledger that offered additional clues. According to the ledger, the current owners of the staff are two necromancers holed up in Brittleshin Pass. Objective 60: Find the necromancers in Brittleshin Pass
I've killed the necromancer Ivara of Olenveld.
I've killed the necromancer Lushak gra-Ragdam.

Inside Brittleshin Pass I was attacked by two necromancers, Ivara of Olenveld and Lushak gra-Ragdam. In their possession was the artifact they purchased from the smugglers, the Staff of Hasedoki. Objective 90: Retrieve the necromancer's staff
Inside Brittleshin Pass I was attacked by two necromancers, Ivara of Olenveld and Lushak gra-Ragdam. In their possession was the artifact they purchased from the smugglers, the Staff of Hasedoki.

Inside Brittleshin Pass I was attacked by two necromancers, Ivara of Olenveld and Lushak gra-Ragdam. In their possession was the artifact they purchased from the smugglers, the Staff of Hasedoki. After defeating them both, I retrieved the staff from the body of Ivara.

notes: Ivara, Lushak, and the three bonemen will spawn in Brittleshin Pass as soon as Modig Gilgar is killed or pickpocketed. Reading the ledger is optional. Brittleshin Pass is not reset by this. If you have not cleared it previously, Ivara will kill the necromancer boss, clearing the dungeon.
Completing the quest will cause Modig Gilgar and his cart to immediately disappear.

quick: Travel to Labyrinthian.
Kill the dragon priest Morokei.
Retrieve the Staff of Magnus.

walkthrough.heading: To Save the College
paragraphs: After the Containment quest, you must leave the college at Mirabelle Ervine's behest, outfitted with the Torc of Labyrinthian and Savos Aren's Amulet. Your destination is Labyrinthian, which will be marked on your map, where you must retrieve the Staff of Magnus in order to contain the Eye of Magnus.

Labyrinthian sits nestled in a pass through the mountains southeast of Morthal. It can be approached from the north or south end of the pass. Following the quest marker, at the top of one of the many staircases, you will arrive at the Ceremonial Door, which is the entrance to the ruin's interior. Here a ghostly after-image of a younger Savos Aren and five adventurous mages from the college, Atmah, Girduin, Takes-In-Light, Hafnar Ice-Fist and Elvali Veren, will appear. Apparently, the late Arch-Mage had explored the ruins before and the apparitions will replay their experience as you progress through the ruins.

walkthrough.heading: Labyrinthian
paragraphs: The Labyrinthian indoor ruins are fairly straightforward and guarded by a number of undead. The entrance room is littered with skeleton corpses; at the opposite end of the room, on your right, you will find a spell tome on an altar.

Proceed through a passage leading to a closed gate opening on a wide room. Levers on each side of the gate can be used to raise it, but it will fall down after a few seconds. A number of skeletons await beyond the gate, as well as a Skeletal Dragon. It is possible to raise the gate and shoot through the open entrance without entering. You can thus eliminate the skeletons and even the dragon before going into the room.

In addition, the dragon doesn't seem to be able to fit through the gate, so if you have entered, you can retreat back through it to take cover. Loot the cavern and descend the stairs where another ghostly scene will relay the events of Girduin's death. Take a moment to read the etched tablet introducing visitors to the great city of Bromjunaar, then proceed into the Labyrinthian Chasm.

Opening the door, you will find twin staircases leading down. Check the alcove on the right for a hidden chest, then take the right-hand staircase down. When you emerge into the chamber you will hear Morokei's voice, resonating with glowing power, addressing you in the dragon language "Wo meyz wah dii vul junaar?".

As he speaks, a large portion of your magicka will drain. As his voice subsides, a closed door is apparent. The door seems to be covered in ice, and then, as if to confirm, a frost spirit will emerge from the doorway. A draugr is also standing in one of the alcoves in this room. After removing the enemies, locate a flames spell tome which is in an alcove nearby. Cast a flames spell at the icy door to melt the ice crystals and open the door.

Entering the chasm beyond, Morokei will again address you, draining your magicka: "Nivahriin muz fent siiv nid aaz het". From the doorway, you will see a draugr standing below; an easy target for a ranged attack. There are several more draugr roaming this area, so be on guard. After eliminating the threat, enter the tunnel to find a door guarded by a lightning rune. Behind the door, another draugr is in a small room with the Equilibrium spell tome.

Return to the chasm and descend another level. There are several more draugr roaming this area, so be on guard. Here, the passageway will fork, with a bridge in front of you and a side passage continuing deeper into the chasm. You will hear Morokei's voice once again, this time speaking in your "guttural" language, trying to engage you in conversation.

Either path, across the bridge or along the side wall, lead to the bottom of the chasm; however, the bridge features more draugr. Beyond, the cave leads to a river running through the chasm. A door at the far end of the passage leads to the next section of the ruins. Approaching the door, you hear Morokei plaintively asking for Aren.

walkthrough.heading: Labyrinthian Thoroughfare
paragraphs: Once inside open the next gate that leads to a sunken cavern strewn with stalactites and stalagmites. Haunting this cavern is a skeleton and a draugr.
